More details are revealed about the source of Juliette's illness, resulting in an epic showdown. Back at the precinct, Hank senses that something is amiss when Nick lands in hot water with the FBI. Meanwhile, Captain Renard continues to reveal himself as he deals with his estranged brother.

episodes.name: Bad Moon Rising
episodes.summary: As Hank continues to seek help to cope with the inexplicable siting he had, an old friend, Jarold Kempfer, needs his help when his daughter goes missing. Nick's expertise as a Grimm comes in to play as he investigates the disturbing motives linked to the disappearance.

episodes.name: Quill
episodes.summary: While investigating an accident site, Nick comes upon a bizarre and gruesome Wesen disease that is spreading quickly. A romantic day out for Monroe and Rosalee takes a dangerous turn when they encounter an infected creature that is out for blood. Meanwhile, Captain Renard gets a tip about a dangerous foreign fugitive who's made his way to Portland.

episodes.name: The Good Shepherd
episodes.summary: When a local Reverend reports that his church has been robbed, Nick quickly learns that it's a Wesen church, and enlists Monroe to check for any suspicious activity regarding the shepherd's flock. Meanwhile, Nick and Juliette continue to figure out the rules of their relationship as a dangerous opponent lurks in the shadows with his sites on Nick.

episodes.name: Over My Dead Body
episodes.summary: Angelina comes back in to town with bad tidings as Monroe learns his continued cooperation with the Grimm may come at a high cost. Nick comes to Hank for help to keep Monroe safe and Hank uses this time to get caught up with his knowledge of the "Wesen world." Meanwhile, an old European acquaintance pays Captain Renard a visit, but it's hard to tell if this visit is for business or pleasure.

episodes.name: The Bottle Imp
episodes.summary: After investigating a grisly murder, clues lead Nick and Hank to a seemingly unstable father who is on the run with his daughter. As they learn more about the case they realize that the girl's father may be the least of their worries. At the spice shop, Monroe finds out filling in for Rosalee isn't as simple as he'd hoped it would be. Meanwhile, Captain Renard finds himself paying unwarranted attention to more than one woman from his past.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to the scene of a murdered high school academic decathlete and learn just how competitive some extracurricular activities can be, and the extremes some coaches and parents will go to give students the best chance for success. In other police matters, Captain Renard deals with an unwanted infatuation while we learn an old accomplice of his has been spending time with his family in Europe. Elsewhere, Monroe continues to manage the spice shop and gets a visit from an unlikely customer.

episodes.name: La Llorona
episodes.summary: Despite the enthusiastic anticipation of the city's residents for Halloween, a series of horrifying child abductions make their way to Portland, quickly spoiling the holiday spirit. Nick and Hank join forces with Valentina Espinosa, a mysterious detective from Albuquerque, to help find and capture the elusive suspect. Juliette joins their investigation, acting as the precinct's fill-in Spanish translator. The more Nick digs into the case, the more he realizes the pattern of the kidnapping matches those in the famed Hispanic horror story "La Llorona," a story with its roots intertwined with his own family's history. Meanwhile, Monroe celebrates the holiday in fine style as he teaches the neighborhood bullies a lesson.

episodes.name: The Hour of Death
episodes.summary: When a brutal vigilante homicide is made public, it sends Portland's Wesen community into a frenzy. As Nick investigates further, he discovers a pattern similar to that of a particularly brutal line of past Grimms. Is there another Grimm in town, or is Nick dealing with a sadistic copycat? Meanwhile, Captain Renard takes it upon himself to offer Juliette comfort in handling her ongoing dilemma with Nick.

episodes.name: To Protect and Serve Man
episodes.summary: Hank starts reflecting on an arrest he made earlier in his career regarding a man who committed murder claiming "self-defense against monsters." With the man's death sentence rapidly approaching and the knowledge he's recently gathered from Nick, Hank begins to wonder if there was more truth to the man's seemingly absurd story then he once thought. Back at the spice shop, Monroe finds himself involved in a situation he never saw coming.

episodes.name: Season of the Hexenbiest
episodes.summary: Adalind returns to wreak havoc in everyone's lives and avenge her mother's brutal death. She has her eyes set on Nick and those closest to him - especially Hank and Juliette. Elsewhere, Captain Renard's obsession continues to escalate. Meanwhile, a surprise visit at the spice shop gives Monroe more than he ever bargained for.

episodes.name: Face Off
episodes.summary: After Nick learns about Juliette and Captain Renard, he must deal with the consequences. Things get even more complicated when Nick is called to investigate his own crime. Meanwhile, the search for the key intensifies as Captain Renard finds Nick's trailer and makes a surprising alliance. With Rosalee's help, Monroe informs Nick that they might be able to stop what's going on with Renard and Juliette before it goes too far. Elsewhere, Wu responds to a bizarre shooting at Nick and Juliette's house.

episodes.name: Natural Born Wesen
episodes.summary: The Wesen code of honor comes into question when Nick, Hank and Monroe discover a series of bank robberies with Wesen using true natures as their disguises. Meanwhile, Juliette finds herself tormented by faint, slowly returning memories that cause her to question her mental state.

episodes.name: Mr. Sandman
episodes.summary: When a mysterious case of sudden blindness causes a woman's death, Nick and Hank come across a disturbing Wesen that feeds off its victim's tears. Meanwhile, Adalind contemplates the significance of her new situation, while Juliette continues to work with Rosalee in an effort to fix her memory.

episodes.name: Nameless
episodes.summary: When a gruesome homicide brings an office party to a screeching halt, Nick and Hank find themselves battling a Wesen on a completely new platform - online. Meanwhile, Juliette's mysterious hallucinations finally start to take shape, giving them a whole new meaning.

episodes.name: One Angry Fuchsbau
episodes.summary: While on jury duty, Rosalee tasks Nick, Hank and Monroe to help stop a defense attorney from using his particular "Wesen wiles" to overturn what should be an open-and-shut murder case. Back at the precinct, Captain Renard brings Nick and Hank in on his own recent dealings with the Verrat, to keep them on their toes. Meanwhile, a return to the trailer brings a flurry of memories of Nick rushing back to Juliette.

episodes.name: Volcanalis
episodes.summary: Nick finds himself fighting a wildly different sort of nature freak in a desperate attempt to keep a volcano from burying Portland in lava. Meanwhile a pregnant Adalind meets a powerful new ally in Europe. Meanwhile, Juliette seeks out help after becoming overwhelmed by the latest side effect of her recovery - multiple memories of Nick showing up everywhere.

episodes.name: Endangered
episodes.summary: Mysterious cow mutilations and reports of glowing creatures put Nick on a case that forces him to question the existence of aliens within the Wesen world. He also meets a strange UFO expert who seems to know more than he's letting on. Meanwhile, Nick digs further into the key, and Juliette's romantic memories of Nick start coming back in a big way.

episodes.name: Kiss of the Muse
episodes.summary: Nick discovers a muse-like Wesen with the ability to influence those she gets close to - some with positive results, others with terrifying ones. Nick must find a way to get close without losing himself in the process. Juliette arranges a dinner date with Nick in the hopes of clearing the air, but their plans go awry as the case intensifies. Meanwhile, Rosalee takes her first visit to Aunt Marie's trailer.

episodes.name: The Waking Dead
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank discover a new kind of strange when they investigate suspects being found dead - for the second time. In Europe, Adalind finds herself in the middle of a feud between Frau Pech and Stefania while working over the details of her pending transaction. Meanwhile, determined to remember every last detail to get things started once more, Juliette insists Monroe share with her Nick's darkest secret - the world of Grimms and Wesen.

episodes.name: Goodnight, Sweet Grimm
episodes.summary: Just when things look like they're back to normal with Juliette, Nick is called to investigate a flurry of rage-fueled assaults happening all over Portland. He goes to Monroe and Rosalee for help battling Portland's newest wave of "undead." As if that weren't enough, Captain Renard informs Nick that his brother Eric is in town on family business. Meanwhile, Stefania and Frau Pech methodically use their alliances with Adalind to battle one another.

episodes.name: The Ungrateful Dead
episodes.summary: Panicked Juliette, Monroe, and Rosalee enlist Hank's help in fending off a zombie hoard while trying to figure out what happened to Nick. Knowing the truth, Captain Renard takes measures to help rescue Nick from the clutches of his brother, Eric. Elsewhere, along with the help of the mysterious Stefania, Adalind finds herself facing her most gruesome task yet in her effort to regain her Hexenbiest abilities.

episodes.name: PTZD
episodes.summary: Monroe, Hank, Rosalee and Juliette track down a manic Nick and do all they can to find him and reverse what's been done to him before he causes any more damage. Meanwhile, Captain Renard does his best to clean up the zombie fallout on all fronts - domestic and international. Elsewhere, the more time Adalind spends with Stefania, the more disturbing things seem to get in her quest to regain her Hexenbiest abilities.

episodes.name: A Dish Best Served Cold
episodes.summary: Series of disturbing crime scenes leads Nick and Hank to the resurrection of an old feud that's all too familiar for Nick and Monroe. With the news of a royal family member's demise, several key players start to make their move. Meanwhile despite his recent trauma, Nick finds himself healthier than normal and Monroe and Rosalee talk about moving their relationship forward.

episodes.name: One Night Stand
episodes.summary: When Nick and Hank investigate a drowning death with mysterious marks on the victim's ankles, they happen upon a group of water-bound Wesen with a deadly postcoital cuddle. Meanwhile, Rosalee starts unpacking her things at Monroe's, and Captain Renard makes a startling realization about the possible identities of the Royal Baby's parents.

episodes.name: El Cucuy
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are on the case as repeat instances of apparent vigilantism have whispers of an old Spanish legend making their way through a working-class Portland neighborhood. Elsewhere, Juliette learns the truth about Nick's mother. Meanwhile, Adalind has a brief scare during her ultrasound.

episodes.name: Stories We Tell Our Young
episodes.summary: Nick faces his toughest challenge yet when he and Hank investigate a case that combines religious phenomenon with the dark dealings of the Wesen Council. Meanwhile, Rosalee is torn when Nick's case challenges her Wesen loyalties. Elsewhere, Captain Renard leaves town to tend to some "family matters."

episodes.name: Cold Blooded
episodes.summary: As a deadly crime spree begins to surface, a century-old urban legend takes shape in Portland's sewers and becomes Nick's latest case. In Europe, Adalind meets Prince Viktor, who's come to bring those responsible for his cousin Eric's demise to justice. Meanwhile, Captain Renard responds to the recent attempt on his life.

episodes.name: Twelve Days of Krampus
episodes.summary: After a string of delinquent teens go missing, an old Wesen tale of an evil Santa who brings more than just a lump of coal may be the prime suspect. The investigation intensifies as Nick and Hank take things a little too far. Meanwhile, Monroe enlists Juliet to surprise Rosalee for their first Christmas together with unintended results. Elsewhere, Captain Renard's tour of Europe brings him closer to tracking down Adalind.

episodes.name: Red Menace
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a Wesen "healer" whose ability holds risks that far outweigh its rewards. Meanwhile, Juliette takes in a friend when domestic issues escalate and Hank makes a move on his physical therapist Zuri. Elsewhere, Captain Renard finally tracks down Adalind and has a stern warning for her.

episodes.name: Eyes of the Beholder
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to the scene of a gang-related homicide. The case escalates as Zuri, Hank's physical therapist, and her brother get caught up in the investigation. Meanwhile, Juliette seeks advice from Rosalee in dealing with the news that her friend is Wesen.

episodes.name: The Good Soldier
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to the gruesome murder of a veteran working in home security. During their investigation, they discover this might be one of several revenge killings regarding a horrifying cover-up involving members of the army and military contractors. On the domestic front, Monroe accompanies Rosalee during her long overdue reunion with her mother and sister. In Europe, Adalind sees hints of what she thinks might be her powers returning.

episodes.name: The Wild Hunt
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a cop killer who scalps his victims. Meanwhile, Juliette begins to communicate with Nick's mom via email and Adalind finds herself much closer to delivering her baby than she previously thought. Elsewhere, Monroe's parents decide to surprise him and Rosalee with an early arrival to Portland after learning some exciting news.

episodes.name: Revelation
episodes.summary: Monroe fights an impossible battle to convince his parents to embrace the life choices he's made. Meanwhile, Nick turns to Juliette to help him figure out the Wesen aspect of his cop-killing scalper investigation. On the Royal Baby front, Captain Renard learns new information that forces him to contact Adalind in the interest of keeping her and the baby safe from Viktor.

episodes.name: Mommy Dearest
episodes.summary: Horrible new predator creeps into Portland with its sight set on a young expectant couple who are close friends of Sgt. Wu. Nick and Hank must figure out how to deal with Wu as the investigation escalates. Meanwhile, Adalind prepares for a special delivery while her enemies are hot on her trail.

episodes.name: Once We Were Gods
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank find themselves thrown into the middle of an ancient battle and things heat up when the Wesen Council decides to get involved. Monroe and Rosalee fill everyone in on early Wesen history. Meanwhile, Sgt. Wu is still reeling from the events he recently experienced. As things heat up in Europe, one of the Resistance's most trusted allies gets compromised as he tries to protect Adalind.

episodes.name: The Show Must Go On
episodes.summary: Double homicide leads Nick and Hank to a traveling carnival where the performers are not what they seem. To get a better understanding of what's going on behind the scenes Monroe and Rosalee go undercover. On the wedding front, Monroe has a really important question for Nick. In Austria, an invaluable member of the Resistance makes the ultimate sacrifice to help Adalind.

episodes.name: Synchronicity
episodes.summary: The Resistance's plan to keep Adalind safe gets kicked into high gear when an unexpected ally arrives to ensure she and the baby make it out of Europe safely. In Portland, as Monroe and Rosalee prepare for their upcoming wedding, Nick and Juliette are reminded of their failed proposal.

episodes.name: The Law of Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Nick and his mom, Kelly Burkhardt, join forces to protect Adalind's baby. Meanwhile, Prince Viktor activates a deadly stateside asset to find Adalind and her child.

episodes.name: Nobody Knows the Trubel I've Seen
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a dangerous female suspect leaving a trail of Wesen in her wake. Elsewhere, Adalind takes measures into her own hands, even if that means forging a dangerous alliance.

episodes.name: My Fair Wesen
episodes.summary: Nick does his best to educate Trubel on how best to handle the world she is learning about for the first time, and decides it best to bring her on a ride along with Hank. They find themselves investigating the homicide of a young woman that strikes a chord for Trubel. Meanwhile, Adalind makes a discovery that she hopes will lead her to regain something she has lost.

episodes.name: The Inheritance
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to investigate a double homicide, and quickly learn the victims were from a special section of the Verrat tasked with finding rare objects pertaining to the Wesen world. Trubel gets involved with a mysterious father-and-son tandem that crossed the country in a desperate attempt to deliver invaluable cargo to "the Portland Grimm." Meanwhile, Captain Renard begins to grow suspicious of Adalind's recent behavior and quietly decides to put extra eyes on her.

episodes.name: Blond Ambition
episodes.summary: It's Monroe and Rosalee's big day and their joy will only be matched by unexpected heartache for those around them. Nick and Juliette make a startling realization that could shake their relationship to its core. Meanwhile, Adalind proceeds with a delicately laid plan that leads to a catastrophic event that will alter the course of Nick's journey.

episodes.name: Thanks for the Memories
episodes.summary: After the events at Monroe and Rosalee's wedding, Nick is faced with losing his identity as a Grimm. Hank and Juliette join Nick as they try to figure out how to deal with Trubel as she faces the consequences of a heinous murder she committed. Meanwhile, when Wu arrives at the scene, his discoveries bring back images of his traumatic encounter. A new threat arrives in Portland to steal the memories of its victims, leaving them in a state of dementia. Elsewhere, Captain Renard's life hangs in the balance and Adalind falls into Prince Viktor's trap as she desperately searches for her baby.

episodes.name: Octopus Head
episodes.summary: As Nick and Hank turn their attention to a string of attacks where victims are left without their memories, Nick weighs whether or not he should regain his Grimm abilities. Trubel joins the investigation and puts herself in harms way. ?In Vienna, Adalind is being held captive and learns that she is more connected than ever to Nick. Meanwhile, Captain Renard continues to fight for his life as a mysterious visitor arrives to help him.

episodes.name: Last Fight
episodes.summary: After Nick has a bizarre, unsettling vision, he and Hank find themselves on a case that takes them into the world of boxing. Trubel finds herself under the watchful eye of Agent Chavez before jumping into the ring to help with Nick's investigation. Meanwhile, Monroe and Rosalee get some unexpected help in figuring out a way to restore Nick's Grimm abilities. Elsewhere, Adalind encounters a mysterious visitor in her dungeon cell.

episodes.name: Dyin' on a Prayer
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to an unusual crime scene with a victim who appears to have died from clay-induced asphyxiation. At the precinct, Wu begins to grow more suspicious of Trubel's presence. At the Spice Shop, Elizabeth makes a major breakthrough with regards to restoring Nick's powers, while Monroe and Rosalee experience cultural backlash as a result of their inter-Wesen marriage. In Europe, Adalind hopes that putting trust in her mysterious visitor will help her escape the dungeon.

episodes.name: Cry Luison
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to the scene of a crime where the suspect swears she was driven to madness by a very persistent talking wolf. Meanwhile, Nick and Juliette wonder if getting his Grimm powers back is worth giving up a normal life.Elsewhere, Bud hopes Trubel can help take care of a wesen-related issue and the threats against Monroe and Rosalee's inter-wesen marriage heat up. In Austria, Adalind continues her perilous trek in the hopes of retrieving her daughter.

episodes.name: Highway of Tears
episodes.summary: The justification for Nick to become a Grimm again is made much clearer in the wake of the most recent attack against Monroe and Rosalee. At work, Nick and Hank are called to a stretch of highway that acts as a staging area for a horrifying Wesen ritual. In Vienna, Viktor meets with a completely broken Adalind, now ready to be of assistance in finding and retrieving the baby. Meanwhile, Trubel is surprised by the sudden arrival of an old friend.

episodes.name: The Grimm Who Stole Christmas
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to investigate a bizarre string of home invasions that lead to an even stranger Wesen phenomena. Monroe has a very special Christmas surprise in store for Rosalee. Meanwhile, Truble comes to a life changing realization that will affect everyone.

episodes.name: Chupacabra
episodes.summary: An unsuspecting traveler brings a blood-sucking legend with him to Portland, and Nick and Hank find themselves investigating the gruesome trail of "El Chupacabra." Meanwhile, Monroe and Rosalee prepare to leave for their long-overdue honeymoon as they are met with more threats regarding their marriage. Elsewhere, Viktor and Adalind decide to take a trip of their own, while Wu decides to confront Nick about what he has been seeing.

episodes.name: Wesenrein
episodes.summary: The Wesenrein act on their many threats against Monroe and Rosalee's marriage. Meanwhile, Nick and Hank bring Wu to a place where he's sure to find the answers he's looking for. Elsewhere, Juliette tries to come to grips with her new reality.

episodes.name: Tribunal
episodes.summary: After Monroe's abduction by the Wesenrein, Nick gathers the whole team, including Wu, to track him down and return him to Rosalee. As the search intensifies, Juliette learns more about her new reality as a Hexenbiest.

episodes.name: Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Monroe and Rosalee are finally off on their honeymoon, but that doesn't mean trouble isn't stirring in Portland. Nick and Hank are called to a shocking homicide at an abandoned residence many Portland locals think is haunted, even the survivors swear a ghost committed the murder. Meanwhile, on the heels of Juliette's startling revelation Captain Renard seeks the help of a mystical woman from his past.

episodes.name: Maréchaussée
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a series of murders that lead back to the Wesen Council and a mysterious bounty hunter. Elsewhere, Juliette's meeting with Henrietta brings about more disturbing news than she was expecting. Meanwhile, Adalind and Viktor make their way back to Portland.

episodes.name: Trial by Fire
episodes.summary: When an arson case looks to have Wesen origins, Nick find himself reluctantly having to ask an old foe for help. Elsewhere, Viktor teaches Adalind the effectiveness of well-played diplomacy. Meanwhile, Juliette finds herself in a confrontation sooner than expected.

episodes.name: Bad Luck
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a murder victim with his foot cut off, and stumble onto a disturbing Wesen take on the "lucky rabbit's foot." In an effort to help, Monroe and Rosalee go undercover. Meanwhile, the fallout from Adalind and Juliette's showdown still has Nick reeling and sends him on a path that leads to Henrietta.

episodes.name: Double Date
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to investigate a one night stand turned deadly when a man finds himself in the middle of a very bizarre love triangle. Captain Renard hopes Monroe and Rosalee can help him deal with recurring episodes of phantom bleeding. Meanwhile, Adalind makes a discovery that might turn the tables in her favor and Juliette makes a big decision that could change the course of her relationship with Nick.

episodes.name: Heartbreaker
episodes.summary: Cyclist's homicide introduces Nick and Hank to a Wesen with a tragic fatal touch. Captain Renard and Adalind learn the Royals have stepped up their efforts to find their child, and another member of the Royal family is introduced. Meanwhile, Juliette ponders the idea of embracing what she's become as opposed to fighting it.

episodes.name: Hibernaculum
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are called to investigate a rare Wesen that leaves its victims frozen solid. Meanwhile, Juliette starts to feel that she is losing her humanity as she seeks to get revenge on Adalind. Elsewhere, Captain Renard continues to suffer from mysterious bleeding and visions while Monroe works toward coming to grips with the Wesenrein incident.

episodes.name: Mishipeshu
episodes.summary: Homicide leads Nick and Hank onto the dark and mysterious path of a local Native American power quest. Meanwhile, Juliette's erratic behavior lands her on the wrong side of the law. At the spice shop, Rosalee and Monroe are on a mission and call on Captain Renard for help.

episodes.name: Iron Hans
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank are brought in to investigate a homicide they learn is connected to an age-old Wesen rite of passage. Meanwhile, Juliette makes a surprising new ally. Elsewhere, Captain Renard continues to battle a darkness within, and Nick finds hope for Juliette in the last person he expected - Adalind.

episodes.name: You Don't Know Jack
episodes.summary: String of homicides have the press asking Captain Renard if a Jack the Ripper copycat has arrived in Portland. While dealing with the investigation, Nick, Hank, Monroe and Wu deal with a situation they never expected. Meanwhile, Adalind and Rosalee must work together on a last ditch attempt to fix Juliette's condition. Elsewhere, Juliette decides to help her new ally even if it means hurting those around her.

episodes.name: Headache
episodes.summary: While investigating a grisly murder, Nick and Hank get closer to uncovering the identity of the serial killer while Wu's life is put in grave danger. Having turned down Monroe and Rosalee's offer, Juliette solidifies a new alliance as she works to get her revenge. Elsewhere, Trubel makes a surprising return to Portland.

episodes.name: Cry Havoc
episodes.summary: On the heels of a shocking discovery, Nick is hell bent on getting revenge and taking the fight to the Royals with help from Trubel. Meanwhile, Juliette's alliance continues to lead her down a dark path.

episodes.name: The Grimm Identity
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of Kelly and Juliette's deaths, Nick's friends question whether he can handle the strain. Meanwhile, Trubel goes missing and Nick is blaming an FBI agent... and Adalind goes into labor.

episodes.name: Clear and Wesen Danger
episodes.summary: With Nick on leave, Hank gets a new partner as he investigates the case of a seemingly mild-mannered accountant who is actually a vicious Wesen killer... with ties to the organization that killed Chavez. Meanwhile, Adalind moves in with Nick because she has nowhere else to go.

episodes.name: Lost Boys
episodes.summary: Four homeless Wesen children lose the "mother" that they kidnapped and decide to take Rosalee as their new mother. Meanwhile, Nick moves Adalind and Kelly to his new home, and Renard meets with Meisner for the first time since the King's death.

episodes.name: Maiden Quest
episodes.summary: A man trying to kill a mobster is himself killed by a Wesen, and Nick and Hank determine that an old ritual is at the heart of the murder. Meanwhile, a mayoral candidate asks Renard for his support, Rosalee receives a letter from an old friend, and Nick and Adalind continue to adjust to living together.

episodes.name: The Rat King
episodes.summary: While Nick and Hank investigate the deaths of two Wesen, Trubel recovers at the hospital. However, the Occultatum Libera have tracked her down and have their own plans. Meanwhile, Meisner contacts Adalind.

episodes.name: Wesen Nacht
episodes.summary: A local gang of Wesen attack Wesen shop owners, and Nick and Hank soon discover that the attacks are deliberate... and tied to the Uprising. Meanwhile, Trubel settles in at the fortress, and Renard films an ad for the mayoral candidate.

episodes.name: Eve of Destruction
episodes.summary: After the ambush by the group calling themselves Black Claw, Nick calls Meisner and demands to see the new Juliet. Meanwhile, a Black Claw attack wipes out the Council, and the team's prisoner is attacked while in custody.

episodes.name: A Reptile Dysfunction
episodes.summary: While Meisner shows Nick the extent of the HW organization and reintroduces him to Eve, the detectives deal with a lakeshore killer who is mistaken for a legendary water monster and murders two people.

episodes.name: Star-Crossed
episodes.summary: HW requests a meeting with Nick and his allies to determine if they are with the organization or against them. Meanwhile, two bodies turned up ritualistically murdered, and Nick discovers that they are connected to an ancient Wesen ritual ... that isn't complete.

episodes.name: Map of the Seven Knights
episodes.summary: Monroe's Uncle Felix comes into possession of a cache of Grimm journals, which could hold the key to Nick's and Trubel's pasts... and the location of the Templar cache. However, two Black Claw killers will stop at nothing to get the journals.

episodes.name: Key Move
episodes.summary: Nick and Monroe use the key map to find the location in Germany where the Seven Knights hid their treasure. In Portland, an assassination closes in on Renard and the mayoral candidate that he's supporting in the election.

episodes.name: Into the Schwarzwald
episodes.summary: While Nick and Monroe search the catacombs in Germany, Hank, Wu, and Renard try to bring Dixon's killer to justice. Meanwhile, Tony pays Rosalee a visit, and Adalind discovers that her Hexenbiest powers are returning.

episodes.name: Silence of the Slams
episodes.summary: A maskmaker for Luchadors kills a Wesen to obtain his face... and make a mask from it for a young Luchador client. Meanwhile, Adalind worries about what happens if she reverts to her Hexenbiest nature, and Eve looks into Andrew's assassination.

episodes.name: Lycanthropia
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a pair of murders that lead them to a family inflicted with a Wesen genetic disorder. Meanwhile, Renard arranges a meeting with Adalind, and Eve continues her investigation into Andrew's assassination.

episodes.name: Skin Deep
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a young girl's murder... where she aged 70 years overnight. Meanwhile, Renard considers running for mayor, and Eve continues her investigation of Black Claw.

episodes.name: The Believer
episodes.summary: A preacher uses his Devil-like Wesen form to convince his audience that he is possessed by Satan and then casts him out. While Nick and Hank investigate, Eve gets closer to Rachel than she expected when she disguises herself as Renard.

episodes.name: Inugami
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate a decapitation murder and discover that it is tied to an ancient Wesen ritual. Meanwhile, Eve warns Adalind not to harm Nick, Monroe and Rosalee explore the tunnels, and Adalind applies for her old job at the law firm.

episodes.name: Good to the Bone
episodes.summary: Two corpses turned up dead, their bones liquified and then extracted from their bodies. While Nick, Hank, and Monroe track down the killer, Wu deals with his ongoing transformation. Meanwhile, Renard arranges a secret meeting with Adalind.

episodes.name: The Taming of the Wu
episodes.summary: While Wu deals with his nightmares, Renard and a Black Claw representative both give Adalind an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Bad Night
episodes.summary: Nick realizes that Adalind is with Renard, and Renard arranges a meeting with the Grimm to explain his options. Meanwhile, Zuri lets a Black Claw agent into her house to clone Hank's phone, but he catches on and realizes that Zuri is connected to the enemy.

episodes.name: Beginning of the End - Part One
episodes.summary: Black Claw closes in on Nick and his allies, framing Hank for murder and wiping out HW's compound. Meanwhile, Diana's attempts to force Renard and Adalind together threaten Black Claw's plans.

episodes.name: Beginning of the End - Part Two
episodes.summary: With Nick in custody, Black Claw makes its move and launches attacks on the entire team. Eve is mortally wounded and the cure may be worse than the injury. Meanwhile, Rosalee tries to find the right time to give Monroe some important news.

episodes.name: Fugitive
episodes.summary: With pressure coming down from Black Claw, Renard claims that Nick killed Conrad and gives his officers a shoot-to-kill order on the Grimm. Meanwhile, Eve discovers that she can't woge, and Monroe and Rosalee consider their baby's future.

episodes.name: Trust Me Knot
episodes.summary: Nick manages to escape the police but is forced to make a deal with Renard. Meanwhile, the others try to decipher the cloth while Monroe babysits Diana.

episodes.name: Oh Captain, My Captain
episodes.summary: In a desperate ploy to undermine Renard, Nick has Eve cast a spell to transform him into the captain. Meanwhile, Diana reveals further powers, and Renard obtains a new ally that he can't afford to lose.

episodes.name: El Cuegle
episodes.summary: Back at work, Nick, Hank and Wu investigate a baby abduction tied to an ancient Wesen legend of El Cuegle, which steals and eats babies. Meanwhile, Adalind takes Diana to stay with Renard, while Eve examines the stick.

episodes.name: The Seven Year Itch
episodes.summary: A cicada-like Wesen emerges from its seven-year hibernation with an insatiable hunger... and a need to find a victim that will sustain it through its next hibernation. Meanwhile, Adalind finds Eve in the tunnels, and Monroe and Rosalee confirm Diana's predictions about Rosalee's pregnancy.

episodes.name: Breakfast in Bed
episodes.summary: After a hotel guest kills a man on the street, Nick and Hank investigate and discover a series of bizarre murders and suicides at the same hotel. Meanwhile, Eve and Rosalee try to work out the meaning of the symbols,and Renard gets a warning about a visitor.

episodes.name: Blind Love
episodes.summary: Adalind leaves Diana with Renard while she and the others go to a hotel to celebrate Monroe's birthday. While Diana has a playdate with a new friend, Nick and the others get caught up in a twisted revenge scheme.

episodes.name: The Son Also Rises
episodes.summary: When a scientist is killed in her laboratory, Hank and Wu investigate and discover that a strange incident ties together the dead woman with three of her colleagues. Meanwhile, the black-skulled creature attacks Eve, and Nick stands guard over her as she recovers in the hospital.

episodes.name: Tree People
episodes.summary: Nick and the others investigate a series of disappearances in the forest all tied to crimes against nature. Meanwhile, Diana tells the group where the creature that attacked Eve came from, and Renard gets disturbing news from his contact in Russia.

episodes.name: Blood Magic
episodes.summary: Nick and Hank investigate two seemingly unrelated crimes: a mystery killer of people on the street, and an orderly who claims that an elderly patient turned into a monster and attacked him shortly before she turned up dead.

episodes.name: Where the Wild Things Were
episodes.summary: Nick uses the Stick to pass through the mirror, but discovers that he and Eve are trapped on the other side. Meanwhile, the others bring Renard in and Dasha warns them that they are facing the fulfillment of ancient prophecy.

episodes.name: Zerstörer Shrugged
episodes.summary: When Diana opens the portal to bring Nick and Eve back, Zerstörer comes to the real world as well just as he planned. The team realize the significance of the Stick while Zerstörer attacks the precinct house.

episodes.name: The End
episodes.summary: Nick faces off against Zerstörer in final battle, and the devil-wesen gives him an unthinkable choice: hand over the stick or let his friends die. However, Nick receives help from two unexpected allies.

shows.title: Gotham
shows.summary:
The good. The evil. The beginning.

Everyone knows the name Commissioner Gordon. He is one of the crime world's greatest foes, a man whose reputation is synonymous with law and order. But what is known of Gordon's story and his rise from rookie detective to Police Commissioner? What did it take to navigate the multiple layers of corruption that secretly ruled Gotham City, the spawning ground of the world's most iconic villains? And what circumstances created them – the larger-than-life personas who would become Catwoman, The Penguin, The Riddler, Two-Face and The Joker?

Gotham is an origin story of the great DC Comics Super-Villains and vigilantes, revealing an entirely new chapter that has never been told. It follows one cop's rise through a dangerously corrupt city teetering between good and evil, and chronicles the birth of one of the most popular super heroes of our time.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Lt. Jim Gordon tries to deal with the corruption in his new home of Gotham, but his partner Harvey Bullock isn't interested. Their first case is investigating the shooting deaths of one of Gotham's wealthiest couples, the Waynes.

episodes.name: Selina Kyle
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey investigate a child-trafficking ring, while Oswald returns to Gotham vowing revenge.

episodes.name: The Balloonman
episodes.summary: A vigilante targets the corrupt by sending them into the stratosphere. Oswald tries to use Carmine's rival to get revenge on Carmine, and someone tries to turn Barbara against Jim.

episodes.name: Arkham
episodes.summary: Someone hires a hitman to target city council members deciding the fate of Arkham. Oswald continues using Maroni to get at Carmine.

episodes.name: Viper
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey try to track down a new street drug, while Oswald and Fish both continue their plots against Carmine. Bruce continues searching for his parents' killer.

episodes.name: Spirit of the Goat
episodes.summary: A seemingly dead serial killer, the Goat, rises to kill more firstborn sons of wealth and privilege. Oswald pays his mother Gertrud a visit, and Edward makes a friend.

episodes.name: Penguin's Umbrella
episodes.summary: Jim tries to bring Mayor James and Falcone to justice for the Waynes' murder. Maroni defies Carmine, and hitman Victor Zsasz pays Jim a visit.

episodes.name: The Mask
episodes.summary: A financial CEO runs a fight club among his employees, and Jim and Harvey find out about it. Alfred helps Bruce when he returns to school and finds his classmates less than sympathetic toward his plight.

episodes.name: Harvey Dent
episodes.summary: DA Harvey Dent tries to close the Waynes' murder case with Jim's help. Meanwhile, Oswald finds out who Fish has on the inside of the Falcone operation.

episodes.name: LoveCraft
episodes.summary: Bruce trains with Selina, and an assassin comes after the girl. Jim learns about it, while Alfred and Harvey go after the teenagers when they flee the city to avoid the killer.

episodes.name: Rogues' Gallery
episodes.summary: After Jim is reassigned to Arkham, he looks into a guard's murder. Selina takes Ivy to Jim's apartment and finds an unexpected ally.

episodes.name: What the Little Bird Told Him
episodes.summary: Jim hunts a self-styled "Electrocutioner", and Fish tries to take down Carmine.

episodes.name: Welcome Back, Jim Gordon
episodes.summary: Jim is reinstated but forced to turn to Oswald for help when he goes after a mole in the police. Bruce looks for Selina, and Oswald tries to impress Gertrud.

episodes.name: The Fearsome Dr. Crane
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey investigate a new killer who uses his victims' worst fears against them. Edward gets a job notice, and Fish gets revenge on the person who betrayed her by telling Maroni who it was.

episodes.name: The Scarecrow
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey continue their search for the fear-based serial killer, Carmine makes a request of Maroni, and Bruce goes for his annual hike alone for the first time.

episodes.name: The Blind Fortune Teller
episodes.summary: Jim and Leslie go to the circus, Oswald gets a new employee, and Barbara gets new roommates.

episodes.name: Red Hood
episodes.summary: Bank robbers wear red hoods to stay anonymous, baffling Jim and Harvey's efforts to bring them in. Barbara tries to become Selina's friend, and Fish tries to negotiate her release.

episodes.name: Everyone Has a Cobblepot
episodes.summary: Bruce and Alfred deal with the attack on Alfred. Selina offers her help to Bruce, and Jim tries to help Harvey who is in over his head.

episodes.name: Beasts of Prey
episodes.summary: While Bruce and Selina track down Reggie, Jim and Harvey investigate the Ogre, and Fish tries to escape the Dollmaker.

episodes.name: Under the Knife
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey continue pursuing the Ogre, Maroni visits Gertrud, and Edward defends Kristen.

episodes.name: The Anvil or the Hammer
episodes.summary: Jim discovers that someone close to him is involved with the Ogre. Oswald tries to gain control of the Gotham underworld, and Bruce closes in on the person responsible for his parents' deaths.

episodes.name: All Happy Families Are Alike
episodes.summary: The mob war that Oswald has engineered between Falcone and Maroni comes to a startling conclusion when Fish returns from the dead. Meanwhile, Bruce finds his father's secret, and Barbara and Leslie have a heart-to-heart chat.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Damned If You Do
episodes.summary: While Bruce continues to try and penetrate his father's vault, Loeb fires Jim from the force... and Jim takes extreme measures to get reinstated. Meanwhile, Barbara settles in to life at Arkham Asylum and makes several new friends.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Knock Knock
episodes.summary: Theo sends his team of Maniax out on a new assignment, but it's only the prelude to something much larger and bloodier. Meanwhile, Alfred tries to protect Bruce, and turns to Lucius Fox for help.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: The Last Laugh
episodes.summary: Jim is reluctant to turn to Oswald for help, so Harvey pays the new crime boss a visit. Meanwhile, Jerome poses as a magician to infiltrate a children's hospital benefit, but discovers that Theo has other plans in store for him.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Strike Force
episodes.summary: The GCPD gets a new captain and he immediately cleans house and brings on Jim as his second-in-command... unaware of Jim's background with the Penguin. Meanwhile, Theo asks the Penguin for a favor, and Bruce and Theo have lunch.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Scarification
episodes.summary: Theo forces Oswald to hire the Pike Brothers to torch select buildings in Gotham, and the Pikes use their sister Bridgit. Meanwhile, Theo asks Jim for his endorsement, Oswald orders Butch to lend a hand, and Leslie invites Edward and Kristen over for fondue.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: By Fire
episodes.summary: Jim promises Selina to keep the new Firefly safe, but discovers that the girl doesn't want to turn herself in. Meanwhile, Theo and Silver invite Bruce to dinner, Edward tells Kirsten the truth, and Butch finds out where Gertrude is imprisoned.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Mommy's Little Monster
episodes.summary: Jim begins to realize that Theo has orchestrated everything to become mayor. Meanwhile, Oswald swears revenge on the man who killed his mother, and Edward tries to cover up Kristen's death but faces an opponent that knows his every move.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Tonight's the Night
episodes.summary: While Theo tries to convince Bruce to sign over Wayne Enterprises to him, he sends Barbara as a distraction to keep Jim occupied. Meanwhile, Edward has one last picnic lunch with Kirsten before disposing of her body, and ends up meeting a familiar figure.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
episodes.summary: While Jim and Barnes takes on hit men sent to kill Jim, Edward convinces Oswald that he has something to live for in Gotham. Meanwhile, Alfred forbids Bruce from seeing Silver again, even though she may hold the key to finding out whose his parents' killer was.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: The Son of Gotham
episodes.summary: While Jim and Harvey try to track down the elusive monks performing blood sacrifices, Bruce proposes a new deal with Silver to find out the name of his parents' killers. Meanwhile, Edward gets used to having a roommate.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Worse Than a Crime
episodes.summary: Jim discovers that the Order of Dumas is prepared to sacrifice Bruce at midnight, and turns to Oswald for help. Meanwhile, Leslie gives Jim startling news, Tabitha comes to a decision about her brother, and a new vigilante stalks the streets of Gotham.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Mr. Freeze
episodes.summary: A new killer stalks the streets of Gotham, freezing victims with liquid helium for his experiments in cyrogenic reanimation. Meanwhile, Jim goes before the board for his actions in taking down Theo, and a captured Oswald is sentenced to Arkham.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: A Dead Man Feels No Cold
episodes.summary: The GCPD take Nora to Arkham when her condition worsens, and Victor breaks into the asylum in his new guise as Mr. Freeze. Meanwhile, Oswald undergoes extreme treatment at Hugo's hands, and Alfred finds the mysterious M. Malone that killed Bruce's parents.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: This Ball of Mud and Meanness
episodes.summary: While Hugo continues Oswald's treatment at Arkham, Bruce goes on a hunt for his parents' killer.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Mad Grey Dawn
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey try to track down a bomber who leaves riddles to his crimes. Meanwhile, Oswald pays old friends a visit and is reunited with the father and family that he never knew.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Prisoners
episodes.summary: While Jim adjusts to life in prison, Harvey makes plans to break his friend out. Meanwhile, Oswald adjusts to family life but discovers that his new relatives have other plans.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Into the Woods
episodes.summary: Jim discovers who framed him, but it may cost him his life. Meanwhile, Alfred gives Bruce an ultimatum, and Hugo releases Barbara from Arkham.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Pinewood
episodes.summary: Bruce decrypts some of his father's computer files and learns of the mysterious Pinewood Project. While he and Alfred investigate, Barbara offers to help Jim find the mysterious Philosopher.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Azrael
episodes.summary: Hugo figures out the key to controlling the resurrected Theo and sends him forth as... Azrael. Meanwhile, Jim tries to convince Barnes that Hugo is responsible for creating monsters, and Bruce begins to learn that the law is insufficient to deal with the threats to Gotham.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Unleashed
episodes.summary: Bruce convinces Selina to break into Arkham and rescue her friend Bridgit, and along the way Selina encounters an escaping Edward. Meanwhile, the manhunt for Azrael continues and Tabitha agrees to help Jim and Harvey track her brother down.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: A Legion of Horribles
episodes.summary: Bruce, Jim, and Lucius sneak into Arkham to try and find Selena, but Hugo realizes what they're up to and captures them. Meanwhile, Selena offers herself as a servant to Firefly, and Alfred turns to Harvey for help.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Transference
episodes.summary: Hugo is ordered to destroy Arkham to cover the council's tracks, but Fish's efforts to escape complicate things. Meanwhile, Basil distracts Harvey from investigating Arkham, and Bruce and Lucius fail Edward's quiz.

episodes.name: Mad City: Better to Reign in Hell...
episodes.summary: Six months after the Indian Hill escape, Jim is working as a bounty hunter in Gotham. He teams up with reporter Valerie Vale to track down Fish and her new gang of escapees... all of whom have superpowers. Meanwhile, Bruce and Alfred return from Switzerland to confront the Wayne Enterprises board, and Selina falls in with the wrong crowd.

episodes.name: Mad City: Burn the Witch
episodes.summary: Fish takes control of Harvey and tracks down Hugo, demanding a cure to her condition. Meanwhile, Oswald rallies the citizens against the "monsters" in their midst, and Jim and Barnes are forced to ally to save Harvey.

episodes.name: Mad City: Look Into My Eyes
episodes.summary: Hypnotist Jervis Tetch comes to Gotham looking for his sister Alice, and hires Jim to find her. However, Jervis has some secrets of his own that he doesn't want anyone to find out. Meanwhile, Oswald announces his candidacy for mayor while Jim meets Lee's fiance.

episodes.name: Mad City: New Day Rising
episodes.summary: Bruce and Alfred look for the missing Five, and the trail leads to Selina. Meanwhile, Jervis goes to extreme lengths to recover his sister Alice, and Edward takes extreme steps to convince Oswald how popular he is.

episodes.name: Mad City: Anything for You
episodes.summary: Bruce asks Jim to help find Ivy, while Oswald finds his mayorship threatened when the Red Hood Gang launch a new series of attacks.

episodes.name: Mad City: Follow the White Rabbit
episodes.summary: Jervis forces Jim to choose between the two women that he loves, leading Jim through a maze of tests to determine if he can pick who will live and who will die.

episodes.name: Mad City: Red Queen
episodes.summary: Jervis doses Jim with a powerful hallucinogenic that will burn out his brain, and forces Jim to face some hard truths. Meanwhile, Oswald tries to break up Edward and Isabella, and Bruce has Selina over for dinner.

episodes.name: Mad City: Blood Rush
episodes.summary: The virus begins to consume Barnes, bringing out his inner rage at the guilty. Meanwhile, Jim's first case after he rejoins the GCPD involves him trying to find a killer... unaware that his captain is responsible. And Isabella puts Edward's sanity to the test, unaware that Oswald has his own plans.

episodes.name: Mad City: The Executioner
episodes.summary: Barnes attempts to recruit Jim to his new crusade. Meanwhile, Edward realizes that someone murdered Isabella and confronts Oswald with what he's learned. On the streets, Ivy turns to Selina and Bruce for help after she steals a necklace.

episodes.name: Mad City: Time Bomb
episodes.summary: Someone tries to kill Carmine, but Jim suspects that there's more going on. Meanwhile, Edward goes after the man he believes killed Isabella, and Bruce makes a deal with a faction opposed to the Court of Owls.

episodes.name: Mad City: Beware the Green-Eyed Monster
episodes.summary: Barbara forges a fragile alliance to gain control of the Gotham underworld.. Meanwhile, Jim suspects that Mario is infected with the Tetch virus and tries to stop his marriage to Lee before it's too late.And Bruce, Selina, and Alfred break into the Court of Owls' building to acquire the weapon they need to destroy the organization.

episodes.name: Mad City: Ghosts
episodes.summary: Carmine orders a hit on Jim after Jim is forced to kill Mario. Meanwhile, a follower plans the resurrection of one of Gotham's greatest criminals, and Oswald's facade starts to slip after he sees his father's ghost.

episodes.name: Mad City: Smile Like You Mean It
episodes.summary: When he's unable to resurrect Jerome, Dwight cuts off his face and tries to lead the cult. Meanwhile, Lee reveals a darker side, while Barbara and Tabitha continue to undermine Oswald while following Edward's plan.

episodes.name: Mad City: The Gentle Art of Making Enemies
episodes.summary: Jerome and his acolytes run wild across a darkened Gotham, and Jerome abducts Bruce. Meanwhile, Oswald confronts Edward and the Court begins its move to take control of the city.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: How the Riddler Got His Name
episodes.summary: Edward goes on a killing spree to discover who he is without Oswald. Meanwhile, Frank tells Jim about the Court of Owls, and Bruce tries to reconnect with Selina.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: These Delicate and Dark Obsessions
episodes.summary: Jim discovers who ordered his father killed. Meanwhile, Oswald learns the loyalty of his minions, and a Shaman tries to help Bruce overcome the pain of his parents' deaths.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: The Primal Riddle
episodes.summary: Oswald gathers the first two members of his army of freaks. meanwhile, Edward sets out to solve the riddle of the Court, and Bruce-2 warns Selina about the city's coming demise.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Light the Wick
episodes.summary: The Court puts Hugo to work weaponizing the Tetch virus. Meanwhile, Jim tries to learn what the Court plans for Gotham, and the Shaman offers Bruce a release from his emotional pain.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: All Will Be Judged
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey discover that Kathryn isn't the Court's leader. Meanwhile, Alfred learns that Bruce isn't who he believed him to be, and Lee realizes who is truly responsible for Mario's death.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Pretty Hate Machine
episodes.summary: Edward puts pressure on Selina to find out where Oswald is hiding. Meanwhile, Jim confronts the infected Lee, who sets him up so that he must make a terrible choice if he wants to save the citizens of Gotham from the Tetch virus.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Destiny Calling
episodes.summary: Gotham descends into chaos after the spread of the virus. Jim fights for control as he and Harvey try to locate Lee. Meanwhile, Barbara convinces Edward to help her take control of Gotham by obtaining the antidote, only to find Fish and Oswald opposing her.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Heavydirtysoul
episodes.summary: Bruce kills Alfred and Ra's promises that they will meet again. Meanwhile, Jim and Harvey make a desperate trade with Edward to get what they need for the antidote, and Butch and Tabitha turn against Barbara.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Pax Penguina
episodes.summary: Oswald controls Gotham by handing out licenses to criminals and lowering the crime rate. Meanwhile, Bruce continues his field training by preying on criminals, and Harvey tells Jim in no uncertain terms to let the licensed criminals go free. And a new gang tries to undermine Oswald by breaking Jonathan Crane out of Arkham and using his father's fear gas formula.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Fear Reaper
episodes.summary: Bruce's efforts in fighting crime prove less than successful until Lucius steps in. Meanwhile, Jonathan Crane goes on a rampage through Arkham as the Scarecrow, and Jim goes in alone to stop him. Elsewhere, Tabitha and Selina receive an invitation to join a new criminal enterprise.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: They Who Hide Behind Masks
episodes.summary: Jim acquires an unexpected ally when he travels to Miami to get Carmine to help him against Oswald. Meanwhile, Oswald ships an antique knife into the city and several interested parties seek to obtain it.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Demon's Head
episodes.summary: Bruce goes to a museum curator for information on the knife, but the man is soon killed and his grandson goes on the run. Meanwhile, Edward tries to come up with a riddle worthy of his nemesis, but things don't go as planned.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Blade's Path
episodes.summary: After six months in a coma, Butch is exposed to Indian Hills chemicals and transformed into a man-monster. Meanwhile, Bruce seeks out Ra's, and Sofia tries to make amends with Oswald.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Hog Day Afternoon
episodes.summary: A serial killer goes after crooked cops, putting pig masks on their corpses. Jim and Harvey hunt him down once they realize who his targets are. Meanwhile, Oswald suspects that Sofia is preparing to betray him, and Edward asks Lee for help.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: A Day in the Narrows
episodes.summary: The hunt continues for Pyg, who abducts three cops. Meanwhile, Bruce receives an invitation from a former classmate, and Selina sets out to prove she and Tabitha can still serve a role in Barbara's organization.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Stop Hitting Yourself
episodes.summary: When Oswald learns that Edward is mocking him on stage at Cherry's, he tells the Sirens to bring Edward to him. However, Grundy protects Edward until Tabitha reminds him of who he was. Meanwhile, Jim receives an offer from the mayor and has to consider whether to go against Harvey or not... and what it will cost him.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Let Them Eat Pie
episodes.summary: Professor Pyg continues to torment Gotham city, involving Jim Gordon whenever possible. Sofia and Penguin get ready for a fundraiser for the orphanage, and things don't go as planned when Professor Pyg shows up as the chef. Meanwhile, Bruce's partying gets in the way of his relationship with Alfred.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Things That Go Boom
episodes.summary: After learning that Jim and Sofia are involved, Oswald prepares to torture Sofia for information about her plans. Meanwhile, Lee and Edward pay a visit to a gangster trying to move in on the Narrows.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Queen Takes Knight
episodes.summary: Jim tries to stop the war between Oswald and Sofia, and discovers that the only way to do so is to take Sofia's side. Meanwhile, Tabitha attempts to beat Grundy's memories of Butch back into Grundy's head, and Alfred and Bruce come to blows.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Pieces of a Broken Mirror
episodes.summary: A new killer, the Toy Maker, strikes at Lee's Narrows meeting. While Jim tries to determine the killer's next target and who hired him, Selina meets two old friends. Meanwhile, Alfred makes a new friend while wandering the Narrows.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: A Beautiful Darkness
episodes.summary: Ivy learns of a secret project at WayneTech that will let her avenge the murdered plants of Gotham, and gives Bruce a dose of her hallucinogenic poison. While Bruce sees his real self, jim tries to track down Ivy. At Arkham, Jerome tries to convince Oswald to cheer up.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Reunion
episodes.summary: Ivy prepares to take revenge for the plants and for herself, and her first target is Harvey. While Selina prepares to confront her former friend, Bruce asks Alfred to help him while Edward comes up with a way to destroy Riddler once and for all.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Sinking Ship the Grand Applause
episodes.summary: Jim and Harvey try to track down Oswald, who has information on the man who can provide them with evidence to tie Sofia to Pyg. Meanwhile, Riddler and Oswald turn to Lee and Grundy for help, and Selina asks Bruce for help returning some stolen jewelry.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: One of My Three Soups
episodes.summary: Jerome escapes from Arkham with Mad Hatter and Scarecrow, and goes after his uncle while Jarvis commands thousands to kill themselves at midnight. Meanwhile, Bruce searches for Jerome and the League of Shadows confront Barbara.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Mandatory Brunch Meeting
episodes.summary: While Jim and Harvey chase after Jerome and try to find his target, Lee challenges Riddler to a duel of riddles. Meanwhile, Oswald tracks down Butch and offers him a cure to his monstrous condition.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: That's Entertainment
episodes.summary: Jerome plans his revenge against Gotham, and lies further plans in case of his death. Meanwhile, Barbara and Tabitha come to a parting of the ways, and Alfred helps Bruce celebrate his birthday.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: To Our Deaths and Beyond
episodes.summary: The League uses Bruce's blood to bring Ra's back to life. Meanwhile, Oswald advises Riddler to turn against Lee, who is giving the money from the bank robberies to the people of the Narrows.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: That Old Corpse
episodes.summary: Jerome sends his followers a message from beyond the grave, and they hold a wake in the GCPD. Meanwhile, Jeremiah shows Bruce his new "clean" generator, and Butch grows impatient with Oswald's failure to find him a cure for his condition.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: One Bad Day
episodes.summary: Jeremiah carries out his plan to destroy Gotham, while Lee and Riddler find Jim and tend to his injuries. Meanwhile, Oswald senses an opportunity and convinces Barbara and Tabitha to help him.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: No Man's Land
episodes.summary: Ra's and Jeremiah join forces to destroy Gotham and recreate Bruce. Meanwhile, Jim faces off with the military when the mayor orders Gotham's evacuation, and Strange finds a cure for Butch.

episodes.name: Year Zero
episodes.summary: Two months after Gotham is cut off from the outside world, Jim and his men are trying to hold the precinct house; Oswald has secured City Hall; Barbara and Tabitha have opened up the Sirens' Club to women; Riddler is dealing with a split personality; and Selina undergoes an operation to save her life but will be paralyzed for life.

episodes.name: Trespassers
episodes.summary: Riddler deals with a prisoner that he doesn't remember capturing, and Barbara offers Jim unexpected help. While Jim and Harvey rescue kids being held by the Soothsayers, Bruce tries to find a cure for Selina.

episodes.name: Penguin, Our Hero
episodes.summary: While Selina and Bruce set out to find Jeremiah, Oswald gathers the gangs in an attack on Haven to get his people back.

episodes.name: Ruin
episodes.summary: Oswald offers Jim his help to bring in the person responsible for bombing Haven. Meanwhile, Lucius teams up with an unlikely partner to find out how the crime was committed, and Selina finds Jeremiah.

episodes.name: Pena Dura
episodes.summary: Secretary Walker sends Eduardo Durrance and his men in to help Jim clean up Gotham. Edward looks for the person who controlled him into bombing Haven, and turns to Oswald to find the person responsible.

episodes.name: 13 Stitches
episodes.summary: Eduardo continues his search for Jim, who finds new allies and tries to get word out about Eduardo's and Walker's bombing of Haven. Oswald gets a new partner, and Lee makes a surprising reappearance.

episodes.name: Ace Chemicals
episodes.summary: Jeremiah lures Bruce to Wayne Manor to bond the two of them together in life... and death. Jim and Lee go looking for a criminal gang connected to a recent series of chemical deaths.

episodes.name: Nothing's Shocking
episodes.summary: Two former detectives are murdered in Sirens, and the clues lead to Harvey's old partner Dix... and Harvey himself. Edward and Oswald meet a new rival, and Barbara seeks assurances from Jim that she won't go to prison when the government arrives.

episodes.name: The Trial of Jim Gordon
episodes.summary: Jim is shoot while trying to negotiate a cease-fire with Gotham's gangs, and Harvey soon learns who is responsible. Bruce goes on a date with Selina, and Alfred gives Lee some advice on parenthood.

episodes.name: I Am Bane
episodes.summary: The mutated Eduardo--Bane--kidnaps Bruce, Jim, and the general in charge of assessing Gotham's suitability for reunification, and his employer Walker reveals who she really is. Barbara turns to Lee for help when she goes into labor, and Edward and Oswald come looking for their "partner".

episodes.name: They Did What?
episodes.summary: Jim and the others make their final stand against the invading army under the command of Bane. Nyssa holds Barbara and her baby captive, and Edward and Oswald consider whether to defend Gotham or leave it to its fate.

episodes.name: The Beginning...
episodes.summary: Ten years in the future, Gotham is preparing for the reopening of Wayne Tower and the return of Bruce Wayne to the city. However, four cases of C-4 go missing, Edward escapes from Arkham, Oswald is released from Blackgate, and Jim considers retiring as police commissioner. Will someone step up to be the savior that Gotham needs?

shows.title: Lost Girl
shows.summary:
Lost Girl follows supernatural seductress Bo, a Succubus who feeds on the sexual energy of humans. Growing up with human parents, Bo had no reason to believe she was anything other than the girl next door — until she drained her boyfriend to death in their first sexual encounter. Now she has hit the road alone and afraid.
She discovers she is one of the Fae, creatures of legend and folklore, who pass as humans while feeding off them secretly and in different ways, as they have for millennia. Relieved yet horrified to find out that she is not alone, Bo decides to take the middle path between the humans and the Fae while embarking on a personal mission to unlock the secrets of her origin.

With the help of her human sidekick, Kenzi, and Dyson, a sexy police detective, Bo takes on a challenge every week helping a Fae or human client who comes to her to solve a mystery, or to right a wrong.

episodes.name: It's a Fae, Fae, Fae, Fae World
episodes.summary: In the series opener, Bo's impulsive decision to protect a young woman in jeopardy (Kenzi) has unexpected consequences: the two become fast friends, while Bo is swept up into the secret world of the Fae, learning for the first time about these ancient people and the birthright she never knew existed.

episodes.name: Where There's a Will, There's a Fae
episodes.summary: Fresh from the realization that she is a member of the Fae, Bo is approached by a strange client, Will, a real life Will O' the Wisp. The storehouse of jewels he's collected over the centuries has been stolen...by a human! While this line of work is foreign to Bo, Will offers her an irresistible payment - information about where she might have come from. As Bo gets involved in the recovery of Will's gems, she finds the shocking truth about the thief... and the weird and deadly forces that seem to also be on the trail of the jewels.

episodes.name: Oh Kappa, My Kappa
episodes.summary:
When a missing coed's mother comes begging for help, Bo and Kenzi go undercover on the local college campus to find her. Using all of Bo's unique talents and Kenzi's con artist skills, the women dig into the mysterious underbelly of the school's sorority system and find a surprising Fae connection, while racing to save the kidnapped young coed.

On the personal side, Bo and Dyson enjoy the afterglow of their first sexual encounter, both wondering where it's leading them... until Trick's stern objections and Kenzi's excited pressuring threatens to put a rift between Bo and Dyson before they're even a couple.

episodes.name: Faetal Attraction
episodes.summary:
When a Fury with an unfaithful spouse tries to hire Bo to kill her husband's mistress, Bo instead takes the side of the unsuspecting human woman and puts her under protection. Things quickly spin out of control, however, after the husband ends up brutally murdered, leaving Bo scrambling to contain a mess of jealousy and violence and unravel the mystery of the real killer – as Kenzi nearly becomes the next victim.

Dyson has to submit to therapy at the cop shop when his romantic frustration over Bo causes anger issues, leading him and Bo to patch things up.

episodes.name: Dead Lucky
episodes.summary:
Bo is coerced into solving how a human scammed Mayer, a Dark Fae bookie. Things get creepy when she discovers the con artist behind it all is a Hsien, a Fae that can inhabit dead human corpses.

Kenzi's determination to prove she's more than just the human "sidekick" leads her to do a little investigating on her own, which lands her in some serious hot water – and eventually, locked in the trunk of a car headed to a bad fate unless she can be rescued by Dyson.

episodes.name: Food for Thought
episodes.summary:
While tagging after Lauren and Bo in the Fae world, Kenzi becomes deathly ill (and incredibly grossed-out) when she inadvertently eats some toxic human soup at the home of an Aswang - sending Bo and Lauren on a daring undercover mission in search of a cure, at a powerful pharmaceutical company.

As Bo and Lauren race to save Kenzi, they are each forced to face their varying control issues – with surprising results – underscoring their growing attraction and the beginning of a possible relationship.

episodes.name: ArachnoFaebia
episodes.summary: When con artist Kenzi runs a "Shaman" scam, and does a spiritual cleanse of a human house where a bloody murder-suicide took place, she inadvertently brings home a vicious Fae spider whose venom turns people psychotic. After getting bitten by this nasty eight legger, both Bo and Kenzi's paranoia mounts – and the best friends begin to turn on each other in this haunted house homage, forcing romantic rivals Dyson and Lauren to put their differences aside and work together to find a way to kill the nasty arachnid... before Bo and Kenzi kill each other.

episodes.name: Vexed
episodes.summary: Bo's freelance work earns her a lead on someone who might know something about her mother... but the trail ends at Lou Ann, a death row inmate who claims not to know anything about Bo. Desperate to prove otherwise, and increasingly convinced Lou Ann is innocent; Bo uses all her political wiles to try and bust her out of jail. When she has to admit defeat, Bo's goal switches to one of personal vengeance: to find Vex, the Fae that framed Lou Ann, and make him pay.

episodes.name: Fae Day
episodes.summary:
A fun-filled Fae "high holiday" turns potentially deadly when a Banshee wail predicts the death of someone in Trick's bar to occur within the next 12 hours. After a scramble that puts Bo and Dyson on the Banshee's trail, the two learn the name of the Light Fae (Sean) who's marked for death – and his last wish is for them to help him reconcile with his Dark Fae brother. Bo has to heal the rift between the two brothers at great risk to herself, while trying to unravel and prevent the mysterious death omen hanging over Sean.

Amidst helping adorable Sean write a bucket list and make the best of his last day on earth, Kenzi unexpectedly develops feelings for him... and is unwilling to give him up without a fight.

episodes.name: The Mourning After
episodes.summary:
While investigating a baffling sex-related murder case, Bo comes into contact with Saskia, a strong, sensuous Succubus who has much to teach her. The two become fast friends, but as they work together to solve the case Saskia reveals her true dark Fae colours, which tests the limits of this newfound friendship... and Bo's own inner bad girl.

Kenzi – feeling a bit left out due to Bo's new gal pal – joins forces with Trick in a race against time to save The Dal Riata.

episodes.name: Faetal Justice
episodes.summary: When Dyson wakes up bloody and without the last eight hours of memory, he finds himself accused of murdering Ba'al, a close associate of The Morrigan's pet psychopath, Vex, and takes refuge in Trick's bar, invoking sanctuary. It's up to Bo and Kenzi to recreate Dyson's lost hours and to find the real killer before the forces of the Fae, both light and dark, join forces to take Dyson's head. If Trick tries to prevent it, there may be more blood spilled... and an all-out war amongst the Fae might ensue. In the end, Bo and Kenzi fight to find the truth amid a morass of old hostilities and twisted loves... and get the proof to Dyson in time to save his life.

episodes.name: (Dis)Members Only
episodes.summary: Bo and Dyson go undercover as a married power couple at a swank country club to help an old friend from Kenzi's criminal past. At first they enjoy their taste of the good life – and the chance to play house. But soon the emotional pressure of the charade, and the increasing body count, push Dyson and Bo to a new level in their relationship...and prompts Dyson to give Trick an ultimatum. It's time for them to tell Bo all they know about her origins once and for all. But before Dyson has a chance to come clean to Bo, an unexpected arrival drops by and tries to silence him for good.

episodes.name: Bloodlines
episodes.summary: Bo has finally learned the truth about her mother – and that those closest to her have been keeping secrets about her past. Reeling, no longer sure who to trust, Bo decides to track down "Mommy Dearest" alone, in order to extract the truth about her own origins once and for all. While everyone frantically searches for Bo, Dyson visits an ancient Norn, a wish-granting, tree-dwelling crone, where – in order to protect the woman he loves - he makes a sacrifice that may irrevocably change his relationship with Bo forever. All these paths converge in a final face-off between mother and daughter that forces Bo to choose who will be saved…and who will not.

episodes.name: Something Wicked This Fae Comes
episodes.summary: In the season opener, a nomadic Fae sideshow comes to town looking to take advantage of the chaos that the bombing of the Light Fae headquarters has wrought. Unbeknownst to the general Light Fae populace, The Ash is in a coma, and his bond with the land is weakening – which makes this the perfect time for the travelling circus freaks to steal the most precious thing the Light Fae possess.

episodes.name: I Fought the Fae (and the Fae Won)
episodes.summary: The hunt for The new Ash is on. Literally. A traditional Stag Hunt is held, whereby the candidate who successfully tracks and kills The Stag becomes The next Ash. Bo barely takes a passing interest in this ceremony until a surprise visitor with a vested interest in the hunt appears in her front room.

episodes.name: Scream a Little Dream
episodes.summary:
As Bo struggles to accept the new terms of her and Dyson's relationship, she investigates an apartment building full of residents who appear to have lost their minds.

Kenzi's choice to employ a Brownie to help around the house threatens to backfire on her.

episodes.name: Mirror, Mirror
episodes.summary: In a move of sisterly solidarity, Kenzi drunkenly invokes the Russian hag Baba Yaga to curse Dyson for his behaviour towards Bo. In the sober light of day, however, Kenzi and Bo seek to remove the curse.

episodes.name: BrotherFae of the Wolves
episodes.summary: Bo and Dyson team up to track down a stolen Mongolian Death Worm on behalf of Dyson's old wolf pack mate. When things get complicated, Dyson finds himself reliving his medieval days – tormented by the hard choices he once had to make, and fighting in the present not to repeat past mistakes. Fearing The Ash's reputed crackdown on humans, Lauren hides out at the clubhouse.

episodes.name: It's Better to Burn Out Than Fae Away
episodes.summary: The Morrigan enlists Bo's help to find a tortured graffiti artist under her employ. The young painter has killed a Dark Fae, and his urban murals are exposing Fae secrets all over town – with The Morrigan on the hook for his actions. In exchange for her help with the case, The Morrigan offers Bo information on breaking The Ash's hold on the Lauren.

episodes.name: Fae Gone Wild
episodes.summary:
Bo is happy for the distraction provided by an assembly of strippers that helps break an accused cop-killer out of the police station. While Bo goes undercover at a strip joint to follow the trail of one of the apparent accomplices, Dyson and Hale simultaneously track the murderer. Both investigations meet in the middle at The Hand of Glory – a disembodied hand with remarkable powers.

Coming off The Morrigan's shocking revelation about Lauren, Bo and the doctor have a difficult conversation.

episodes.name: Death Didn't Become Him
episodes.summary: Trick's dear friend seeks his assistance when his ballet dancer husband goes missing – or rather, his ballet dancer husband's corpse. Bo and Dyson track the dead ballet dancer to a bizarre figure, enlisting Lauren for her scientific expertise along the way.

episodes.name: Original Skin
episodes.summary: A night out at the Dal goes awry when an insane trickster spikes the beerwith a substance that transfers Bo out of her body – resulting in a ripple effect that finds our regulars inhabiting the skin of their friends, lovers and rivals. Suppressed – and not so suppressed – feelings bubble to the surface, and the brief stays in one another's bodies gives each surprising insights into the other.

episodes.name: Raging Fae
episodes.summary: Bo joins the brutal world of underground fighting to help a human competitor juiced up on Fae "steroids" that are sending him on blackout rages – and putting his son in harm's way. Meanwhile, the sister of the first boy she ever killed shows up and confronts Bo over her deadly past.

episodes.name: Can't See the Fae-rest
episodes.summary: When rich young humans start turning up dead, Bo agrees to go undercover to help Dyson find the Fae responsible. As she makes her way through the "Gossip Girl" world, Bo learns a deadly kind of class warfare is afoot.

episodes.name: Masks
episodes.summary: Bo enlists Dyson's help to find an artifact she believes will release Lauren from her life of servitude to the Fae -- even though it might mean having to say goodbye to the good doctor herself.

episodes.name: Barometz. Trick. Pressure
episodes.summary: When Trick takes matters into his own hands to foresee the future, he runs the risk of revealing too much to the wrong Fae. Meanwhile, a furious Bo confronts The Ash about a betrayal… and is stunned by his response.

episodes.name: Midnight Lamp
episodes.summary: While Bo continues to ponder The Ash's shocking proposal, she agrees to his interim request – to kidnap a Genie. The assignment becomes complicated and dangerous, and Bo finds herself involved with the most unlikely partner.

episodes.name: Table for Fae
episodes.summary: What Bo uncovers while investigating the mysterious disappearance of human backpackers threatens her own fine physique. Meanwhile, the new man in Bo's life sets events in motion that force Kenzi to make a desperate choice.

episodes.name: School's Out
episodes.summary: Bo goes undercover as a high school teacher to investigate a mysterious case-Kenzi soon regrets agreeing to help her. Lauren makes a much anticipated return home from vacation.

episodes.name: The Girl Who Fae'd with Fire
episodes.summary: Things heat up when Bo tangles with Fae politics in an attempt to save some very important people. Meanwhile, Kenzi risks more than she intended when she does a favour for Hale.

episodes.name: Fae-nted Love
episodes.summary: Kenzi and Trick must race to save Bo from the fallout of a steamy night gone awry before it binds the Succubus for a millennium. In its wake, Bo poses very uncomfortable questions to Trick about her origins.

episodes.name: Truth and Consequences
episodes.summary: Bo confronts a very powerful Fae, uncertain whether she can trust The Ash's counsel. The coming War takes its first casualties – literally and figuratively – which challenges Bo's and Kenzi's commitments to the cause and the ones they love.

episodes.name: Lachlan's Gambit
