episodes.summary: Hank is told he faces 3 years in prison because the DA wants to make an example of him. There are signs Marcy is pregnant. Hank tries to fix things with Becca. The episode ends as Hank, high on drugs and liquor, writes a letter to Becca and then passes out.

episodes.name: Home Sweet Home
episodes.summary: Hank takes advantage of the misperception that he tried to commit suicide and moves back home with Karen and Becca, but his daughter knows the truth; Charlie sets out to reach a sexual benchmark while a wealthy producer pursues Marcy.

episodes.name: Monkey Business
episodes.summary: Hank Moody is notified by his attorney Abby that he will be going to trial for statutory rape. But not before Hank hands the completed F&P script to Charlie, who promptly drags him to a meeting with the Director, producer Stu Beggs and eccentric financier Zig Samitaur, setting off a chain of events that leads to Hank and Charlie having to explain why there's a dead billionaire in the bathroom.

episodes.name: Freeze-Frame
episodes.summary: After a personal grooming mishap, Charlie discovers that his vasectomy was botched and that Marcy's baby could be his; Hank's relationship with lawyer Abby gets more personal but a good deed yields a compromising photo that could ruin Hank's life.

episodes.name: Lawyers, Guns and Money
episodes.summary: A sensational photo derails Hank's case and threatens to destroy his movie project until his sincere love for Becca rescues his career, while Karen resuscitates her ex-husband's relationship with his beautiful lawyer.

episodes.name: The Recused
episodes.summary: Forced by her relationship with Hank to recuse herself as his lawyer, Abby pitches the case to a senior partner on the golf course; Hank is dismayed by Karen's growing relationship with artist Ben; Marcy and Stu ask Charlie to help them pitch a TV project.

episodes.name: Lights, Camera, Asshole
episodes.summary: Hank takes a gig rewriting dialogue on a zombie sequel but threatens his job when he hooks up with a sexy woman with close ties to the film's female lead; Marcy tells Stu she's pregnant but not that the baby may be Charlie's.

episodes.name: Another Perfect Day
episodes.summary: Evicted from his apartment, Hank moves back in with Karen and Becca while he prepares for his trial and teaches his daughter to drive; while Karen is out on a date with Ben, Becca and Pearl steal the Porsche and wreck it.

episodes.name: The Trial
episodes.summary: A nervous Hank discovers that he's got good reason to panic when his trial turns into an all out character assassination, with even friendly witnesses Charlie and Karen unable to portray him as anything other than a drunken, oversexed lout.

episodes.name: The Last Supper
episodes.summary: Found guilty of statutory rape, Hank buys a used Porsche and considers fleeing from Los Angeles, but instead enjoys one last night in the company of his friends and family.

episodes.name: ...And Justice for All
episodes.summary: As Hank awaits sentencing, the lines between his real life and the movie based on his life blur as the film's star hits on his ex-wife and he feels stirrings of passion for the actress hired to play Karen.

episodes.name: JFK --> LAX
episodes.summary: A few years have passed and Hank is living in New York but looking for a ticket out of town after his latest breakup. He accepts an invitation from Charlie to come to Los Angeles for a job writing a film starring rapper/actor Samurai Apocalypse, then reunites with Karen, her former professor and now husband Richard, and his daughter Becca, who now has a boyfriend named Tyler that is the spitting image of Hank himself ... in the worst possible way.

episodes.name: The Way of the Fist
episodes.summary: Hank passes on writing Samurai Apocalypse's new movie but Sam won't take no for an answer and drags Hank to a meeting with director Peter Berg, where they discover that Hank and Peter have shared more than just a love of the written word. Sam takes it on himself to get rid of Tyler, which makes things worse between Hank and Becca. Co-parents Charlie, Marcy and Stu have their hands full when Little Stuart exposes himself to a preschool classmate, and Charlie takes it upon himself to mend fences with the offended girl's attractive mother.

episodes.name: Boys & Girls
episodes.summary: Hank hands a completed draft of "Santa Monica Cop" over to Samurai Apocalypse, but he still finds himself stuck in L.A. when he's asked to take Kali, his "acquaintance" from the flight to Los Angeles, out for a night on the town. Tyler crashes at Karen and Becca's house while he recovers from his injuries. Charlie is rescued from a serious parental crisis by Stuart's nanny, Lizzie.

episodes.name: Waiting for the Miracle
episodes.summary: Hank receives an unwelcome surprise in the form of Carrie, ex-girlfriend and arsonist that he's forced to invite along when Karen and Becca show up to invite him to a dinner party. Stu, Marcy and Bates' talk of sexual proclivities leaves the Moodys searching for the nearest exit, but the party gets even more out of control when Carrie has a realization about Hank. Meanwhile, Charlie goes on a blind date with Mary, a "nice girl" who's more than a little inexperienced.

episodes.name: The Ride-Along
episodes.summary: Charlie's boyhood dream is realized and Hank's worst nightmare comes true when Samurai Apocalypse invites the boys on a ride along with the Santa Monica Police Department and takes them on a joyride that goes sexually awry for Charlie; Richard hits the bottle at a crowded Venice restaurant but Hank and the boys arrive to save the day for Karen and Becca, and Tyler realizes he's seen Sam somewhere before.

episodes.name: Love Song
episodes.summary: When Samurai Apocalypse hits a lyrical roadblock with his protege, he calls on the best writer he knows: Hank Moody, who unites with Kali to imbibe, bare his soul, and write a song that takes Hank back in time to an era when he, Karen and Charlie were happier and life was simpler before "A Crazy Little Thing Called Love." But the present comes roaring back when Karen shows up at Hank's door, worried that she made a mistake.

episodes.name: Here I Go Again
episodes.summary: Hank saves Karen from embarrassment with a drunk Richard, then covers for Richard by pretending to be dating a stripper named Holly, who takes a liking to Tyler and offends his girlfriend, Becca. Meanwhile, when she's fired after an inappropriate encounter with Stu, nanny Lizzie calls on Charlie and allows their relationship to progress, only to have Marcy beg for her return.

episodes.name: Raw
episodes.summary: Hank is stuck reading Tyler's screenplay but discovers some talent under that head of hair, even though the script appears to be disturbingly autobiographical account of the author's relationship with Becca. Charlie and Lizzie's love quadrangle with Stu and Marcy heats up, but when their bedroom games hit too close to home for Charlie, it may be off to therapy for all four of them.

episodes.name: At the Movies
episodes.summary: On the first day of production on Hank Moody's latest movie "Santa Monica Cop," Stu has brought back his "F--king and Punching" director in hopes of creating a cinematic masterpiece, but Hank's rendezvous with the film's leading lady puts his relationship with Sam in jeopardy. Luckily for Hank, Stu and the production's crew, Charlie has a backup plan.

episodes.name: Perverts & Whores
episodes.summary: Minus one agent and best friend, Hank crashes with his two favorite ladies, Karen and Becca. Looking for new representation, he meets with Hollywood power agent Larry Levine, who quickly sets a meeting with world-class filmmaker and Hank Moody idol Lars Manderhoff. It may be a match made in heaven when Lars surprises Hank with one of his favorite working girls, Trixie. Distraught over his personal losses, Charlie seeks comfort from Marcy while Lizzie enjoys her big break, a part in "Santa Monica Cop" courtesy of Stu.

episodes.name: The Party
episodes.summary: Hank overstays his welcome at the house of Karen and Richard and hits the road with one last stop at Malibu, where he runs into Lizzie, who uses her newly acquired acting chops to lure him back to the Runkle Manor. Once there, Hank is surprised by everyone he loves and loathes: Karen, Becca, Charlie, Marcy, Stu, Richard and his creepy sponsor, Gabriel. Even Sam and Kali show up, but it's not a party until someone gets hurt and luckily for these partygoers, Hank has it in him for one final run in with Tyler.

episodes.name: Hell Ain't a Bad Place to Be
episodes.summary: Hank discovers the bartender at a local watering hole is his late friend Lew Ashby and wonders if he's in Hell. Richard makes a startling announcement about Hank and Karen. Hank tries to make things right with Becca, but her news about Tyler leaves him stunned. On the set of "Santa Monica Cop," Sam's jealousy and fondness for firearms give Charlie an opportunity to show how much he loves his best friend and number one client; Hank's arsonist ex-girlfriend surprises him with a way for them to be together forever.

episodes.name: The Unforgiven
episodes.summary: Hank Moody narrowly survives the aftermath of his scorned ex-lover Carrie; her attempted suicide to see them both together, free from the constraints around them. Charlie takes Hank to see Atticus Fetch, a rocker who is interested in turning "A Crazy Little Thing Called Love" into a Broadway show. Meanwhile, Karen, Marcy and Charlie have to deal with Hank, after a revelation about Becca.

episodes.name: Quitters
episodes.summary: Hank reluctantly heeds the advice from his family and friends, but Faith, muse to many rock stars, may be his light at the end of the tunnel. Charlie runs into out and proud movie star Robbie Mac and finds himself taking drastic action in order to land the award winner as a client. Marcy loses her resolve with Stu, while Karen lands a new job.

episodes.name: Dead Rock Stars
episodes.summary: Hank and Faith attend a funeral. Later, Karen finds Hank in a compromising position. Robbie Mac and Ken take Charlie out on the town, which doesn't sit well with Marcy.

episodes.name: Hell Bent for Leather
episodes.summary: Hank and Charlie's meeting with Robbie Mac isn't as promising as they hoped; and later, Hank reconnects with an entertainment exec he'd worked with. Meanwhile, Marcy, Ophelia and Karen swap tales over dinner, while Becca proves she's her father's daughter at a reading of her work.

episodes.name: Rock and a Hard Place
episodes.summary: Ken discovers Charlie's secret. Atticus sends Hank and Charlie on a hunt, so they enlist the help of Faith. Marcy makes a decision about Stu that is influenced by her man hating spiritual guide, Ophelia Robbins.

episodes.name: In the Clouds
episodes.summary: Karen asks Hank to intervene with Becca. Later, the boys board Air Force 69 with Atticus Fetch to fly to NYC to present the songs for the Broadway adaptation of "A Crazy Little Thing Called Love." Charlie faces a serious case of aerophobia. Atticus is surprised by Faith, while his wife surprises Hank.

episodes.name: The Dope Show
episodes.summary: Hank returns from his trip to find Becca spiraling, but his plan to help her backfires when they go to visit Atticus and meet his current house guest. Hank has an encounter that puts him in a very awkward position with Karen. Charlie takes Stuart out for the day and has an encounter of his own.

episodes.name: Everybody's a Fucking Critic
episodes.summary: The reviews are in for the first draft of "A Crazy Little Thing Called Love: The Musical." Hank looks for inspiration from Faith to help get him to the next level. Becca contemplates alternate careers. Charlie and Stu join forces to win back Marcy, but first, they'll have to pry her from the man hating clutches of Ophelia Robbins.

episodes.name: Mad Dogs & Englishmen
episodes.summary: Atticus throws a party. Faith provides the girls, The Dealer provides the recreation and Hank's old friend provides the entertainment. Hank gets a taste of his own medicine with Karen. Atticus tries to recreate rock and roll folklore with one of his biggest fans while Charlie reunites with The Widow.

episodes.name: Blind Faith
episodes.summary: Hank seeks comfort from Faith, only to find her with Beckett. Hank meets two very important people in Faith's life. On the home front, Becca has some big news.

episodes.name: The Abby
episodes.summary: Hank and Faith join forces to track down Atticus, but Becca is the only person who can really help. Marcy's outing with Ophelia leaves her a little tied up and Charlie's response to a curious message reveals the true feelings between the two exes. Karen has an epiphany about Becca.

episodes.name: I'll Lay My Monsters Down
episodes.summary: Hank makes a big decision about his future, which affects Faith. Charlie and Marcy also make a decision. The troops are rallied to ensure Atticus makes it to the Greek Theatre for his co-headlining gig with Marilyn Manson. A call from Becca and a visit from a dearly departed friend set Hank in motion.

episodes.name: Levon
episodes.summary: Hank's reunion with Karen doesn't go quite as he planned. Meanwhile, Hank gets hired by the "Santa Monica Cop" showrunner, and a reporter asks to interview Hank for his college paper.

episodes.name: Julia
episodes.summary: Hank gets frustrated with his "Santa Monica Cop" coworkers on his first day in the show's writer's room, and he gets a surprise when he visits Levon's apartment. Meanwhile, Charlie meets Rath's new assistant; and Karen gets an unexpected surprise.

episodes.name: Like Father Like Son
episodes.summary: Hank gets his first episode assignment, much to the dismay of coworkers Terry and Hugh. Meanwhile, Levon tries to bond with Rath's assistant; Charlie attempts to patch things up with Marcy; and Karen considers giving up on Hank.

episodes.name: Dicks
episodes.summary: Hank and Levon help Julia celebrate her new role. Meanwhile, financial trouble adds to Charlie and Marcy's marital unrest, but a new client may put Charlie back in the black; and Levon tries to get some alone time with Melanie, but the Director keeps getting in the way.

episodes.name: Getting the Poison Out
episodes.summary: Levon enjoys a night with Nikki, while Karen, Hank and Marcy are forced to endure the company of Nikki's creepy friend. Meanwhile, Charlie gets in over his head with a new client.

episodes.name: Kickoff
episodes.summary: A "Santa Monica Cop" kickoff party is hosted by Rath, where Hank conducts an intimate notes session with the show's leading lady, and Hashtag Black eyes Julia. Meanwhile, Charlie manages headcase client Goldie; and Stu makes Charlie an offer.

episodes.name: Smile
episodes.summary: Rath demands a rewrite of Hank's 'Santa Monica Cop' script. Julia's new boss, Dr. Dan, gives her some career advice, but Levon and Hank have other ideas. Charlie and Marcy consider Stu's offer - until Atticus' old rock 'n' roll butler Krull offers an alternative solution to their money woes.

episodes.name: 30 Minutes or Less
episodes.summary: Hank has problems with Hashtag Black. Stu's offer leads to fisticuffs.

episodes.name: Faith, Hope, Love
episodes.summary: Hank recalls turbulent times with Karen, a confused Becca, and their days with a happier Charlie and Marcy. Meanwhile, a nun helps Hank put things into perspective.

episodes.name: Dinner with Friends
episodes.summary: Hank entices Karen to have dinner with him, but Julia interrupts their romantic evening. Later, Charlie, Marcy, Krull, Levon and his new friend bring even more drama to the night; and chaos ensues when Stu assaults Charlie's manhood.

episodes.name: Daughter
episodes.summary: Hank might soon be out of a job. Becca makes a big announcement.

episodes.name: Grace
episodes.summary: Hank makes a life-altering decision. Series finale.

shows.title: Vikings
shows.summary: Vikings transports us to the brutal and mysterious world of Ragnar Lothbrok, a Viking warrior and farmer who yearns to explore - and raid - the distant shores across the ocean.

cast.name: Linus Roache
cast.character: King Ecbert of Wessex and Mercia

episodes.name: Rites of Passage
episodes.summary: A Viking warrior seeks approval from his community's leader in the opener of this series chronicling the medieval adventures of a band of Norsemen.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Northmen
episodes.summary: Ragnar gathers a crew in preparation for an epic journey; the earl is overcome with paranoia.

episodes.name: Dispossessed
episodes.summary: Ragnar and his crew raid a monastery, securing a bounty of riches that impresses the earl.

episodes.name: Trial
episodes.summary: The Vikings return to England; the earl plants a spy within Ragnar's crew.

episodes.name: Raid
episodes.summary: A prophet predicts the earl's future; Ragnar's home and farm are destroyed.

episodes.name: Burial of the Dead
episodes.summary: Ragnar faces off with the Earl after learning of Rollo's torture.

episodes.name: A King's Ransom
episodes.summary: Ragnar presents a proposal to King Aelle.

episodes.name: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Ragnar attempts to cope with the death of his unborn son; Lagertha seeks answers from the gods.

episodes.name: All Change
episodes.summary: Ragnar attempts to settle a land dispute; a plague breaks out.

episodes.name: Brother's War
episodes.summary: A battle begins, pitting Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg and Rollo in the Season 2 premiere. Meanwhile, Princess Aslaug arrives in Kattegat with a surprise that leaves Ragnar in a difficult predicament.

episodes.name: Invasion
episodes.summary: An unlikely alliance plans a raid on England; Ragnar and his men face off against a formidable foe.

episodes.name: Treachery
episodes.summary: King Ecbert faces a new foe; Ragnar races to dominate in the West.

episodes.name: Eye for an Eye
episodes.summary: Ragnar and Ecbert meet face-to-face; Rollo is forced to become a leader.

episodes.name: Answers in Blood
episodes.summary: Lagertha and Ragnar unite to battle Jarl Borg. Later, Bjorn makes a difficult choice.

episodes.name: Unforgiven
episodes.summary: King Horik presents a surprising proposition to Ragnar; Athelstan becomes confidant to King Ecbert.

episodes.name: Blood Eagle
episodes.summary: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to punish Jarl Borg. Meanwhile, Ecbert eyes a new alliance.

episodes.name: Boneless
episodes.summary: Aslaug prepares to give birth; Ragnar, Horik and Lagertha set sail for Wessex.

episodes.name: The Choice
episodes.summary: Ragnar's men are engaged in battle while marching to King Ecbert's villa.

episodes.name: The Lord's Prayer
episodes.summary: Ragnar and King Horik return to Kattegat in the Series 2 finale. Meanwhile, new alliances are formed.

episodes.name: Mercenary
episodes.summary: King Ecbert proposes a deal to the Vikings in the Season 3 premiere. Later, Ragnar leads his forces into battle.

episodes.name: The Wanderer
episodes.summary: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

episodes.name: Warrior's Fate
episodes.summary: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. In Mercia, the Wessex/Viking forces charge at the battle at the Hill of the Ash. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat, and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

episodes.name: Scarred
episodes.summary: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp–Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

episodes.name: The Usurper
episodes.summary: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

episodes.name: Born Again
episodes.summary: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Kalf arrives in Kattegat to join the raid and the Viking fleet sails up the Seine and catches sight of Paris for the first time. Porunn and Judith both deliver children, and with new life there is also death.

episodes.name: Paris
episodes.summary: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who hopes that a heroic victory against the Vikings will gain him Gisla's hand in marriage. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

episodes.name: To the Gates!
episodes.summary: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and will stop at nothing to succeed.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.summary: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

episodes.name: The Dead
episodes.summary: With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Viking troops take a daring chance. Ragnar asks Bjorn for a favor that could change the course of Viking history.

episodes.name: A Good Treason
episodes.summary: Entry to Valhalla eludes Ragnar but as he lies in his sick bed in Kattegat events unfold beyond his control. Bjorn orders the arrest of Floki for Athelstan's murder and in Paris, Rollo betrays his allies to strengthen his position. Meanwhile, in Hedeby, Kalf announces joint Earldom with Lagertha, but is Lagertha actually willing to share what once was hers?

episodes.name: Kill the Queen
episodes.summary: Floki hopes to escape from Ragnar and Kattegat. Rollo makes great efforts in Paris to win over his new bride, Princess Gisla. King Ecbert orders his son Aethelwulf to rescue Queen Kwenthrith from opposing forces in Mercia.

episodes.name: Mercy
episodes.summary: Floki faces the wrath of Ragnar. Intrigue prevails in the French Court as Rollo finds an unlikely ally. Kalf and Erlendur plot their ascent. Bjorn must fight a fierce opponent in the wilderness.

episodes.name: Yol
episodes.summary: The Yule Log burns in the Great Hall in Kattegat and mysterious visitors are welcomed, among them a Norwegian King. King Aelle visits Wessex for Christmas and is concerned with how family relations are developing. In Paris, Rollo's future hangs in the balance - can he win over his new bride, Gisla, as a Papal Delegation arrives to arrange a divorce?

episodes.name: Promised
episodes.summary: There's an air of betrayal at Court in Paris and in Wessex. Ecbert agrees to support Kwenthrith in Mercia, but is Ecbert a true ally? Ragnar confides in Yidu his darkest secret. Happiness comes to Lagertha and Kalf and a marriage is arranged.

episodes.name: What Might Have Been
episodes.summary: Ragnar announces a raid on Paris at the Thing in Kattegat. The fleet is battered by a storm after it sets sail, but the greatest challenge for the Vikings lies ahead in Paris, where Rollo awaits. Meanwhile, Ecbert dispatches Aethelwulf and Alfred on a pilgrimage to Rome.

episodes.name: The Profit and the Loss
episodes.summary: On the Seine, the Vikings attack with considerable force but can they breach Rollo's defenses? Meanwhile, Harbard, the mysterious wanderer, returns and causes a stir amongst the women of Kattegat.

episodes.name: Portage
episodes.summary: The Vikings call Ragnar's leadership into question. Ragnar himself remains inscrutable and orders the fleet to beach at a cliff face where he unveils an ingenious plan. Rollo and Gisla have news that strengthens Rollo's position at the French Court.

episodes.name: Death All 'Round
episodes.summary: The labours of the Vikings bear fruit as, within sight of Paris, they re-launch their fleet but this time with some formidable new structures that Floki has engineered. Aethelwulf and Alfred arrive in Rome and honours are conferred by Pope Leo. Relations are not so cordial in Wessex.

episodes.name: The Last Ship
episodes.summary: A fierce battle between the Vikings and the French eventually comes down to Ragnar against Rollo and the outcome seals the fates of the two brothers.

episodes.name: The Outsider
episodes.summary: Ragnar has returned to Kattegat and there are secrets to be revealed. He makes plans to return to Wessex to right past wrongs but finds that those who were once his closest allies now have plans of their own. Even the Lothbrok sons refuse to join their father's mission – except one.

episodes.name: The Vision
episodes.summary: The Kattegat locals chide Ragnar that the gods have deserted him as he struggles to crew his voyage to Wessex. It's Bjorn who has charisma now as he prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki. By contrast, Ragnar must accept weathered boats and a crew he has bribed but when Aslaug foresees that the fleet will be lost in a vicious storm her warnings go un-heeded by Ragnar and her precious son, Ivar.

episodes.name: Two Journeys
episodes.summary: Ragnar's fleet is shipwrecked and washes up on the Wessex coast, but without enough survivors to form a credible force, Ragnar and Ivar have a difficult decision to make. Rollo meets his Viking comrades again and can't resist the urge to join Bjorn's voyage, risking his marriage and his new Frankish identity. Ragnar too is taking a risk as he carries Ivar towards the Royal Villa in Wessex – throwing himself and his son upon the mercy of King Ecbert.

episodes.name: In the Uncertain Hour Before the Morning
episodes.summary: Lagertha attempts to fulfill a long-held ambition. Ragnar negotiates an unexpected concession from King Ecbert.

episodes.name: All His Angels
episodes.summary: Ragnar and Ivar plot against the Saxons and reach a new level of understanding.

episodes.name: Crossings
episodes.summary: Bjorn's fleet sails onward and launches a surprise attack; back in Kattegat, Lagertha continues in her quest for power.

episodes.name: The Great Army
episodes.summary: The Viking army begins to gather in Kattegat; Lagertha must remain vigilant in the absence of her son, Bjorn.

episodes.name: Revenge
episodes.summary: Ragnar's plan comes to fruition; the Viking army lands on the coast of Northumbria.

episodes.name: On the Eve
episodes.summary: The Viking army causes panic in the English countryside as King Ecbert and Aethelwulf plan the defense of the realm.

episodes.name: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Prince Aethelwulf finds himself subject to the Vikings' battle master plan; Ecbert remains behind with a plan of his own.

episodes.name: The Fisher King
episodes.summary: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund, the warrior bishop, must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

episodes.name: The Departed
episodes.summary: As the Vikings establish their stronghold in York, Ivar is determined to lead the Great Army. In Kattegat, Lagertha misjudges King Harald and pays a heavy price. Floki arrives at a mysterious land.

episodes.name: Homeland
episodes.summary: Celebrations are cut short in the aftermath of the battle at York. Ragnar Lothbrok's sons are pitted against each other as tensions reach an all-time high and each is forced to choose a side.

episodes.name: The Plan
episodes.summary: Guided by Bishop Heahmund's visions, the Saxons devise a battle plan. Ivar the Boneless strategizes on his own as the Vikings undergo increasing pressure. Bjorn Ironside finds himself in a new territory and must convince the local commander he is a trader and not a raider.

episodes.name: The Prisoner
episodes.summary: Ivar meets his match in Bishop Heahmund, while Floki returns to Kattegat and Bjorn receives a lavish welcome in North Africa.

episodes.name: The Message
episodes.summary: Lagertha is betrayed and Bjorn must find a way to support the distraught queen. Floki and his settlers arrive in a new land but it is far from what they expected.

episodes.name: Full Moon
episodes.summary: Bjorn returns to Kattegat to learn that an attack is to take place during the next full moon. Ivar must decide if he can place his trust in a former enemy on the battlefield.

episodes.name: The Joke
episodes.summary: The battle for Kattegat begins; as the two armies line up to fight, the Great Heathen Army must decide between a final plea for peace or all-out war; Floki faces discord among the settlers.

episodes.name: A Simple Story
episodes.summary: The army leaders consider their options in the aftermath of the battle; in Floki's camp, all hopes of binding the community together are dashed as tragedy unfolds.

episodes.name: Moments of Vision
episodes.summary: A sense of doom looms over Kattegat as bloodshed ensues; the defeated army flees in the face of the victors, and a legendary warrior makes his way home.

episodes.name: The Revelation
episodes.summary: Ivar is crowned the new king of Kattegat just in time to welcome Rollo home. Bjorn, Lagertha, and Ubbe must rely on unsteady alliances to survive.

episodes.name: Murder Most Foul
episodes.summary: Bjorn, Lagertha, and Ubbe face an uncertain fate as Heahmund's loyalty is tested. In Iceland, Floki fights to understand the will of the gods. In Kattegat, Ivar may have met his match.

episodes.name: A New God
episodes.summary: Heahmund must try to convince King Alfred that his actions are in defense of the Crown. Ubbe and Torvi strengthen the position of the Vikings but not all in the Viking camp support their strategy. Another settler disappears in Iceland.

episodes.name: The Lost Moment
episodes.summary: As the celebrations for Ivar continue in Kattegat, grief hits Iceland, and Floki must now make a fated decision. Harald's army approaches Wessex. A conspiracy grows against King Alfred in Court.

episodes.name: Hell
episodes.summary: Bishop Heahmund is wracked with guilt as he fights to renounce his passions. Viking will clash with Saxon on the battlefield leaving a key figure lost in the balance.

episodes.name: The Buddha
episodes.summary: Bjorn achieves one of Ragnar's dreams. Back in Kattegat, Ivar hatches a new plan while preparing for a divine arrival. In Iceland, a settler returns in a terrible state. King Alfred faces his greatest threat yet.

episodes.name: The Most Terrible Thing
episodes.summary: An unexpected turn amongst the settlers leaves Floki powerless. King Alfred confronts Judith. In York, Bjorn must strike a deal with Harald. Wessex is once again threatened by a Viking force, but who will lead the Saxon army to defend the Realm?

episodes.name: Baldur
episodes.summary: Hvitserk is severely tested. Floki makes an amazing discovery. Freydis gives Ivar a surprise. Ubbe negotiates with the three Danish Kings that have massed their armies in Reading, but the negotiations may have a perilous outcome.

episodes.name: What Happens in the Cave
episodes.summary: Ubbe is forced into hand-to-hand combat. Floki reaches new depths and is met by a shocking sight. Bjorn sets off for Scandinavia with an old rival.

episodes.name: Ragnarok
episodes.summary: A new battle for Kattegat is on and only the gods know who will emerge victorious.

episodes.name: New Beginnings
episodes.summary: It's six months after the battle of Kattegat and Bjorn is now King. But as he struggles with the responsibilities of kingship, he finds he can't rely on his mother, Lagertha--she has other plans. But can Lagertha lead a quieter life and leave her days as a shield-maiden behind? Ivar falls into the hands of the Kievan Rus, and in their ruthless and unpredictable ruler, Prince Oleg, he may finally have met his match. Intrigued by Ivar's claims to be a god, Oleg decides to put him to the test.

episodes.name: The Prophet
episodes.summary: Messengers arrive in Kattegat with news that presents Bjorn with a dilemma. As Bjorn attempts to do the right thing as ruler of Kattegat, Prince Oleg of Kiev seems untroubled by his conscience. Even Ivar is shocked by Oleg's vicious character as he wrestles for control over the young heir to the throne of the Rus Empire. Lagertha has settled into her new, peaceful life, but danger lurks nearby.

episodes.name: Ghosts, Gods and Running Dogs
episodes.summary: Lagertha is visited by women from the nearby villages and they feast together happily but the community is shattered by shocking events that follows and Lagertha is forced to take action. In Kiev, although Oleg continues to be friendly, Ivar is aware of the threat which Oleg poses, not only to himself, but to the vulnerable young heir to the throne. Bjorn has answered the call and come to the aid of an old enemy, but all is not as it seems and disaster looms for Bjorn's forces.

episodes.name: All the Prisoners
episodes.summary: Lagertha leads her village's response to the recent attacks but despite her best efforts, when the inevitable attack comes, the consequences are tragic. Olaf has a bold new plan for the future of Norway. In Kiev, although Ivar discusses Oleg's ambitions for Scandinavia, he's actually more interested in the plight of Igor, the young heir who Oleg controls.

episodes.name: The Key
episodes.summary: King Olaf feels confident about the result of the election of the King of all Norway as the kings and jarls visit Harald's territory; Lagertha's village is abuzz due to bandit attacks; Ivar is forced to confront an unfortunate element of his past.

episodes.name: Death and the Serpent
episodes.summary: Bjorn is forced to act quickly in the aftermath of the election for the King of all Norway. The bandits attack Lagertha's village again, confident of victory. But when the defense boils down to single combat with Lagertha, victory for the bandits looks less certain. Back in Kattegat, haunted and paranoid, Hvitserk continues to unravel.

episodes.name: The Ice Maiden
episodes.summary: Bjorn comes back to Kattegat; Harald manages to acquire a semblance of revenge against Olaf; Ivar and Igor learn information about Prince Dir while in Kiev.

episodes.name: Valhalla Can Wait
episodes.summary: Bjorn is confronted by a difficult choice to make; Ubbe and Torvi embark on a search for old friends and new lands after they leave Kattegat; Oleg's preparations for invading Scandinavia go as planned while King Harald investigates the raiding party.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.summary: In Iceland, Ubbe and Torvi finally meet a mysterious wanderer. Bjorn is forced to re-think who his enemies are when Erik returns from a scouting mission with worrying information. Bjorn will need allies, but can he convince his old foe, King Harald, to join forces in the face of the new threat? Ivar is reunited with someone close to him.

episodes.name: The Best Laid Plans
episodes.summary: Ivar and Igor may be plotting against Oleg, but they're still part of the force that departs Kiev to invade Scandinavia. King Harald and King Bjorn begin furious preparations for the invasion. But can enough be done to resist the Rus force?

episodes.name: King of Kings
episodes.summary: In Iceland, Ubbe learns the truth about Kjetill and has a difficult decision to make. Back in Norway, the battle against the Rus has had grave consequences. But re-enforcements have arrived, and Bjorn has an idea that may yet save the day.

episodes.name: All Change
episodes.summary: The mood has changed when the Rus army returns to Kiev and Oleg isolates Ivar. But Dir confirms that he's mustering a force to overthrow Oleg and Ivar is part of the plan. Ubbe and a group of settlers depart Iceland, in search of the Golden Land.

episodes.name: The Signal
episodes.summary: It's Election Day in Kattegat and all eyes are on the voting. But strangers arriving at the harbor may force an unexpected outcome. Meanwhile, Ivar receives the signal from Prince Dir that his forces are ready to challenge Oleg.

episodes.name: Lost Souls
episodes.summary: Prince Igor receives a hero's welcome in Novgorod but back in Kiev the mood is darker: Prince Oleg will not be giving up the fight. Meanwhile, Ubbe's settlers are overjoyed to find land, but it's not the Golden Land they expected.

episodes.name: All At Sea
episodes.summary: A fight erupts in Greenland and Ubbe, Torvi and Othere barely escape with their lives...in a leaking boat with no supplies. And in Kattegat, Gunnhild makes a bold move.

episodes.name: The Final Straw
episodes.summary: Out in the open sea, Ubbe and the settlers are at the mercy of the elements. Tension mounts between Ubbe and Othere and when baby Ragnar begins to weaken, it's the final straw for Ubbe. Meanwhile, Ivar and Hvitserk return to Kattegat.

episodes.name: The Raft of Medusa
episodes.summary: When King Alfred of Wessex hears about the arrival of the sons of Ragnar, with an army, he knows he must take drastic action. So as the Viking army makes camp and lies in wait, Alfred and his army abandon the Royal Villa and march to meet them.

episodes.name: It's Only Magic
episodes.summary: Ubbe and the settlers find land, but soon realize they're not alone. In Wessex, King Alfred has mustered a large force to meet the Vikings. Meanwhile, in Kattegat, Erik realizes that Ingrid has been using her powers against him.

episodes.name: The Lord Giveth…
episodes.summary: In the new land, Ubbe and the settlers engage in careful diplomacy when they are surrounded by the locals. In Wessex, the Vikings ambush the Saxon army, but Alfred is convinced the Lord is with his army and refuses to retreat.

episodes.name: The Last Act
episodes.summary: The epic saga which began with Ragnar Lothbrok, the first Viking hero to emerge from the mists of myth and legend, comes to an end in a spectacular and shocking series finale which finds tragedy striking in the new land and in England.

shows.title: American Horror Story
shows.summary: American Horror Story is an horror television anthology series. Each season is conceived as a self-contained miniseries, following a disparate set of characters and settings, and a storyline with its own beginning, middle, and end. While some actors appear for more than one year, they play completely different roles in each season.

cast.character: Shelby Miller TV / Actress Audrey Tindall

cast.name: Cuba Gooding, Jr.
cast.character: Matt Miller TV / Actor Dominic Marks

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Therapist Ben Harmon, his wife, Vivien, and their daughter, Violet, move across the country to Los Angeles to escape their troubled past.

episodes.name: Home Invasion
episodes.summary: Serial killer enthusiasts reenact the brutal murders of two nursing students, while Ben returns to Boston to fix a mistake involving an old flame.

episodes.name: Murder House
episodes.summary: Ben confronts Moira about recent strange behavior, while Vivien learns about the house's first resident.

episodes.name: Halloween Part 1
episodes.summary: Two of the house's previous residents, interior designers Chad and Patrick, give the Harmons decorating advice.

episodes.name: Halloween Part 2
episodes.summary: While on a date with Violet, Tate is harassed by a group of bloody teens. Ben and Vivien are haunted by one of the house's newest guests.

episodes.name: Piggy, Piggy
episodes.summary: Ben sees a new patient who is terrified by the legend of a man who slaughters those who repeat a specific mantra into a mirror.

episodes.name: Open House
episodes.summary: Moira persuades a prospective buyer to make an offer, but Constance and Larry try to undermine her efforts. Meanwhile, Vivien and Luke grow closer.

episodes.name: Rubber Man
episodes.summary: The identity of the man in the rubber suit is revealed.

episodes.name: Spooky Little Girl
episodes.summary: One of history's most famous murder victims pays the house a visit. Constance discovers more of Tate's bad behavior.

episodes.name: Smoldering Children
episodes.summary: In 1994, Larry gets burned. In the present, Ben begins to understand what happened to cause Vivien's institutionalization. Constance is questioned by the police in Travis' death. Violet learns something about herself that she doesn't know.

episodes.name: Birth
episodes.summary: Vivien gives birth. Violet learns who fathered one of her new siblings.

episodes.name: Afterbirth
episodes.summary: The aftermath of Vivien's difficult labour is revealed and Ben makes plans to get out of the house. Some of the spirits have other plans and the family has to pull together to make it through these very tough changes.

episodes.name: Welcome to Briarcliff
episodes.summary: After a life-changing experience, a young man is admitted into a notorious insane asylum, while a local reporter is determined to get the full story.

episodes.name: Tricks and Treats
episodes.summary: An exorcist is summoned to Briarcliff to help save a troubled farm boy. Sister Jude's darkest secret is revealed.

episodes.name: Nor'easter
episodes.summary: A group of patients plan an escape from the asylum during a violent storm. Sister Jude is haunted by her past.

episodes.name: I Am Anne Frank Part 1
episodes.summary: A new patient claiming to be Anne Frank exposes Arden's past. Kit learns why Grace was admitted to Briarcliff.

episodes.name: I Am Anne Frank Part 2
episodes.summary: Sister Jude digs up dirt on Arden. Kit makes a surprising confession. Bloody Face is unmasked.

episodes.name: The Origins of Monstrosity
episodes.summary: A mysterious little girl is abandoned at Briarcliff. The Monsignor makes a Faustian pact with Dr. Arden. The origin of Bloody Face is revealed.

episodes.name: Dark Cousin
episodes.summary: Sister Mary Eunice is terrified to discover a dark angel has descended on Briarcliff. Kit makes a bold move to be reunited with Grace.

episodes.name: Unholy Night
episodes.summary: A murderous Santa wreaks havoc on Briarcliff. Sister Jude faces off with the Devil. Arden has a shocking encounter in the Death Chute.

episodes.name: The Coat Hanger
episodes.summary: The Monsignor takes an unlikely convert under his wing. Lana secures a new piece of evidence that can exonerate Kit. Dr. Arden witnesses a miraculous return.

episodes.name: The Name Game
episodes.summary: The Monsignor confronts the Devil. Dr. Arden's experiments reach a shocking conclusion. Dr. Thredson facilitates a surprising reunion for Kit.

episodes.name: Spilt Milk
episodes.summary: Grace brings Kit devastating news about the aliens' experiments on Alma. Dr. Thredson receives an unexpected visitor. The Monsignor goes to extreme lengths to silence Jude.

episodes.name: Continuum
episodes.summary: A deadly new inmate threatens Sister Jude's chance of release from Briarcliff. Grace's obsession with the aliens turns violent.

episodes.name: Madness Ends
episodes.summary: Johnny sets out to complete his father's work. Lana leads the charge to finally shut down Briarcliff.

episodes.name: Bitchcraft
episodes.summary: After discovering her unique bloodline, a young girl is whisked away to a special academy for girls who share the same lineage.

episodes.name: Boy Parts
episodes.summary: Fiona threatens a long-standing peace when she delves into Madame LaLaurie's past, while Zoe and Madison must deal with a horrible tragedy.

episodes.name: The Replacements
episodes.summary: Fiona takes on an unlikely protégé. A guilt-ridden Zoe tries to give Kyle his old life back. Madison has a fiery exchange with Joan Ramsey, a new neighbor.

episodes.name: Fearful Pranks Ensue
episodes.summary: Fiona's choices rattle a decades-long truce between the Salem witches and Marie Laveau. The Council of Witchcraft pays a surprise visit to the Academy with disturbing allegations.

episodes.name: Burn, Witch. Burn!
episodes.summary: Besieged by Marie Laveau's army, Zoe unleashes a new power. Fiona and Myrtle clash over control of the Coven. Madame LaLaurie is confronted by old ghosts.

episodes.name: The Axeman Cometh
episodes.summary: Zoe, Queenie, and Nan make contact with a dark spirit trapped in the Academy. Cordelia's new power brings on a heartbreaking revelation.

episodes.name: The Dead
episodes.summary: Fiona finds new purpose in a dangerous love affair. A night out with LaLaurie leads Queenie to question her place in the Coven. Cordelia makes a fateful decision about her mother.

episodes.name: The Sacred Taking
episodes.summary: Cordelia rallies the girls in the fight to stop Fiona. A dangerous new enemy puts Misty in the crosshairs. The rivalry between Marie Laveau and Delphine comes to a head.

episodes.name: Head
episodes.summary: Cordelia's attacker is revealed. Fiona looks to form an alliance with Marie Laveau. Nan learns a disturbing truth about Luke's past.

episodes.name: The Magical Delights of Stevie Nicks
episodes.summary: Fiona attempts to out the new Supreme with a visit from Stevie Nicks. Cordelia learns the truth about Hank and the Witch Hunters. Madison tries to eliminate her competition for the Supremacy.

episodes.name: Protect the Coven
episodes.summary: Fiona and Laveau have a deadly face off with The Corporation. Cordelia makes a desperate sacrifice to protect the Coven.

episodes.name: Go to Hell
episodes.summary: Cordelia's latest vision puts the Coven's future in question. With the end of Fiona's reign approaching, the girls manifest powerful new gifts. Queenie's search for Marie Laveau leads her to Hell and back.

episodes.name: The Seven Wonders
episodes.summary: A new Supreme rises.

episodes.name: Monsters Among Us
episodes.summary: One of the only surviving sideshows in the country struggles to stay in business during the dawning era of television. When police make a terrifying discovery at a local farmhouse, the eccentric purveyor of the freak show sees an opportunity that will lead her troupe either to their salvation or ruin.

episodes.name: Massacres and Matinees
episodes.summary: A citywide curfew threatens to shut down the Freak Show. A strongman from Ethel's troubled past arrives at camp. Gloria arranges a terrifying play date for Dandy. The Tattler Twins reveal a talent that could knock Elsa from the spotlight.

episodes.name: Edward Mordrake: Part 1
episodes.summary: The Freaks refuse to perform on Halloween due to an old carny superstition. Jimmy is smitten by a woman claiming to be a fortuneteller. Ethel receives life-changing news.

episodes.name: Edward Mordrake: Part 2
episodes.summary: Edward Mordrake continues his search for a Freak to add to his ghostly coterie. Elsa tells the grisly story of her days in Germany. Jimmy and Maggie have a run-in with the Twisted Clown.

episodes.name: Pink Cupcakes
episodes.summary: Stanley and Maggie hatch a plan to murder the Freaks. Gloria hides the evidence of Dandy's gruesome new hobby. A health scare reveals Desiree may not be the oddity she once thought.

episodes.name: Bullseye
episodes.summary: Elsa unveils a dangerous new act. Stanley puts pressure on Maggie to murder Jimmy. Paul indulges in a secret romance.

episodes.name: Test of Strength
episodes.summary: The women of the Freak Show rally against Dell after his latest act of violence. A strange encounter with Dandy raises Jimmy's suspicion about the clown murders.

episodes.name: Blood Bath
episodes.summary: Recent disappearances around camp raise Ethel's suspicion of Elsa. Gloria makes a last ditch effort to contain Dandy's bloodlust.

episodes.name: Tupperware Party Massacre
episodes.summary: In the wake of a tragic loss, Jimmy sinks into a drunken despair. A reading from Maggie spurs Dandy to action. Stanley and Elsa track down the Twins.

episodes.name: Orphans
episodes.summary: The death of a Freak sparks troubling behavior in Pepper. Elsa reveals the history of the Freak Show. Desiree grows suspicious of Maggie.

episodes.name: Magical Thinking
episodes.summary: Elsa prepares for her move to Hollywood. The Twins grow enamored with a traveling salesman. Dell plots Jimmy's escape from police custody.

episodes.name: Show Stoppers
episodes.summary: Dandy gives the Twins troubling information about Chester. Maggie vows to prove her loyalty to Jimmy. The Freaks enforce their harsh code of justice.

episodes.name: Curtain Call
episodes.summary: The Freaks rebel against new management. Dandy prepares for his debut performance. Elsa arrives in Tinseltown.

episodes.name: Checking In
episodes.summary: Detective John Lowe investigates a strange murder-torture case, and gets a tip that leads him to the Hotel Cortez. Meanwhile, the staff and long-time residents discover that the owner has sold the hotel and they will soon be evicted.

episodes.name: Chutes and Ladders
episodes.summary: While Will holds a fashion show in the lobby, his son Lochlin shows Scarlett one of the hotel's many secrets. Meanwhile, John forces Iris to tell him the history of the hotel from the 1920s when it was built as an abbatoir by a homicidal oil man.

episodes.name: Mommy
episodes.summary: After a family counseling session, Alex gives John some bad news. Meanwhile, Donovan tells his mother to kill herself and then is captured by the Countess' rival.

episodes.name: Devil's Night
episodes.summary: James holds his annual dinner for his most favored students, and John discovers that he's on the list. Meanwhile, Alex confronts the Countess over the changes in Holden, and the older woman tells her how she can be with her son forever.

episodes.name: Room Service
episodes.summary: To save a dying boy, Alex uses her own blood with unexpected consequences. Meanwhile, Iris and Liz draw closer, Donovan makes a deal with Ramona, and John wakes up in bed with Sally.

episodes.name: Room 33
episodes.summary: Iris looks the other way as Ramona and Donovan enter the Cortez to deprive the Countess of what she loves most. Meanwhile, Liz finds true love but there's a snag, and John inadvertently brings a horror into his house.

episodes.name: Flicker
episodes.summary: The Countess' first love is revealed in 1925, while two modern-day construction workers open up a wing of the Cortez that has not been seen... since 1925. Meanwhile, John checks himself into the hospital to confront the suspect in the Ten Commandment killings.

episodes.name: The Ten Commandments Killer
episodes.summary: John and Hahn meet over Wren's body, and John tells his former partner who the Ten Commandments Killer really is.

episodes.name: She Wants Revenge
episodes.summary: Donovan asks the Countess to commit to him totally... and then goes to Ramona and offers to betray his lover. Meanwhile, Iris kills two more people in the Cortez, and Will makes his wedding plans.

episodes.name: She Gets Revenge
episodes.summary: Liz and Iris decide to make a clean exit from the Cortez, but a visit by Liz's son Douglas causes a change in plans. Meanwhile, John and Alex decide to give their marriage a second chance, and Donavan confronts Rudolph.

episodes.name: Battle Royale
episodes.summary: John brings his family home, but Sally has other plans. Meanwhile, Liz and Iris help Ramona escape her prison and provide her with the blood she needs.to restore herself to health.

episodes.name: Be Our Guest
episodes.summary: The last days of the Cortez are chronicled as Liz and Iris take charge and put an end to the killing. Meanwhile, John speaks for the first time with a psychic to reveal his fate and the fate of his family.

episodes.name: Chapter 1
episodes.summary: A young interracial couple move into a farmhouse in North Carolina after purchasing it with their life savings. However, unearthly phenomena begin occurring and things are not what they seem.

episodes.name: Chapter 2
episodes.summary: Matt and Shelby find a revealing videotape in a hidden cellar. Meanwhile, Lee's daughter Flora makes a new friend, and the mysterious events continue.

episodes.name: Chapter 3
episodes.summary: Lee and the others conduct a frantic search for the missing Flora, but a psychic is the only one who offers her hope of finding her daughter. Meanwhile, the identity of the Butcher is revealed.

episodes.name: Chapter 4
episodes.summary: Scathach presents herself for the first time and reveals what she wants. However, Thomasin and the ghost settlers have other plans.

episodes.name: Chapter 5
episodes.summary: The Millers attempt to escape the house with the help of an unexpected ally, but fall into the clutches of the Polk family.

episodes.name: Chapter 6
episodes.summary: The producer of My Roanoke Nightmare decides to follow up his huge hit with a second season... putting the actors and their real-life counterparts in the same house during the Blood Moon, and seeing if Lee confesses to Mason's murder.

episodes.name: Chapter 7
episodes.summary: Chaos breaks out at the house as Audrey, Monet, and Lee try to escape through the secret tunnel. Meanwhile, Shelby learns why Matt came back to the house, and Agnes considers a career change.

episodes.name: Chapter 8
episodes.summary: Lee, Audrey, and Monet try to escape the Polks. Meanwhile, Shelby and Dominic are trapped by the ghosts in the house.

episodes.name: Chapter 9
episodes.summary: Three My Roanoke Nightmare fans pay a visit to the House, unaware that they've arrived at the worst possible time. Meanwhile, Lee and Audrey try to recover the camera, and a new visitor doesn't prove very helpful.

episodes.name: Chapter 10
episodes.summary: After Three Days in Hell, Lee stands trial for murder and is then interviewed by Lana Winters.

episodes.name: Election Night
episodes.summary: After Trump is elected President, Ally Mayfair-Richards is beset by all of her old phobias... and they appear to be coming to life.

episodes.name: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
episodes.summary: Kai runs for City Council, and pays a visit to Ally. Meanwhile, Ivy asks Rudy to pay Ally a visit, and Ally and ivy visit their new neighbors.

episodes.name: Neighbors from Hell
episodes.summary: The community turns on Ally after she shoots and kills a Hispanic man. At home tensions between Ally and Ivy grow worse, and Kai may be Ally's only hope.
The events surrounding the 2017 Presidential election as Kai begins to gather his cult.

episodes.name: Holes
episodes.summary: Kai asks for the cult members to prove their loyalty against one of their own. Meanwhile, Ally meets with Rudy to tell him about her problems dealing with Ivy's departure.

episodes.name: Mid-Western Assassin
episodes.summary: Ally takes Meadow to Rudy in the hopes that she will confirm her story about the cult. However, Meadow has a change of heart. Meanwhile, an unexpected opponent runs against Kai in the city council election.

episodes.name: Valerie Solanas Died for Your Sins: Scumbag
episodes.summary: Kai begins to solidify his grasp on power after winning the election, and a mysterious woman warns Beverly, Ivy, and Winter that Kai will soon cast them aside.

episodes.name: Winter of Our Discontent
episodes.summary: Kai gains a new ally as he seeks out the betrayers in his cult... and asks Winter to become the mother of the messiah.

episodes.name: Drink the Kool-Aid
episodes.summary: Kai tests the loyalty of his followers, including the women. Meanwhile, Ally tells Ivy how she overcame her phobias, and plots to take Oz away.

episodes.name: Charles (Manson) in Charge
episodes.summary: Kai receives visits from Charles Manson as he begins to question everyone around him.

episodes.name: Great Again
episodes.summary: The FBI arrest Kai, but he continues to amass power in prison. Meanwhile, Ally tries to move on with her life but decides to go into politics.

episodes.name: The End
episodes.summary: The end of the world happens when the bombs drop, and the survivors wonder if surviving is worth it after the Cooperative gives them shelter.

episodes.name: The Morning After
episodes.summary: Michael determines which of the survivors are worth taking to Sanctuary, and a familiar body appears from the past to seduce Gallant.

episodes.name: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.summary: When a carriage with a box of apples arrive, Wilhelmina decides to throw a Halloween party. Three guests crash the afterparty.

episodes.name: Could It Be ... Satan?
episodes.summary: Michael's early life as a teenager, and how he came to find himself at the Hawthorne Academy, is revealed.

episodes.name: Boy Wonder
episodes.summary: Cordelia not only challenges Michael to complete the Seven Wonders, but to surpass his predecessors by bringing Misty Day back from Purgatory. Meanwhile, John Henry has suspicions about Michael's background and Miriam has a chat with him.

episodes.name: Return to Murder House
episodes.summary: Old spirits rise and are laid to rest as Madison and Behold come to the Murder House seeking answers to Michael's childhood.

episodes.name: Traitor
episodes.summary: Cordelia takes steps to punish the traitors among the coven and stop Michael from rising to power as the Antichrist.

episodes.name: Sojourn
episodes.summary: Michael questions his father's unholy plan for world annihilation, and is directed on the proper path to recover Miriam.

episodes.name: Fire and Reign
episodes.summary: Michael strikes at the school, but Cordelia, Myrtle, and Mallory escape him. Mutt and Jeff step in to guide Michael to his destiny, and recruit Wilhelmina to administer the Outposts.

episodes.name: Apocalypse Then
episodes.summary: The surviving witches travel to Outpost 3 to stand in final battle against the Antichrist.

episodes.name: Camp Redwood
episodes.summary: The notorious Mr. Jingles brutally kills nine camp residents in 1970. Fourteen years later, Jingles escapes the insane asylum where he was confined and returns to the camp to wreck bloody havoc.

episodes.name: Mr. Jingles
episodes.summary: Margaret makes contact with one of the killers, and Brooke tells Montana about her tragic backstory. Xavier meets the man who called him earlier, and Trevor takes a shower.

episodes.name: Slashdance
episodes.summary: The dark pasts of three of the camp staff are revealed. Ray panics and loses his head, the camp nurse ends up paddled, and Chet gets the point.

episodes.name: True Killers
episodes.summary: As the counselors try to escape Camp Redwood, Jingles meets an old friend and Margaret prays to God for strength.

episodes.name: Red Dawn
episodes.summary: Brooke fights for her life inside a thriller, Xavier goes after Jingles, Margaret takes Chet on a boat trip, and Don gets ahead.

episodes.name: Episode 100
episodes.summary: After Brooke is arrested for multiple murders, the spirits at the camp settle into a life of dull, boring, murderous routine. Margaret makes a killing in macabre real estate, Trevor becomes a kept man, Richard goes to prison, and Jingles makes a new life for himself.

episodes.name: The Lady in White
episodes.summary: On their way to Redwood, Rita and Brooke give a man a lift. Jingles meets his mother for the first time since the 1950s, and Richard cuts his way into the musical festival.

episodes.name: Rest in Pieces
episodes.summary: Richard arrives at Redwood and finds two allies to help him in his battle against Jingles. Montana and Trevor are reunited, and Brooke and Donna reach their destination.

episodes.name: Final Girl
episodes.summary: Jingles' son comes to Redwood looking for closure, and learns the fate of his father and his victims.

episodes.name: Cape Fear
episodes.summary: A struggling writer, his pregnant wife, and their daughter move to an isolated beach town for the winter. Once they're settled in, the town's true residents begin to make themselves known.

episodes.name: Pale
episodes.summary: A quick fix for Harry's writer's block has unexpected side effects. Two eccentric locals offer Harry a helping hand.

episodes.name: Thirst
episodes.summary: Harry's newfound talent brings an unexpected visitor to town. Alma decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Blood Buffet
episodes.summary: The dark history of Provincetown and its residents are brought to light.

episodes.name: Gaslight
episodes.summary: Harry struggles to keep Alma under control. Doris is pushed past her limits.

episodes.name: Winter Kills
episodes.summary: Ursula devises a sinister plan. The Gardners write their final act.

episodes.name: Take Me to Your Leader
episodes.summary: A group of college students on a camping trip are swept up in a horrifying and deadly conspiracy decades in the making.

episodes.name: Inside
episodes.summary: The President struggles with the morality of a deal he must make.

episodes.name: Blue Moon
episodes.summary: An unexpected visitor arrives at the White House and reveals the details of the horrific plan.

episodes.name: The Future Perfect
episodes.summary: Mamie takes matters into her own hands. The fate of the future is revealed.

episodes.name: Something's Coming
episodes.summary: Mysterious deaths and disappearances ramp up in the city. A doctor makes a frightening discovery, and a local reporter becomes tomorrow's headline.

episodes.name: Thank You for Your Service
episodes.summary: Without the NYPD's help, Gino is forced to get resourceful. A traumatizing event brings dangerous suspects closer than ever.

episodes.name: Smoke Signals
episodes.summary: Without the NYPD's help, Gino is forced to get resourceful; a traumatizing event brings dangerous suspects closer than ever.

episodes.name: Black Out
episodes.summary: As darkness consumes the city, evil takes root in the unlikeliest of places.

episodes.name: Bad Fortune
episodes.summary: Hannah receives concerning news while Patrick suffers a loss; the city's most dangerous resident reveals his true motives.

episodes.name: The Body
episodes.summary: A chilling event from Patrick's past returns to haunt him; Gino and Henry are determined to uncover it at any cost.

episodes.name: The Sentinel
episodes.summary: Patrick's search reaches an epic conclusion. The group reshifts their focus, but a different plan is in store for Hannah.

episodes.name: Fire Island
episodes.summary: Terrifying events at Fire Island rupture the group and force them to reconsider everything.

episodes.name: Requiem 1981/1987 Part One
episodes.summary: As vitality expires, two old friends are led through uniques journeys of retrospection.

episodes.name: Requiem 1981/1987 Part Two
episodes.summary: Grief and peril dominate Gino; the discovery of a tragedy becomes a revelation for Adam.

episodes.name: Multiply Thy Pain
episodes.summary: After multiple failed attempts of IVF, actress Anna Victoria Alcott wants nothing more than to start a family. As the buzz around her recent film grows, she fears that something may be targeting her - and her pursuit of motherhood.

episodes.name: Rockabye
episodes.summary: It's awards season and Anna is primed to be a major player in contention. After a frightening encounter convinces her that she's being followed, she begins to question who she can trust.

episodes.name: When the Bough Breaks
episodes.summary: As Anna and Dex settle into their Hamptons sanctuary, the comfort begins to fade. Her circle of trust is slowly shrinking, and doubt creeps into Anna's head - could the evil be right under her nose?

episodes.name: Vanishing Twin
episodes.summary: With help from Siobhan, a major announcement helps restore Anna's public image. Behind closed doors however, something powerful seems to be taking over.

episodes.name: Preech
episodes.summary: Anna senses the dark presence closing in on her, closer than ever. Ms. Preecher reveals pieces of her past and may know the truth about what's happening to Anna and Dex.

episodes.name: Opening Night
episodes.summary: A glimpse into Anna's past reveals why she craves motherhood, while Dex's troubling family life is dragged into the spotlight.

episodes.name: Ave Hestia
episodes.summary: Entrenched in her grapple for fame and motherhood, Anna may be involved in a cycle much bigger - and older - than she realizes.

episodes.name: Little Gold Man
episodes.summary: The world around Anna is starting to crescendo in every way: her career path continues to skyrocket, while her personal life is more stressful than ever - just in time for Hollywood's big night.

episodes.name: The Auteur
episodes.summary: Her choices have unknowingly led to deadly consequences, but Anna can still have it all - for a price.
After a near-death experience, Ben provides hospice care for a mysterious client in an eerie penthouse.

episodes.name: 1:13 AM
episodes.summary: Ben struggles with some unusual hospice duties and learns how the job vacancy actually happened.

episodes.name: Rauhnacht
episodes.summary: While hosting a holiday party, Constance deals carefully with two surprise guests, all to keep the special night on course.

episodes.name: Is That All There Is?
episodes.summary: As Constance's evening winds down, the holiday guests have dark places to go and people to see.

episodes.name: Date Night
episodes.summary: A friend of Ben's girlfriend wants to reconnect, whether he is ready to face the past or not.

episodes.name: The Return of Devil's Night
episodes.summary: As an unseen threat closes in, the witches of Miss Robichaux's Academy turn to powers older than the school itself.

episodes.name: The Baddest Witch of Them All
episodes.summary: A home invasion like no other, and Cordelia's Coven finds its worst fears confirmed.

episodes.name: Hell No
episodes.summary: With an ungodly threat upon them, the witches strike a bargain that will cost someone dearly.

episodes.name: The Devil Is in the Details
episodes.summary: Alone and at a loss, Constance risks everything to reinvent her family's fate.

episodes.name: The Prodigal Son
episodes.summary: Under threat, the witches learn of an ancient evil that has shaped history's darkest hours.

episodes.name: Madison's Happy Ending
episodes.summary: When a charming stranger draws close to the Coven, Madison discovers an unexpected side to him.

episodes.name: Sisters in Arms
episodes.summary: Fiona confronts a family secret, while the Coven prepares for a foe worse than any they've faced.

episodes.name: Devil of a Good Time
episodes.summary: Cordelia's witches try their hardest to come together as their chances to save the world grow dim.

shows.title: Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
shows.summary: Phil Coulson heads an elite team of fellow agents with the worldwide law-enforcement organization known as S.H.I.E.L.D. (Strategic Homeland Intervention Enforcement and Logistics Division), as they investigate strange occurrences around the globe. Its members -- each of whom brings a specialty to the group -- work with Coulson to protect those who cannot protect themselves from extraordinary and inconceivable threats.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Joss Whedon, the creative genius behind the feature film "Marvel's The Avengers," one of the highest grossing films of all time, and of the iconic television series "Buffy The Vampire Slayer," has co-created "Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.," a dynamic, action-packed one-hour drama that brings back Agent Phil Coulson to lead a team of highly skilled agents to investigate extra-normal and super human people and events worldwide.

Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents travel to Peru to investigate an object of unknown origin, codenamed 0-8-4. But when he runs into Comandante Camilla Reyes, more than just sparks fly at 30,000 feet.

episodes.name: The Asset
episodes.summary: When the brilliant scientist Dr. Franklin Hall is kidnapped, Agent Coulson and his S.H.I.E.L.D. agents must race against the clock to locate him. Skye is their only way in -- pushing the team to their limits when the entire plan turns upside-down.

episodes.name: Eye Spy
episodes.summary: Agent Coulson and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team try to track down a mysterious woman who has single-handedly committed numerous high-stakes heists. But when the woman's identity is revealed, a troubling secret stands to ruin Coulson.

episodes.name: Girl in the Flower Dress
episodes.summary: An elusive girl in a flower dress may hold the key to the mystery that brings Coulson and team to Asia to rescue a young man with an unusual and dangerous power. Meanwhile, Skye has a secret that jeopardizes her relationship with the team right when they need her most.

episodes.name: FZZT
episodes.summary: When floating bodies turn up, Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D must hunt down an elusive killer. No one is safe -- not even the team.

episodes.name: The Hub
episodes.summary: Dangerous secrets are being kept from Coulson's team and he works the system to save Ward and Fitz when they are sent on a Level 8 classified mission that may end in tragedy.

episodes.name: The Well
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the events chronicled in the feature film THOR: THE DARK WORLD, Coulson and The Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. pick up the pieces -- one of which threatens to destroy a member of the team.

episodes.name: Repairs
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team are haunted by a mysterious force that threatens to destroy them all, and only a secret from May's past can save them.

episodes.name: The Bridge
episodes.summary: In a shocking cliffhanger episode, Coulson takes the war back to Centipede, and this time he brings in Mike Peterson for some super-soldier support. As they get closer to the truth, startling secrets are revealed and an unexpected twist threatens the team.

episodes.name: The Magical Place
episodes.summary: Coulson uncovers vital information about the mystery of his death, but, with Centipede out for blood, this knowledge may come at the cost of one of the team.

episodes.name: Seeds
episodes.summary: Coulson and May uncover startling information about Skye's past, while the team is swept into a storm at S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy.

episodes.name: T.R.A.C.K.S.
episodes.summary: Hot on the trail of the Clairvoyant, Coulson and his team board a mystery train that seems to be headed for certain death.

episodes.name: T.A.H.I.T.I.
episodes.summary: Coulson goes on the attack to save Skye - enlisting the aid of Ward's former S.O. John Garrett -- and uncovers shocking truths about his own life and S.H.I.E.L.D..

episodes.name: Yes Men
episodes.summary: When Coulson and his team are attacked by Lorelei - a deadly seductress who escaped from Asgard - Thor's Lady Sif, her longtime nemesis, steps in to try to save them.

episodes.name: End of the Beginning
episodes.summary: Agents Garrett and Triplett are back to help Coulson's team track down S.H.I.E.L.D.'S nefarious enemy - the Clairvoyant. But will Deathlok destroy them all to protect his master's identity?

episodes.name: Turn, Turn, Turn
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team find themselves without anyone they can trust, only to discover that they are trapped with a traitor in their midst.

episodes.name: Providence
episodes.summary: With Colonel Glenn Talbot now on their trail, Coulson and his team seek refuge in the last place anyone would look, where they begin to uncover S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most dangerous secrets -- secrets that could destroy them all.

episodes.name: The Only Light in the Darkness
episodes.summary: With their world turned upside down, Coulson races to save the life of his one true love as the mystery of "The Cellist," which began in Marvel's The Avengers.

episodes.name: Nothing Personal
episodes.summary: Just when there's no one left to trust, Agent Maria Hill -- from "Marvel's The Avengers" and "Marvel's Captain America: The Winter Solider" -- returns to team up with Coulson as S.H.I.E.L.D. is being destroyed around them.

episodes.name: Ragtag
episodes.summary: In the last episode before the epic season finale, Ward's betrayal and HYDRA's shocking secrets are revealed as Coulson's team goes undercover on a mission that leaves no one unscathed.

episodes.name: Beginning of the End
episodes.summary: Dark secrets are revealed as Coulson and his team put everything on the line to stop Garrett and the forces of HYDRA.

episodes.name: Shadows
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team are now wanted fugitives with limited resources -- but that's not stopping them from keeping the world safe from powerful and unseen threats everywhere. However, with new members they hardly know, will S.H.I.E.L.D. ever be trusted again?

episodes.name: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.summary: Hunted and running out of solutions, Coulson puts his team right in the line of fire in the hopes of saving them all. But with General Talbot, Hydra and Creel all on the attack, can they possibly survive? Meanwhile, a mysterious Doctor harbors some dangerous secrets that could destroy one of our core team members.

episodes.name: Making Friends and Influencing People
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team race against Hydra to get to Donnie Gill -- a dangerous gifted with the ability to freeze objects -- while Simmons is caught in the crossfire.

episodes.name: Face My Enemy
episodes.summary: While on a mission to learn more about the secrets of the mysterious writing, Coulson finds himself attacked by the only person he can trust: Agent Melinda May. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is trapped in an explosive situation, and it's up to Fitz to save them -- but is he up to it?

episodes.name: A Hen in the Wolf House
episodes.summary: Coulson's team is up against the beautiful and deadly Bobbi Morse -- Security Chief for Hydra. Meanwhile, Skye's father forces Raina to reunite him with his daughter at any cost.

episodes.name: A Fractured House
episodes.summary: The world turns against S.H.I.E.L.D. when Hydra impersonates them to attack The United Nations, and an unexpected enemy leads the charge to bring about their downfall.

episodes.name: The Writing on the Wall
episodes.summary: The team discovers murder victims with the alien glyphs on them that Coulson's been etching. All of Coulson's secrets and lies come to a head.

episodes.name: The Things We Bury
episodes.summary: Coulson and team find themselves in an epic face-off against Hydra to uncover an ancient secret, while Ward kidnaps his brother, Senator Christian Ward, for a violent trip down memory lane.

episodes.name: ...Ye Who Enter Here
episodes.summary: Discovers the ancient city before Hydra, but uncovering the secrets may require one of Coulson's team to make the ultimate sacrifice. Meanwhile, May and Skye race to get to Raina before Whitehall takes her.

episodes.name: What They Become
episodes.summary: Coulson and Whitehall's forces meet in an explosive confrontation that dramatically alters everyone's fates. Meanwhile, Skye discovers shocking secrets about her past, on the Winter finale.

episodes.name: Aftershocks
episodes.summary: In the midseason premiere, "Aftershocks," Coulson's team must deal with the consequences of their war with Hydra as shocking revelations threaten to tear them apart, and Hydra makes a dangerous move that may involve a traitor in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s midst.

episodes.name: Who You Really Are
episodes.summary: Coulson and team come to the aid of a confused Lady Sif, who has lost her memory after fighting with a mysterious warrior, whose true mission will send shockwaves through S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mac continue to hide their true mission from everyone close to them.

episodes.name: One of Us
episodes.summary: Cal seeks revenge on Coulson by assembling a team of Super Villains to destroy S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, May calls on renowned Dr. Andrew Garner, her charismatic ex-husband, with a crisis that threatens to tear the team apart.

episodes.name: Love in the Time of HYDRA
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team are still reeling from a shocking revelation that leaves the team fractured as they must decide what to do with one of their own. Meanwhile, Bobbi and Mack reveal their true allegiance to Hunter, while elsewhere, Ward and Agent 33 embark on a personal mission.

episodes.name: One Door Closes
episodes.summary: War comes to Coulson's doorstep in a way he never anticipated as shocking revelations are brought to light, and Skye struggles to control her new abilities but will soon make a decision that irrevocably changes her life.

episodes.name: Afterlife
episodes.summary: As Robert Gonzales makes his move, Coulson must do whatever it takes to protect the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. Meanwhile, Skye's journey to control her powers takes a surprising turn when she meets the enigmatic Inhuman named Lincoln.

episodes.name: Melinda
episodes.summary: The story of Melinda May's transformation into "The Cavalry" is revealed as she finds herself at a crossroads in the war between Coulson and Gonzales. As Skye learns more about her true heritage from Lincoln, the truth about the Inhumans will send her in a new direction.

episodes.name: The Frenemy of My Enemy
episodes.summary: Dangerous new alliance is formed as Coulson and Hunter turn to the last person anyone would expect - Grant Ward! As the war between S.H.I.E.L.D. factions continues, Skye and Lincoln will find themselves drawn into this conflict.

episodes.name: The Dirty Half Dozen
episodes.summary: Gonzales and Coulson must find a way to put their differences aside and work together against Hydra, even if it means teaming up with someone they don't trust.

episodes.name: Scars
episodes.summary: Skye is torn between her loyalty to S.H.I.E.L.D. and her connection to the Inhumans as tensions rise between the groups -- and Coulson reveals a secret he's been hiding from even those closest to him.

episodes.name: S.O.S.: Part 1
episodes.summary: In Part 1 of the two-part second-season finale, sacrifices are made by Agent Coulson and his team in order to get through a war, and relationships are permanently altered as a result.

episodes.name: S.O.S.: Part 2
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team launch a last-ditch attack on the helicarrier to stop Jiaying from unleashing the Terrigen crystals and wiping out S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.name: Laws of Nature
episodes.summary: Coulson and his team track down an outbreak of Inhumans and discover that someone is killing or capturing many of them... and it's not who they think. Meanwhile, Fitz takes desperate steps to recover Jemma, and Daisy and Mack ask Lincoln for help.

episodes.name: Purpose in the Machine
episodes.summary: The team turn to Asgardian Elliott Randolph for help deciphering the monolith and rescuring Jemma. Meanwhile, Grant abducts a key player in his quest to rebuild Hydra, while Lance begins his quest to find--and kill--Grant.

episodes.name: A Wanted (Inhu)man
episodes.summary: The ATCU launches a public alert to bring Lincoln in, and he reluctantly turns to Daisy for help when he realizes that he's in over his head. Meanwhile, Rosalind and Coulson negotiate a deal, and Lance and Melinda take the first step to infiltrating Hydra.

episodes.name: Devils You Know
episodes.summary: S.H.I.E.L.D. and the ATCU get a lead on the mysterious Inhuman killer, Lash. Meanwhile, Lance prepares for a face-to-face meeting with Grant, and Melinda turns to Coulson and Andrew for help.

episodes.name: 4,722 Hours
