episodes.summary: Jemma tells Fitz how she survived on the alien planet for six and a half months... and who helped her.

episodes.name: Among Us Hide…
episodes.summary: While Melinda recruits Bobbi to help her find Werner after his attack on Andrew, Lance joins Daisy and Mack to confirm if Rosalind's man Banks is the mysterious Lash. Meanwhiile, Fitz and Jemma continue to try and bring Will home.

episodes.name: Chaos Theory
episodes.summary: Melinda realizes who--and what--Andrew really is and confronts him. Meanwhile, Coulson has Daisy give Rosalind a tour of the Zephyr, and Lincoln reaches out to Mack for help.

episodes.name: Many Heads, One Tale
episodes.summary: Having gained Rosalind's trust, Coulson distracts her with a tour of the base while the rest of the team breaks into the ATCU headquarters to learn about the Inhumans they have captured and their attempts at a cure. Meanwhile,Grant learns the true secret of Hydra.

episodes.name: Closure
episodes.summary: After Grant strikes at Coulson through someone close to him, Coulson swears revenge and goes after the only thing that Grant cares about. Meanwhile, Mack takes command of S.H.I.E.L.D., and Jemma and Fitz are captured during a reconaissance mission.

episodes.name: Maveth
episodes.summary: Mack and his team invade the Hydra castle in the hopes of bringing Fitz and Coulson back through the portal. Meanwhile, on the alien world Grant's team find Will and Fitz convinces him to lead them to the extraction point.

episodes.name: Bouncing Back
episodes.summary: President Ellis sanctions Coulson to continue leading S.H.I.E.L.D. to deal with the Inhuman power. Meanwhile, Malick discovers that his new guest can speak, and Daisy's team encounters two new Inhumans in Bogota.

episodes.name: The Inside Man
episodes.summary: Coulson and a reluctant Talbot attend an international symposium on the Inhumans, and discover a traitor in their midst. Meanwhile, the team meets Talbot's new bodyguard, who may provide a vaccine against Terrigenesis.

episodes.name: Parting Shot
episodes.summary: A mission in Russia goes bad, and Bobbi and Lance are captured. To stop a coup and save S.H.I.E.L.D., the couple must make the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.name: Watchdogs
episodes.summary: A group calling themselves the Watchdogs vows to take out any Inhumans that they can find. They begin their campaign of terror by taking out an ATCu facility, but the team soon learn that the Watchdogs are a front for Hydra.

episodes.name: Spacetime
episodes.summary: Daisy tries to stop a future that she foresees due to an Inhuman's power. Meanwhile, Hive gives Gideon a taste of true power, and Giyera chooses sides.

episodes.name: Paradise Lost
episodes.summary: Hive calls a meeting of Hydra's inner circle to show them his true face... and to teach Gideon a lesson in loyalty. Meanwhile, Daisy and Lincoln contact a former Afterlife resident who has information on Hive, while the others investigate Hydra's newest purchase.

episodes.name: The Team
episodes.summary: Daisy's secret warriors rescue Coulson and his people from Hydra. However, when they return to base with a captive Gideon, Coulson realizes that there may be a traitor among them.

episodes.name: The Singularity
episodes.summary: While Coulson, Melinda, and Lincoln try to recover Daisy, Fitz, Jemma, and Mack go after a scientist who may hold the key to stopping Hive.

episodes.name: Failed Experiments
episodes.summary: Coulson sends a strike team to eliminate Hive before he poses a danger to the world. Meanwhile, Mack tries to save Daisy, and Lincoln insists on taking the anti-toxin that Fitz-Simmons has created to defeat Hive's parasites.

episodes.name: Emancipation
episodes.summary: After the Accords are passed, Coulson brings Talbot to the S.H.I.E.L.D. base to take inventory of their Inhumans. Meanwhile, Daisy helps Lincoln escape while Holden discovers the process to create Inhuman Primitives.

episodes.name: Absolution
episodes.summary: S.H.I.E.L.D. manages to stop the missile launch and capture Hive... only to discover that he's exactly where he wants to be. Meanwhile, Daisy tries to deal with the guilt of what she's done.

episodes.name: Ascension
episodes.summary: One of the team will have to sacrifice themselves to stop Hive from spreading the pathogen across the world.

episodes.name: The Ghost
episodes.summary: After the Sokovia Accords, S.H.I.E.L.D. is under new management. Jemma is advising the new Director, Coulson and Mack are in the field, Melinda is training an elite strike force, and Daisy has gone rogue taking down Watchdog resources. She comes across a mysterious serial killer known as "Ghost Rider" who is apparently the Spirit of Vengeance.... and will stop at nothing to get his grisly revenge.

episodes.name: Meet the New Boss
episodes.summary: Daisy tracks down Robbie and demands answers. Meanwhile, Fitz and Mack get a lead on the ghost that emerged from the box, and discover that there are more than one.

episodes.name: Uprising
episodes.summary: A group claiming to be the Inhumans Resistance launches a series of blackouts across the globe. Jeffrey suspects something more is going on and sends Coulson, Mack, and Fitz to investigate. Meanwhile, Daisy learns more about Robbie and his brother Gabe, and Jemma and Holden struggle to save Melinda's life.

episodes.name: Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire
episodes.summary: Daisy turns to Jemma for help, while Mack and Coulson pay a visit to Robbie's uncle Eli and encounter Ghost Rider. Meanwhile, Holden and Fitz use Melinda to test to see if Aida can pass as human.

episodes.name: Lockup
episodes.summary: Coulson and his people break into prison to free Eli before Lucy finds him. Meanwhile, Jeffrey goes before the nation to debate Senator Nadeer about the Inhuman issue.

episodes.name: The Good Samaritan
episodes.summary: How Robbie became Ghost Rider is revealed, after Jeffrey boards the Quinjet looking for Robbie and Daisy. Meanwhile, Lucy forces Eli to reveal the secrets of the Darkhold.

episodes.name: Deals with Our Devils
episodes.summary: Coulson, Fitz, and Robbie disappear and their teammates assume that they're dead... unaware that they're out of phase, intangible, and invisible. Meanwhile, Mack loses hope and the vengeance demon seeks a now host.

episodes.name: The Laws of Inferno Dynamics
episodes.summary: When Eli creates a nuclear bomb using his new powers, Fitz realizes where he is getting his energies from... and that they threaten to destroy LA. The team has to take Eli down before it's too late, but Eli manages to take Ghost Rider out of commission.

episodes.name: Broken Promises
episodes.summary: Jemma confirms Vijay's identity, and she, Jeffrey, and Daisy go to rescue him from his sister and the Watchdogs. Meanwhile, Aida attacks S.H.I.E.L.D. HQ in an attempt to obtain the Darkhold.

episodes.name: The Patriot
episodes.summary: After an attempt on Jeffrey's life, Coulson and Mack escort him to safety... and discover the secret of his Inhuman abilities. Meanwhile, Fitz promises the decapitated Aida that he'll try to restore her, and Melinda wakes up in Holden's apartment.

episodes.name: Wake Up
episodes.summary: Coulson authorizes a mission to bug Nadeer's office against Talbot's advice, but things go bad. Meanwhile, Holden finds the key to keeping Melinda imprisoned, and Fitz finds out what his friend is up to.

episodes.name: Hot Potato Soup
episodes.summary: The Superior and his men abduct Billy Koenig to get the location of the Darkhold from him. While Coulson and his field team go after Sam, Fitz, Jemma, and Mack deal with the Holden LMD that they captured.

episodes.name: BOOM
episodes.summary: The Superior sends Terrence to trigger Terragenesis in Nadeer, believing that she's an Inhuman. However, they all got an explosive surprise. Meanwhile, Coulson and Mack track down the woman that Aida's appearance was based on and try to use her to find Melinda.

episodes.name: The Man Behind the Shield
episodes.summary: The team follows a series of clues left by the Superior designed to bring them to their opponent's base... and the trap that he's set for them.

episodes.name: Self Control
episodes.summary: Fitz and Jemma realize that they may be the only senior staff that haven't been replaced with LMDs. Meanwhile, Aida makes her own plans to protect the Framework.

episodes.name: What If...
episodes.summary: Jemma and Daisy discover that things have gone horribly wrong in the Framework, when they realize that Hydra now rules the world and ruthlessly hunts down and exterminates Inhumans.

episodes.name: Identity and Change
episodes.summary: While Daisy tries to get Holden's location via Hydra's databases, Coulson and Jemma meet with the head of the resistance. Meanwhile, Aida tells Fitz her version of the truth about the Framework.

episodes.name: No Regrets
episodes.summary: Coulson and Jeffrey break into an Enlightenment Center to rescue a prisoner with valuable information about Project Looking Glass. Meanwhile, Fitz meets with an unexpected ally, and Jemma tries to convince Grant and Jeffrey that their world isn't real.

episodes.name: All the Madame's Men
episodes.summary: Daisy and Melinda escape the Triskelion and go on the run from Hydra. Meanwhile, Jemma realizes what Aida has planned, and Holden tells Alistair who he is in the real world.

episodes.name: Farewell, Cruel World!
episodes.summary: Daisy and Jemma take the team to the backdoor, only to discover that Aida has anticipated them. Meanwhile, Fitz discovers that his father is dead and who is responsible, and sets out to exact vengeance.

episodes.name: The Return
episodes.summary: While Coulson and Melinda try to escape the rig, Jemma and Daisy find themselves under attack. Meanwhile, Aida revels in the joys of becoming human.

episodes.name: World's End
episodes.summary: Aida sets out to destroy the world with the help of the Darkhold, and only Ghost Rider can stop her. Meanwhile, S.H.I.E.L.D. is framed for weaponizing the Inhumans and the authorities close in on the team.

episodes.name: Orientation (Part One)
episodes.summary: The team finds themselves on a mysterious outpost in space surrounded by corpses, and with no sign of Fitz. As they meet the inhabitants, the agents try to work out where they are.

episodes.name: Orientation (Part Two)
episodes.summary: As they come to their grips with their new surroundings, Coulson, Mack, and Elena are forced to make a deal with a crime lord, Grill. Meanwhile, Jemma is captured by the Kree, and Daisy discovers who was responsible for Earth's fate.

episodes.name: A Life Spent
episodes.summary: While Daisy tries to rescue Jemma, Coulson and his team search the rubble belt for a mysterious segment. Meanwhile, Jemma coaches a young Inhuman in her powers.

episodes.name: A Life Earned
episodes.summary: Kasius tells Daisy what her value is to him. Meanwhile, Grill tasks Mack with acting as his new enforcer, and Coulson and Melinda discover that Deke isn't being honest with them.

episodes.name: Rewind
episodes.summary: Fitz is left behind and the military locks him up. He soon plots an escape, and works out a way to travel to the future to rescue his friends.

episodes.name: Fun & Games
episodes.summary: Fitz makes contact with Jemma and tries to plan an escape. Meanwhile, the human teenagers undergo Terrigenesis and one of them reveals his new power.

episodes.name: Together or Not at All
episodes.summary: Faulnak sends his best hunter to recover Daisy, while Daisy, Fitz, and Jemma try to reunite with Coulson and the others. On the surface, Melinda meets Enoch.

episodes.name: The Last Day
episodes.summary: Coulson and the others meet up with the surface survivors, while Mack, Elena, and Flint battle the Roaches that Kasius has unleashed on the Lighthouse humans.

episodes.name: Best Laid Plans
episodes.summary: While Elena and Mack rally the humans to fight against Kasius, Coulson and the others try to find a way to return to the Lighthouse while Sinara comes looking for Daisy.

episodes.name: Past Life
episodes.summary: As Deke and Enoch prepare to open the time portal, Elena discovers who Kasius' Seer is while Daisy refuses to go back to 2018 and end up destroying the planet.

episodes.name: All the Comforts of Home
episodes.summary: Coulson and team return to 2018 and discover that they're fugitives from the government. A mysterious woman leads the government forces, and sets off a chain of events that may lead to the future that the team experienced.

episodes.name: The Real Deal
episodes.summary: The team discovers what Coulson has been hiding from them, as the monoliths' explosion causes a rift to a fear dimension that threatens to destroy them all.

episodes.name: Principia
episodes.summary: The team gets a lead on the Gravitonium they need to seal the rift once and for all. Meanwhile, Deke learns who his grandparents are, while Hale and Ruby recruit another member to their team.

episodes.name: The Devil Complex
episodes.summary: Fitz tries to seal the rift, and what appears to be his greatest fear materializes to help him. Meanwhile, Coulson and Melinda capture Hale only to discover that it's a trap.

episodes.name: Rise and Shine
episodes.summary: Hale's history with Hydra is revealed as she tries to convince Coulson to join forces with her. Meanwhile, Fitz asks for his freedom so that he can help find out why Hale wants their leader.

episodes.name: Inside Voices
episodes.summary: Coulson convinces one of Hale's people to help him. Meanwhile, Jemma and Elena come up with a plan to free Fitz, while Daisy and Melinda turn to Robin for help.

episodes.name: The Honeymoon
episodes.summary: Deke is injured trying to help Daisy, while Fitzsimmons and Elena discover what Hale has planned. Meanwhile, Melinda makes a confession to Coulson.

episodes.name: All Roads Lead…
episodes.summary: Daisy benches Coulson and takes a team to stop Ruby before she becomes the Destroyer of Worlds.

episodes.name: Option Two
episodes.summary: Qovas sends his men to get the Gravitonium, and finds a team torn apart by suspicion and distrust of each other... and no sign of Daisy.

episodes.name: The One Who Will Save Us All
episodes.summary: Talbot and Coulson go to negotiate with the Confederacy, while Daisy has Jemma find a way to make the Centipede technology work.

episodes.name: The Force of Gravity
episodes.summary: While Talbot pays his family a visit, Coulson and Melinda try to find a way off of the Confederacy spaceship.

episodes.name: The End
episodes.summary: A member of the team dies while trying to stop Talbot, who is intent on acquiring enough Gravitonium to fight Thanos. Meanwhile, the agents try to deal with Coulson's impending death.

episodes.name: Missing Pieces
episodes.summary: Daisy, Jemma, Piper, and Davis search the galaxy for Fitz. On Earth, Mac continues his command of S.H.I.E.L.D. as a series of dimensional anomalies spring up across the planet.

episodes.name: Window of Opportunity
episodes.summary: Sarge and his crew seek out a vital component to their plan, and S.H.I.E.L.D. slowly learns of their intentions while pursuing them. Fitz's position as an engineer on the Sivian ship is threatened... along with his life.

episodes.name: Fear and Loathing on the Planet of Kitson
episodes.summary: Daisy and her team track Fitz and Enoch to Kitson, where the unlikely duo have lost their ship and are trying to make enough money gambling to get off the planet.

episodes.name: Code Yellow
episodes.summary: What Deke has been up to is revealed, and he discovers that Sarge and his crew are after him. Meanwhile, Keller is infected by an alien parasite and Yo-Yo and Marcus try to save his life.

episodes.name: The Other Thing
episodes.summary: Sarge demonstrates to Miranda the magnitude of the threat Earth faces. Marcus gets a clue to the parasites' plans in Yucatan, and Enoch betrays his best friend.

episodes.name: Inescapable
episodes.summary: Atarah traps Fitz and Jemma in a mind prison and the only way out is for them to find a way for the remaining Chronicoms to travel back through time and save their homeworld. But to do so, the couple must face their inner demons.

episodes.name: Toldja
episodes.summary: Mack questions the captive Sarge, who has plans of his own. Fitz, Jemma, and Enoch return to Kitson and Mr. Kitson has words with them.

episodes.name: Collision Course (Part I)
episodes.summary: Mack sends Melinda, Daisy, and Deke with Sarge and Snowflake, while he holds Jaco and Pax. Meanwhile, Fitz and Jemma begin the journey back to Earth but find something odd going on involving Izel.

episodes.name: Collision Course (Part II)
episodes.summary: Sarge, Jaco, and Pax capture the Zephyr and prepare to go after Izel. The team in the trailer try to stop Sarge's bomb, and Izel questions Fitz-Simmons' loyalty.

episodes.name: Leap
episodes.summary: After Melinda tells Yo-yo that she has no memory of shooting Sarge, a deadly game of hide-and-seek ensues as the team realizes that Izel can possess anyone she wishes.

episodes.name: From the Ashes
episodes.summary: While Deke and Fitz-Simmons try to find a way to negate Izel's powers, Daisy tries to get Sarge to reveal who he truly is and Izel forces Marcus to take her to the temple.

episodes.name: The Sign
episodes.summary: Izel uses Flint's powers to open a gateway to her dimension and bring her people through. Melinda tries to convince Sarge that he's a good person with or without Coulson, and Deke has enough of everyone looking down on him.

episodes.name: New Life
episodes.summary: Melinda battles Izel, Daisy and Mack fight Sarge, and Yo-Yo deals with a problem from within. Fitz-Simmons have to deal with another situation where they have to change the course of their natural lives, and Sarge's true people prepare to invade Earth.

episodes.name: The New Deal
episodes.summary: Coulson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. are thrust backward in time and stranded in 1931 New York City. With the all-new Zephyr set to time-jump at any moment, the team must hurry to find out exactly what happened. If they fail, it would mean disaster for the past, present and future of the world.

episodes.name: Know Your Onions
episodes.summary: With the identity of the timeline-unraveling "thread" revealed, the team's mission to protect him at all costs leads each agent to question their own values.

episodes.name: Alien Commies from the Future!
episodes.summary: A surprise leap forward in time has stranded Enoch in 1931 and landed the team in yet another unfamiliar decade. Now, in order to stop the chronicoms from launching their newest future-dismantling plan, the agents will have to infiltrate one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most secure bases. They won't be able to succeed without help from a familiar face or two.

episodes.name: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: It was just another average morning on July 22, 1955, when Agent Phil Coulson realized the importance of that day in the S.H.I.E.L.D. history books. With a chip on his shoulder and a genre-bending glitch in his system, he'd set into motion a chain of events that would hopefully preserve the timeline as we know it and ensure those pesky chronicoms get the ending they deserve. What could go wrong?

episodes.name: A Trout in the Milk
episodes.summary: After a bumpy landing in the disco decade, the team – Daniel Sousa in tow – reunites with more than one familiar face at the S.H.I.E.L.D. hangout and discovers exactly how to dismantle the Chronicoms' latest plan. But when they get too close for comfort, the Zephyr unexpectedly leaps forward again, this time to a date pivotal to not only the future of S.H.I.E.L.D. but to the future of Director Mack as well.

episodes.name: Adapt or Die
episodes.summary: The team must scramble to rescue Mack's parents, save S.H.I.E.L.D. from a chronicom infestation and fix the ship, all before the next time-jump. Meanwhile, Daisy and Sousa find themselves at a disadvantage against a power hungry Nathaniel Malick and his goons, and Coulson will have to do the thing he does best in order to save the future.

episodes.name: The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D
episodes.summary: After being unexpectedly stranded in 1982, Mack retreats to his childhood home to process the death of his parents, while Deke gets to work scouting a chart-topping group of new agents. With no idea if or when the team is coming back for them, time seems to finally be on their side ... at least until the killer robots show up.

episodes.name: After, Before
episodes.summary: With the Zephyr's time drive malfunctioning, the team is quite literally hurling toward disaster and Yo-Yo may be their only hope. The only problem? To get her powers back, she'll need to enlist the help of an old adversary and revisit part of her past long hidden away.

episodes.name: As I Have Always Been
episodes.summary: A time storm ravages the Zephyr, propelling it toward destruction while simultaneously forcing Daisy and Coulson to relive their failed attempts to save the team over and over, until they find a solution or are swallowed by the storm. Making it to their next destination will take trust, courage and sacrifice from everyone on board, but it will all come down to having enough time.

episodes.name: Stolen
episodes.summary: After Enoch's sacrifice propelled them out of the time storm, the team arrives back in 1983 where Nathanial and Kora are hard at work building an army of hand-selected anarchist Inhumans at Afterlife. When the agents split up to cover more ground, Daisy is tasked with protecting Jiaying and is compelled to confront her mother for the first time since her death; while the others quickly learn they'll need to face yet another supercharged former enemy in order to stop Malick.

episodes.name: Brand New Day
episodes.summary: With the help of Kora on the inside, Sibyl and Nathanial continue their fight to shape a dark new future for S.H.I.E.L.D., managing to stay one step ahead of the agents along the way. If the team is going to turn this one around, they'll have to get creative, and maybe even a little out of this world.

episodes.name: The End Is at Hand
episodes.summary: With their backs against the wall and Nathaniel and Sibyl edging ever closer to eliminating S.H.I.E.L.D. from the history books, the agents must rely on their strengths to outsmart and outlast the Chronicoms. This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.

episodes.name: What We're Fighting For
episodes.summary: This is their most important fight, and it will take the help of friends and teammates, past and present, to survive.

shows.title: Fargo
shows.summary: Fargo is a seasonal anthology crime drama with some dark comical elements, inspired by the film Fargo written by the Coen brothers. Each season follows a new case and new characters, all entrenched in the trademark humor, murder and "Minnesota nice" that has made the film an enduring classic.

episodes.name: The Crocodile's Dilemma
episodes.summary: A ruthless, manipulative man meets a small town insurance salesman and sets him on a path of destruction.

episodes.name: The Rooster Prince
episodes.summary: Molly begins to suspect that Lester is involved with the murders, but her new boss points her in a different direction. Meanwhile, Malvo investigates the blackmail plot against a man known as the Supermarket King.

episodes.name: A Muddy Road
episodes.summary: Malvo flips the script on the blackmail operation, Molly sets a trap, and Gus debates whether he should come clean. Meanwhile, Lester's return to work has complicated repercussions.

episodes.name: Eating the Blame
episodes.summary: When Gus tries to right a wrong, Malvo embraces his alter ego. Lester finds himself in a surprising situation, and Molly uncovers a promising lead.

episodes.name: The Six Ungraspables
episodes.summary: When Lester has a close call, Molly makes an unorthodox decision. Gus weighs some neighborly advice, and Malvo gets what he wants.

episodes.name: Buridan's Ass
episodes.summary: Malvo executes his master plan, while Lester attempts to craft one of his own. Gus and Molly team up in Duluth.

episodes.name: Who Shaves the Barber?
episodes.summary: Malvo seeks answers, while Lester finagles a few of his own. Molly and Gus try to get past a setback in the investigation.

episodes.name: The Heap
episodes.summary: Molly faces pressure to close the case, while Lester starts to feel like a new man.

episodes.name: A Fox, a Rabbit, and a Cabbage
episodes.summary: Lester has an unexpected encounter, Malvo changes course, and a new investigation leads Molly down a familiar path.

episodes.name: Morton's Fork
episodes.summary: Molly takes the lead, while Gus pursues a hunch. Lester manipulates a situation, and Malvo finds a new target.

episodes.name: Waiting for Dutch
episodes.summary: In 1979, an unexpected turn of events at a diner disrupts the lives of the citizens in a small Minnesota town.

episodes.name: Before the Law
episodes.summary: The Gerhardts get a surprising offer, and two unlikely murderers do their best to clean up their mess.

episodes.name: The Myth of Sisyphus
episodes.summary: The Gerhardts' search for Rye intensifies, Lou takes a trip to Fargo, and Peggy overhears a new theory about the Waffle Hut shooter.

episodes.name: Fear and Trembling
episodes.summary: Floyd responds to Kansas City's proposal, Hanzee takes a road trip, and Lou has a realization.

episodes.name: The Gift of the Magi
episodes.summary: Floyd takes action, and Charlie tries to prove himself. Peggy and Ed disagree about what to do next, while Lou finds himself sidelined during Ronald Reagan's campaign tour.

episodes.name: Rhinoceros
episodes.summary: Lou and Hank try to prevent an altercation, Peggy and Ed defend their choices and the Gerhardt clan attempts to get back one of their own.

episodes.name: Did You Do This? No, You Did It!
episodes.summary: Lou and Hank investigate in Fargo, The King of Breakfast visits Betsy and Molly, Floyd is summoned away and Bear questions a family member's loyalty.

episodes.name: Loplop
episodes.summary: Hanzee searches for Peggy and Ed. Dodd ends up in unfamiliar territory.

episodes.name: The Castle
episodes.summary: Peggy and Ed agree to follow through with their plan at the Motor Motel, Lou faces jurisdictional politics and Hanzee reports back to the Gerhardts.

episodes.name: Palindrome
episodes.summary: Peggy and Ed make a run for it.

episodes.name: The Law of Vacant Places
episodes.summary: A petty sibling rivalry between two brothers escalates and brings chaos to a small Minnesotan community.

episodes.name: The Principle of Restricted Choice
episodes.summary: Gloria deals with the aftermath of a crime, Vargas makes a move, and Ray and Nikki move on to Plan B.

episodes.name: The Law of Non-Contradiction
episodes.summary: Gloria revisits her stepfather's past to try and find some answers.

episodes.name: The Narrow Escape Problem
episodes.summary: Emmit and Sy try to figure out what they've gotten themselves into, Nikki and Ray track down some collateral, and Gloria learns more about Maurice.

episodes.name: The House of Special Purpose
episodes.summary: Nikki and Ray's retaliation has consequences for Emmit. Meanwhile, Gloria and Winnie start connecting the dots.

episodes.name: The Lord of No Mercy
episodes.summary: Gloria and Winnie get closer to the truth, Emmit tries to make things right, Nikki and Ray prepare for payback and Varga cleans up a mess.

episodes.name: The Law of Inevitability
episodes.summary: Gloria tries to work around the system, Nikki finds herself in a familiar place, Varga comes up with an alternative plan and Emmit goes to dinner.

episodes.name: Who Rules the Land of Denial?
episodes.summary: Nikki struggles to survive, Emmit gets spooked and Sy joins Varga for tea.

episodes.name: Aporia
episodes.summary: Emmit sits down with Gloria, while Nikki negotiates a deal.

episodes.name: Somebody to Love
episodes.summary: Gloria follows the money, Nikki plays a game and Emmit learns a lesson about progress from Varga.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Alternate Economy
episodes.summary: An uneasy peace between two Kansas City crime syndicates is threatened by an untimely death. Meanwhile, the Smutny family is caught between a rock and a hard place.

episodes.name: The Land of Taking and Killing
episodes.summary: The Smutnys receive unexpected guests, Josto and Gaetano reunite, Loy challenges the status quo and Oraetta is caught.

episodes.name: Raddoppiarlo
episodes.summary: Deafy and Odis join forces, Josto seeks revenge, Oraetta finds new employment, Gaetano makes a move and Zelmare and Swanee help the Smutnys with their debt.

episodes.name: The Pretend War
episodes.summary: Loy retaliates, Josto asserts his leadership, Ethelrida makes a disturbing discovery and the walls begin to close in on Odis.

episodes.name: The Birthplace of Civilization
episodes.summary: Josto strikes back, Ethelrida does the right thing, Loy finds himself against the ropes and Deafy shakes the tree.

episodes.name: Camp Elegance
episodes.summary: Loy goes on the attack, Gaetano pays the piper, Oraetta goes off the deep end, Josto challenges orders and Rabbi puts his life on the line.

episodes.name: Lay Away
episodes.summary: Josto makes a bold move, Loy battles his demons and Oraetta silences her critics.

episodes.name: The Nadir
episodes.summary: Loy plays with fire, Josto wears his heart on his sleeve, Oraetta makes a surprising discovery and Deafy closes in on Zelmare and Swanee.

episodes.name: East/West
episodes.summary: Rabbi and Satchel hit the road.

episodes.name: Happy
episodes.summary: Loy forms an uneasy alliance, Odis finds peace, Josto settles the score, Ethelrida takes a risk and Oraetta gets spooked.

episodes.name: Storia Americana
episodes.summary: Josto gets revenge, Oraetta comes clean and Ebal teaches Loy a lesson about business.

episodes.name: The Tragedy of the Commons
episodes.summary: A series of unexpected events lands Dot in hot water and she is plunged back into a life she thought she left behind.

episodes.name: Trials and Tribulations
episodes.summary: Roy attempts to reset the "natural order of things" and Lorraine becomes increasingly suspicious.

episodes.name: The Paradox of Intermediate Transactions
episodes.summary: Dot and Wayne protect their home, Roy neutralizes an obstacle. Witt suspects foul play and Gator makes a move.

episodes.name: Insolubilia
episodes.summary: Munch makes a bold move, Indira and Witt have questions, Wayne takes a fall and Gator disappoints.

episodes.name: The Tiger
episodes.summary: Dot creates diversions, Roy meets his match and Indira helps a new friend.

episodes.name: The Tender Trap
episodes.summary: Lorraine calls things off, Gator asks questions, Wayne makes a surprising discovery and Indira offers a new perspective.

episodes.name: Linda
episodes.summary: Dot takes a fantastic journey.

episodes.name: Blanket
episodes.summary: Roy's campaign continues, Indira takes a stand and Witt tries to help.

episodes.name: The Useless Hand
episodes.summary: The tide turns.

episodes.name: Bisquik
episodes.summary: Lorraine makes a visit and Dot prepares biscuits.

shows.title: Hemlock Grove
shows.summary: Secrets are just a part of daily life in the small Pennsylvania town of Hemlock Grove, where the darkest evils hide in plain sight.

episodes.name: Jellyfish in the Sky
episodes.summary: A cheerleader from a rival high school is murdered in the opener of this supernatural series set in a Pennsylvania steel town. The evidence points to an animal attack, but suspicion soon falls on a young gypsy who recently moved to town.

episodes.name: The Angel
episodes.summary: Roman confronts Peter at the crime scene; Letha reveals a surprising secret; Olivia and Norman fall back into old habits.

episodes.name: The Order of the Dragon
episodes.summary: Christina discovers a new victim; Peter teams with Roman to find the killer; Sheriff Sworn gets outside help from Dr. Chasseur.

episodes.name: In Poor Taste
episodes.summary: Letha's interest in Peter takes a turn; Chasseur and Sworn's investigation hits a new low; Roman and Peter stay one step ahead.

episodes.name: Hello, Handsome
episodes.summary: Shelley's connection to Dr. Pryce is further revealed; Destiny helps Peter understand the recent murder; the gala at the Tower goes horribly awry.

episodes.name: The Crucible
episodes.summary: Peter and Roman uncover new information when they follow Lisa Willoughby's trail to the old steel mill. Meanwhile, Christina's date goes poorly.

episodes.name: Measure of Disorder
episodes.summary: Shelley commits an act of independence; Chasseur questions Roman and crosses paths with Olivia; Peter and Roman's friendship takes a turn.

episodes.name: Catabasis
episodes.summary: Roman falls into a coma and goes on a subconscious journey of shocking truths and revelations.

episodes.name: What Peter Can Live Without
episodes.summary: Letha's relationship with Peter is discovered by her parents; Chasseur prepares to capture the killer.

episodes.name: What God Wants
episodes.summary: Roman comes out of his coma and reunites with Peter to stop the killer. Meanwhile, the citizens of Hemlock Grove brace themselves for another lethal full moon.

episodes.name: The Price
episodes.summary: Vigilantes hunt the killer, and Peter and his mother hide from them. Meanwhile, Christina disappears; and Roman begins to face the truth about his nature.

episodes.name: Children of the Night
episodes.summary: Peter and Roman uncover the killer's identity; Olivia and Chasseur face off at the mill; Shelley learns the disturbing truth about her family.

episodes.name: Birth
episodes.summary: The conclusion to the Hemlock Grove killing spree leaves both the Godfrey and Rumancek families devastated. Meanwhile, a final horror approaches.

episodes.name: Blood Pressure
episodes.summary: Roman takes charge of the Godfrey institute in Olivia's absence. Roman has problems with his feeding habits. Peter has money issues and has to resort to abstract measures to help his mother. Olivia rehabilites as Roman takes up dispute with Dr Pryce.

episodes.name: Gone Sis
episodes.summary: Peter finds a job and Roman continues with dangerous ways to quench his thirst for blood. Peter and Roman both encounter a new character named Miranda through an unusual turn of events. Olivia and Pryce try to reach out to Roman as their secret experiments continue. Investigation into Peter's dreams by Destiny suggests what could be an upcoming threat.

episodes.name: Luna Rea
episodes.summary: Peter and Roman continue to have dreams that consistently seem to end with them meeting eachother again. There is further worry of the effects of Peter turning at the wrong time. Olivia and Pryce continue to fail in keeping Roman under control as he relentlessly inquires into the basement section of the company. Norman attempts to reconnect and help Olivia. Peter meets again with Miranda and those that he stole money from quickly understand their situation.

episodes.name: Bodily Fluids
episodes.summary: Roman's urges for blood become more and more dangerous. Miranda tries to snoop more into Roman's affairs. The sheriff and Norman are both concerned about the disappearance of Mire Godfrey. Shelley continues to form a bond with the child. The men that Peter obtained his money from attempt vengeance.

episodes.name: Hemlock Diego's Policy Player's Dream Book
episodes.summary: Roman decides to attempt Pryce's treatment as his need for blood becomes too much. Miranda continues to feed the Roman's baby and investigate into why she is lactating. Peter's mother finds herself in more trouble and Peter tries desperately to help her. Olivia begins to realise her potential mortality. Norman finally receives contact from shelley.

episodes.name: Such Dire Stuff
episodes.summary: Roman undergoes radical treatment by Pryce causing Olivia to have a dispute with Pryce. Some information is revealed about the masked killers as one of their attempts goes wrong. Norman attempts to find Shelley. Miranda causes a conflict having slept with both Roman and Peter spiralling into a bizarre turn of events.

episodes.name: Lost Generation
episodes.summary: The sheriff pursues ideas from Peter's dreams and also speaks with Roman. Peter and Roman attempt to follow their dreams to the source; trying to find the unknown masked killers and save a family. Roman continues to undergo treatment to make him human. Shelley is reunited with her family while she consults with Dr Pryce.

episodes.name: Unicorn
episodes.summary: Roman and Peter have an encounter with the sherriff after the two masked killers they encountered. Roman, Peter and Miranda get closer to understanding the masked killers with yet again the help of destiny. Olivia's health continues to decay. Shelley begins to undergo Pryce's treatment.

episodes.name: Tintypes
episodes.summary: Peter undergoes torture by the white masked people and we learn more about their philosophy. Roman and Shelley both set out to begin the final part of their treatments. Norman and the Sherriff continue to scheme against Olivia and consider killing her.

episodes.name: Demons and the Dogstar
episodes.summary: Everyone clears up after the previous attack on Roman's house. Lot's of anarchy ensues when all parties are informed of Shelley's operation. Norman and the Sheriff continue to take dispute with Olivia. Everyone realises the importance of the baby and war in accordance.

episodes.name: A Place to Fall
episodes.summary: The search for Miranda and Nadia digs into Spivak's past. Roman has an encounter with a mysterious stranger. Andreas and Destiny plan their future.

episodes.name: Souls on Ice
episodes.summary: Annie reveals her secrets to Roman as they probe a connection between two attacks. Olivia is unable to feed and Miranda must fend for herself.

episodes.name: The House in the Woods
episodes.summary: Pryce deduces the nature of the creature and looks for links to the Spivak monster. Roman explores upir customs. Peter grills Andreas about the heist.

episodes.name: Every Beast
episodes.summary: Peter makes a bold move to head off a war between the Gypsies and the Croatian mob. After an agonizing detox, Pryce delivers disturbing news.

episodes.name: Boy in the Box
episodes.summary: Ochoa encourages Olivia to reach out to Annie. Destiny's sanity begins to crumble in Andreas's absence, and Pryce is besieged by childhood memories.

episodes.name: Pendant
episodes.summary: As Olivia's condition worsens, she drops a bombshell on Roman. The wolf pack shuns Peter, who struggles to hide the truth about Andreas from Destiny.

episodes.name: Todo Santos
episodes.summary: A plan to save Olivia requires a search for the perfect mark at an upir conference. Destiny confronts Roman about Andreas.

episodes.name: Dire Night on the Worm Moon
episodes.summary: Aitor ponders leaving Hemlock Grove and asks Shelley to join him. Roman manipulates Peter into turning on Milan.

episodes.name: Damascus
episodes.summary: Gruesome discoveries await Roman and Peter at Spivak's cabin. As Olivia's time runs out, she targets her son. Pryce consoles a heartbroken Shelley.

episodes.name: Brian's Song
episodes.summary: Blinsky tends to Roman's wounds at the White Tower. After leaving Nadia with Shelley, Annie confronts Olivia about her father's death.

shows.title: Helix
shows.summary: Helix is a science fiction thriller that focuses on a CDC expedition into the arctic. They go there to investigate the potential outbreak of a disease with no idea what they are getting themselves into. They encounter an almost zombie-like threat that could threaten mankind itself whilst the operator of the facility seems to know more than what he is saying.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: A team of scientists are thrust into a potentially life-or-death situation after being deployed to the Arctic to secretly investigate what could be a disease outbreak.

episodes.name: Vector
episodes.summary: Dr. Alan Farragut and his team work to treat the outbreak patients and contain the virus, while at the same time a rebellion erupts at the Arctic Biosystems base.
The team have every hope that the virus is contained, but unfortunately it continues to spread at an alarming rate; at the same time, some of the secrets the docs are keeping prove to be deadly.

episodes.name: Single Strand
episodes.summary: Alan and the team deal with secrets and suspicion as the crisis heightens and deadly consequences follow. Meanwhile, Walker tries to survive on Level R.

episodes.name: The White Room
episodes.summary: Members of the CDC team come to the realization that nobody is who they seem to be at the base.

episodes.name: Aniqatiga
episodes.summary: Alan and Jordan make progress in decoding the virus; Hatake secretly "cures" Walker before the corporation's black helicopters land on the base.

episodes.name: Survivor Zero
episodes.summary: Daniel makes a discovery; Hatake protects Walker from Sutton's mercenaries.

episodes.name: Bloodline
episodes.summary: The vectors attack and take Peter's body; Walker is held prisoner by Sutton after the true nature of Sutton's relationship with Hatake is revealed.

episodes.name: Level X
episodes.summary: Secrets come to the light and unlikely alliances are established; at the same time, Alan and Walker take on a dangerous mission to destroy what's left of the NARVIK virus.

episodes.name: Fushigi
episodes.summary: Alan and Julia travel to an abandoned satellite station in a last-ditch effort to call for help. Once there, they come across the truth behind Hatake's plan and Julia's condition. Meanwhile, Dr. Jordan makes a startling discovery of her own, which could mean a cure for cancer.

episodes.name: Black Rain
episodes.summary: Peter leads the Vectors in a desperate final attempt to spread the virus, while the CDC scientists work together and successfully create a cure just as their lives come under threat from Ilaria Corporation's deadly mercenaries.

episodes.name: The Reaping
episodes.summary: Alan, Walker, Hatake and Daniel set a trap for an assassin who has been sent by Ilaria to retrieve both the virus and the cure.

episodes.name: Dans L'Ombre
episodes.summary: In the Season 1 finale, Alan and Walker battle the Scythe to save the world from disaster.

episodes.name: San Jose
episodes.summary: In the second-season premiere, Drs. Peter Farragut and Sarah Jordan are joined by Kyle Sommer when they battle a new deadly virus on a mysterious wooded island.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.summary: The CDC team continue to investigate the island; at the same time, they discover Peter's brother, Alan, is a member of Brother Michael's cult, and his warnings for them to leave the abbey fall on deaf ears.

episodes.name: Scion
episodes.summary: Jordan and Peter travel outside the safety of the abbey to retrieve some specimens and discover just what's living in the woods; at the same time, Sister Amy plots to make the CDC team leave forever.

episodes.name: Densho
episodes.summary: Michael struggles to keep the abbey under control as the CDC team move closer toward tracking the source of the pathogen; at the same time, Alan fights the urge to rejoin his former colleagues and comes to terms with the reality about Peter's allegiances. In the future, Walker takes a risk attempting to escape her delusional father.

episodes.name: Oubliette
episodes.summary: Peter reveals is brother's secret and gets them both in trouble; at the same time, Kyle has his hands full trying to quarantine the orchard and the infected hive.

episodes.name: M. Domestica
episodes.summary: The CDC team are forced to work together when another outbreak threatens to overwhelm the Abbey.

episodes.name: Cross-Pollination
episodes.summary: Things go from bad to worse on the island. Elsewhere, Walker decides to go to St. Germain after learning about Brother Michael.

episodes.name: Vade in Pace
episodes.summary: Sister Amy makes a power play for control of the Abbey as Alan and Kyle discover a possible cure for the virus.

episodes.name: Ectogenesis
episodes.summary: Alan, Kyle and Winger search the woods for the tree with red sap that might be a cure for the pathogen.

episodes.name: Mother
episodes.summary: At the abbey, Sister Amy makes a bargain for immortality; and in the woods, the race to find the Bleeding Tree intensifies now that Kyle is infected.

episodes.name: Plan B
episodes.summary: The Navy prepare to implement Plan B, a final solution to ensure that the virus and everyone infected with it never make it off the island.

episodes.name: The Ascendant
episodes.summary: Kyle and Jordan attempt to flee the island, but their escape is made more difficult by the followers who are hunting them down; Walker and Alan plan to halt ILARIA's deadly plan as soon as they find the Mother Tree.

episodes.name: O Brave New World
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, Alan's relationship with Walker reaches a bloody climax, while his sibling feud with Peter erupts in flames. Elsewhere, Kyle does his best to protect a possible cure for the mycosis.

shows.title: The Killing
shows.summary: The Killing follows Seattle homicide detectives Stephen Holder and Sarah Linden and their work as detectives investigating murders. Sarah Linden takes cases very seriously and has issues keeping her work and family separate, as she pairs up with recovering addict Stephen Holder to solve dark murders.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: A detective's last day in homicide finds her investigating the disappearance of a 17-year-old girl who was supposed to be spending the weekend with a friend from school in the opener of this crime-drama series. When the teen's parents learn she didn't show up for class on Monday, they launch their own search, and when word gets out about the missing girl, a mayoral candidate cancels a forum planned at the high school.

episodes.name: The Cage
episodes.summary: Linden and Holder visit Rosie's high school to question classmates and teachers about where she may have gone after the dance; Richmond and his staff go into spin mode over the fact that the victim was found in a car linked to his campaign.

episodes.name: El Diablo
episodes.summary: Police try to determine the connection between the teen girl's murder and the grisly crime scene at "The Cage" in the basement of the high school.

episodes.name: A Soundless Echo
episodes.summary: Rosie's ex-boyfriend Jasper comes under pressure from Sarah and Holder, who also grill a new suspect about the murder. The victim's best friend, Sterling, spills some astonishing secrets about Rosie's personal life. Meanwhile, grief-stricken Stan and Mitch plan their daughter's funeral service, and candidate Richmond seeks a financial shot-in-the-arm at a ritzy party, where he hopes to raise funds.

episodes.name: Super 8
episodes.summary: One of Rosie's teachers provides Sarah and Holder with crucial new evidence. Meanwhile, the Richmond campaign comes up with an anticrime TV spot; and Stan steps up his search for Rosie's killer and enlists Belko's help.

episodes.name: What You Have Left
episodes.summary: A suspect's family, neighbors and friends are grilled by Sarah and Holder. Meanwhile, Richmond and his campaign adviser Gwen don't see eye-to-eye on strategy for his upcoming debate with the mayor; Rosie's funeral is held; and Stan intensifies his own investigation into his daughter's murder.

episodes.name: Vengeance
episodes.summary: The police discover more about Rosie's activities the night of her murder; candidate Richmond's campaign is in danger of being stopped in its tracks by a negative ad, and he takes action; and Mitch begins to wonder about the direction of the police department's investigation.

episodes.name: Stonewalled
episodes.summary: While steering clear of the FBI, Sarah and Holder uncover some surprising new evidence; Richmond scrambles to get back into the mayoral race; and Mitch's actions endanger her sons, leaving Stan to try and gain the upper hand.

episodes.name: Undertow
episodes.summary: Police efforts to make an arrest hit a roadblock; Richmond reconsiders his place in the race; and the Larsens tire of the police's inability to collar a suspect and decide to take matters into their own hands.

episodes.name: I'll Let You Know When I Get There
episodes.summary: The police must regroup after they have second thoughts about a prime suspect, which has a big impact on Richmond's standings in the polls. Meanwhile, Stan's actions could quite possibly land him behind bars.

episodes.name: Missing
episodes.summary: The investigation takes an interesting turn when Sarah and Holder learn more about Rosie's whereabouts on the night of her murder. But everything must be put on hold when Jack goes missing, and the two detectives go searching for him.

episodes.name: Beau Soleil
episodes.summary: As the investigation continues, Rosie is tied to an unusual Web site; work is halted on the waterfront project, which gives Richmond's campaign a shot in the arm; and imprisoned Stan comes to grips with his demons, while Mitch uncovers secrets about her murdered daughter.

episodes.name: Orpheus Descending
episodes.summary: The identification of the mysterious Orpheus provides a vital connection to the case; Mitch and Stan reflect on the past while contemplating their family's future

episodes.name: Reflections
episodes.summary: Sarah returns to Seattle to look into a possible cover-up involving the events that led to Councilman Richmond's arrest, and she wonders if she can ever really trust Holder again.

episodes.name: My Lucky Day
episodes.summary: An unsettling discovery is made at the Larsen house while Sarah is on her way to Tacoma, where she uncovers a revealing secret about Richmond.

episodes.name: Numb
episodes.summary: Sarah searches for Rosie's backpack, while Richmond comes to grips with his situation and Mitch finally turns up. Later, Stan's involvement with the mob proves troublesome.

episodes.name: Ogi Jun
episodes.summary: The tattooed mystery man is identified; Jamie seeks help from Gwen; Stan's troubled past catches up to him.

episodes.name: Ghosts of the Past
episodes.summary: Sarah receives a message from the dead that may shed light on the identity of Rosie's killer. Meanwhile, Mitch befriends a young runaway; and Richmond has grave doubts about his future in politics.

episodes.name: Openings
episodes.summary: Sarah zeros in on a Larsen-family secret; Stan comes to grips with some past indiscretions; and Mitch takes in a runaway girl. Meanwhile, the Richmond campaign entertains a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Keylala
episodes.summary: The investigation refocuses on the casino; Stan has an uneasy face-to-face with Richmond; tension grips the Larsen house.

episodes.name: Off the Reservation
episodes.summary: Holder disappears and a desperate Sarah goes looking for him; Stan decides to take matters into his own hands; and Richmond returns to City Hall.

episodes.name: Sayonara Hiawatha
episodes.summary: Richmond lends support to the investigation; Sarah tries to track down Rosie's key; and Stan deals with his troubled son.

episodes.name: 72 Hours
episodes.summary: Sarah is at her wit's end; Stan tries to mend fences; and Richmond gets a surprise boost in the mayoral race.

episodes.name: Bulldog
episodes.summary: A return to the casino winds up sending Sarah and Holder on the run, while Stan and Richmond face life-altering decisions.

episodes.name: Donnie or Marie
episodes.summary: Sarah and Holder close in on the murderer. Meanwhile, the Richmond campaign preps for the election; and the Larsens seek to get their lives back in order.

episodes.name: What I Know
episodes.summary: Sarah and Holder's investigation comes to a close. Meanwhile, Richmond sets out on a bold new course; and a surprise source helps bring closure to the Larsens.

episodes.name: The Jungle
episodes.summary: Holder is assigned a disturbing case in the third-season premiere.

episodes.name: That You Fear the Most
episodes.summary: Sarah makes a grim discovery about a case from her past.

episodes.name: Seventeen
episodes.summary: Sarah joins the task force with an agenda of her own; and Holder finds a new street informant. Meanwhile, Seward stokes an old rivalry.

episodes.name: Head Shots
episodes.summary: The task force shuts down a business; Sarah and Holder unite; and Seward is offered motivation to comply with orders.

episodes.name: Scared and Running
episodes.summary: Bullet races to find a victim on the run. Elsewhere, Seward is an unkind host to surprise visitors.

episodes.name: Eminent Domain
episodes.summary: Sarah and Holder catch up to the latest victim; Seward comes face-to-face with his past; and Bullet struggles with the truth.

episodes.name: Hope Kills
episodes.summary: Sarah and Holder get a break in the case; Seward battles his own mortality; and Bullet takes on the role of protector.

episodes.name: Try
episodes.summary: The investigation reaches a fever pitch when Sarah goes missing. Meanwhile, Bullet makes a choice to save Lyric and learns a dark secret.

episodes.name: Reckoning
episodes.summary: The hunt for the pornographer leads to an alarming revelation, and Holder seeks someone to blame. Meanwhile, Twitch and Lyric find their dream home.

episodes.name: Six Minutes
episodes.summary: Sarah deals with the consequences of her past mistakes; Holder wrestles with personal demons; and Seward tells the truth.

episodes.name: From Up Here
episodes.summary: Sarah seeks peace in the case's aftermath; the detectives pick up an unnerving new assignment; Lyric is tempted by her old life; Danette says good-bye.

episodes.name: The Road to Hamelin
episodes.summary: Sarah risks her life when someone dear to her goes missing; and Holder's past is used against him.

episodes.name: Blood in the Water
episodes.summary: Holder and Linden start work on a new case where a quite wealthy family have been murdered. The only survivour attends an all-boys military academy and suspiscion instantly places him as a prime suspect. Lindon and Holder are struggle dealing with the final outcome of the last case.

episodes.name: Unraveling
episodes.summary: The survivor of the shooting returns to the academy where he has to face his fellow cadets. Lindon and Holder investigate a mysterious man living in viewing distance of the murdered family revealing a few secrets about the perfect-looking family. Lindon and Holder run into further issues trying to get to talk to the students at the academy as Lindon tries to hold it together after the death of Skinner.

episodes.name: The Good Soldier
episodes.summary: Holder and Linden attend the Stanbury's funeral hoping that the girl who visited Kyle would turn up. Reddick continues to investigate Skinner's disappearance putting more stress on both Linden and Holder. Holder has trouble coming to terms with the fact that he will be a father. We find out more about Colonel Rayne and Stansbury family past.

episodes.name: Dream Baby Dream
episodes.summary: Holder acts aggressive in asking questions due to his recent drug relapse. Lincoln continues to "bully" Kyle in various ways at the academy. More is revealed about Kyle and his relationship with his mother. We learn more about Kyle's mother's sexual preferences. Reddick begins to close in on the whereabouts of Skinner.

episodes.name: Truth Asunder
episodes.summary: Reddick comes down harshly on Linden about about the Skinner matter although Linden tries to uphold that all the evidence is circumstantial. Linden finds out that Holder mentioned the event at an NA meeting. Conflict between Linden and Holder rises throughout the episode. We learn more about family day and perhaps it's links to the murders.

episodes.name: Eden
episodes.summary: Holder prepares for his child with Caroline. The case of the Stanburys' murders is brought to an end with a series of unexpected events. Reddick finally points a finger at Linden resolving the Spinner case once and for all. An incite into Holder and Linden's lives in a few years time is given to finish off the story once and for all.

shows.title: Intruders
shows.summary: A contemporary, chilling, paranormal tale set in the moody Pacific Northwest, the series spins a fascinating and complex web of drama. As strange, apparently unrelated events start happening, multiple story-lines - a missing wife, an assassin covering his crimes, a child on the run - begin to intertwine to reveal a conspiracy that will forever change our understanding of human nature.

episodes.name: She Was Provisional
episodes.summary: Mysteries unfold as Amy heads to Seattle on business and vanishes; Jack goes to Seattle only to uncover more unanswered questions about Amy’s whereabouts; an old friend visits Jack and asks for his help. Meanwhile, nine-year-old Madison starts behaving erratically after seeing a stranger on the beach. An assassin desperately tries to stop his secret from leaking.

episodes.name: And Here…You Must Listen
episodes.summary: Jack desperately tries to find Amy in Seattle but her movements offer more questions than answers; Madison finds herself in a train station with a ticket to Seattle, an envelope of cash, and a mysterious key. An act of humanity has serious consequences for Richard.

episodes.name: Time Has Come Today
episodes.summary: Jack returns home to find Amy sleeping soundly in bed. She has a logical explanation for her whereabouts in Seattle and professes her love to Jack only to ask for a separation the next day. Jack is terrified for Amy’s mental state. Meanwhile, Gary calls with alarming news. Things get dangerous as Madison hitches a ride to Seattle, determined to evade capture. A deal from Richard’s past continues to haunt him.

episodes.name: Ave Verum Corpus
episodes.summary: Gary reveals a strange link between his former client and Amy. But just as Jack and Gary start to put the pieces together, their only reliable source is brutally murdered. Meanwhile, Madison arrives in Seattle and threatens an old acquaintance. Richard attempts to conceal his secret continues while handling rising pressure from Rose.

episodes.name: The Shepherds and the Fox
episodes.summary: Jack discovers that Gary was fired from the law firm he claimed sent him to Seattle. Jack confronts Gary who confesses that he knows far more about Bill Anderson’s murder and research than he’s previously let on. Even more disturbing, he’s discovered a connection between Amy and Rose that will change Jack’s life forever. Meanwhile, Madison’s instincts are getting stronger as she starts making more sense of Marcus’ memories. Frank’s concern over Shepherd leads to dangerous consequences.

episodes.name: Bound
episodes.summary: Rose confronts Jack to explain the cause of Amy’s recent strange behavior. Amy’s past – one which she has worked so hard to suppress and deny – has come back to haunt her and the only way to protect Jack may hurt him the most. Meanwhile, Richard discovers a secret about Rose that could destroy her ascent onto The Nine. Shepherd himself is skating on thin ice as Madison continues to evade his grasp.

episodes.name: The Crossing Place
episodes.summary: A gruesome discovery buried in Jack’s backyard incites him to make one last attempt to bring Amy home. Rose remains haunted by a tragedy from her distant past and abducts a lowly waiter whom she’s certain will have answers. Tired from running, Richard confesses to Rose the truth about Marcus’ return while Marcus gets ever closer in exacting his revenge against Rose. Gary has finally realized how to expose the corruption behind Qui Reverti, but it demands an unthinkable sacrifice.

episodes.name: There Is No End
episodes.summary: In the season finale, Jack discovers the alarming depth and scope of the organization to which he’s lost Amy. Marcus and Madison engage in a fatal struggle. Richard is forced on the run but recruits an unexpected partner along the way.

shows.title: Z Nation
shows.summary: Z Nation starts three years after the zombie virus has gutted the country, a team of everyday heroes must transport the only known survivor of the plague from New York to California, where the last functioning viral lab waits for his blood. Although the antibodies he carries are the world's last, best hope for a vaccine, he hides a dark secret that threatens them all. With humankind's survival at stake, the ragtag band embarks on a journey of survival across three thousand miles of rusted-out post-apocalyptic America.

episodes.name: Puppies and Kittens
episodes.summary: A ragtag team come together to transport the only known survivor of a zombie virus across post-apocalyptic America to a lab that's waiting for his blood in the premiere of this drama. However, what they don't know is that their last, best hope for a vaccine is hiding a dark secret that threatens them all.

episodes.name: Fracking Zombies
episodes.summary: In New Jersey, the survivors run out of fuel and embark on a dangerous mission to replenish their supply. Meanwhile, Cassandra's past comes back to haunt her.

episodes.name: Philly Feast
episodes.summary: The survivors make their way through the mean streets of Philadelphia, where they cross paths with a group of psychotic outlaws with ties to one of their own.

episodes.name: Full Metal Zombie
episodes.summary: The heroes encounter a zombie army; 10K's mysterious past is revealed.

episodes.name: Home Sweet Zombie
episodes.summary: The survivors are in Warren's hometown of Central Illinois looking for her long-missing husband, and trying to survive a zombie tornado

episodes.name: Resurrection Z
episodes.summary: An encounter with a seeming Utopian enclave and a religious cult results in a game changer when the survivors travel near Branson, Mo.

episodes.name: Welcome to FU-Bar
episodes.summary: The survivors struggle to recover from a shocking death; and in Kansas they happen upon a gun show that makes the zombie apocalypse look calm.

episodes.name: Zunami
episodes.summary: A literal zombie tsunami engulfs the survivors, who are forced to take drastic action to survive as they travel across Nebraska; at the same time, Citizen Z gets a visitor.

episodes.name: Die Zombie Die ... Again
episodes.summary: Mack attempts to go on a real date with Addy, but ends up stuck in some Groundhog Day-like nightmare.

episodes.name: Going Nuclear
episodes.summary: The survivors square off against radioactive zombies when they arrive in a South Dakota town that's on the brink of nuclear disaster.

episodes.name: Sisters of Mercy
episodes.summary: The two groups of survivors reunite in Utah, where they come upon an all-female commune that seems like paradise—that is, until someone ends up dead.

episodes.name: Murphy's Law
episodes.summary: Murphy is kidnapped by a group of outlaws trying to crack the "Fort Knox of Oxycotin." As the survivors battle drug-enhanced zombies, a startling discovery is made about Murphy's abilities.

episodes.name: Doctor of the Dead
episodes.summary: Citizen Z redeploys the survivors to Fort Collins, Colo., to meet with Murphy's doctor in the Season 1 finale. At the compound, they discover game-changing details about their mission and the origins of the zombie virus.

episodes.name: The Murphy
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 premiere, moments have passed since Murphy triggered the launch of tactical nuclear weapons and it's every man/woman for themselves as the group split up and try to outrun the impending blast. Meanwhile, Citizen Z finds himself battling thawed zombies and unable to communicate with the team, which leads him to make a desperate move that prompts the arrival of a mysterious and deadly bounty hunter.

episodes.name: White Light
episodes.summary: The heroes are reunited, but soon find themselves navigating an unexpected tragedy as they engage in fierce fighting with both zombies and bounty hunters who are eager to capture Murphy, dead or alive. Meanwhile, Vasquez makes a strategic decision.

episodes.name: Zombie Road
episodes.summary: Murphy is finally tracked down; the Zs are attacked by superfast zombies known as Blasters; and they are introduced to an ultrapotent strain of marijuana called Z-Weed.

episodes.name: Batch 47
episodes.summary: The survivors search for a "natural" cure for the virus at a greenhouse that's being guarded by zombie-plant hybrids.

episodes.name: Zombaby
episodes.summary: Murphy's past comes back to bite him when a pregnant Serena tracks him down. Meanwhile, the survivors stumble upon a hidden Mennonite farm where the members are fighting for their lives against both zombies and anthrax.

episodes.name: Zombie Baby Daddy
episodes.summary: Murphy's parental instincts kick in as he grows quite attached to Little Miss Murphy Jr., while the rest of the team can't help but wonder if there's more to this child than meets the eye.

episodes.name: Down the Mississippi
episodes.summary: A boating accident splits the group up as they are trying to cross the Mississippi; and 10K gets mixed up in Sketchy and Skeezy's latest scam, which leads to a frightening run-in with Escorpion.

episodes.name: The Collector
episodes.summary: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic zombie fan who wants a new addition to his museum.

episodes.name: Rozwell
episodes.summary: Mysterious things happen during a drive through RoZwell, N.M., where the team encounter bright lights in the sky and a beautiful but spacey woman who leads them on an adventure in search of zombie aliens.

episodes.name: We Were Nowhere Near the Grand Canyon
episodes.summary: The heroes are forced to split up when threatened by a massive horde of zombies. After going their separate ways, they meet two factions of a once united Native American tribe.

episodes.name: Corporate Retreat
episodes.summary: The heroes get mixed up in corporate politics after they seek refuge in a hotel that has been taken over by a group of white-collar survivors; and when someone tries to shoot Murphy, the search for the suspect turns into a game of Clue, but with zombies.

episodes.name: Party with the Zeros
episodes.summary: The team meets La Reina, Queen of the Zeros, after being captured; Dr. Kurian is ready for human trials on his Z-vaccine at the Zero compound.

episodes.name: Adiós, Muchachos
episodes.summary: All hell breaks loose when it's discovered that Dr. Kurian's Z-Vaccine doesn't work at all and anyone who has been inoculated is now susceptible to Murphy's unique brand of mind manipulation. Meanwhile, Warren tries to free Vasquez after he's sentenced to death by La Reina.

episodes.name: Day One
episodes.summary: The heroes recall their pasts, including where they were when the Zombie Apocalypse started, as they finally reach their destination of California.

episodes.name: All Good Things Must Come to an End
episodes.summary: The heroes seem to be nearing the end of their adventure when, in the Season 2 finale, they drive through the abandoned city of Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab, where Dr. Merch awaits their arrival. Meanwhile, the Zeros are hot on Murphy and the gang's heels.

episodes.name: No Mercy
episodes.summary: In an unseen story from Season 2, the gang must protect a town from a dangerous new enemy.

episodes.name: A New Mission
episodes.summary: While Murphy and Warren face off, the fates of 10K and Citizen Z are revealed.

episodes.name: Murphy's Miracle
episodes.summary: Murphy's mission to launch his headquarters in Spokane gains momentum when he saves a girls life. Elsewhere in the Apocalypse, Warren and the motley gang meet Wally the mailman in a bizarre Zombified town. Meanwhile, Citizen Z takes his new friend, Kaya, across the Arctic tundra to Camp Northern Light.

episodes.name: Escorpion and the Red Hand
episodes.summary: More people flock to Murphy's new cult; the others are stuck in the middle of a war.

episodes.name: Little Red and the Wolfz
episodes.summary: Injured, alone, and suffering from the side effects of the booster Merch gave him, 10K barely manages to escape his relentless Blend pursuer. Just as he breaks free, he finds himself stalked by a pack of Zombie Wolves. But wait.. are they wolves? In 10K's lowest moment, 5K and Red appear and help him find the strength to survive. Murphy, meanwhile, goes over Dr. Merch's complicated notes while absentmindedly snacking on her brains.

episodes.name: Doc Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
episodes.summary: The residents of a mental hospital capture Doc.

episodes.name: Welcome to Murphytown
episodes.summary: The Man discovers Lucy's existence; 10K reunites with the gang and he tells them about Murphy's growing army.

episodes.name: Election Day
episodes.summary: On the road to find Lucy in Illinois, Doc and Addy are forced off the road by a retro presidential limo. Turns out Sketchy is running for "President of the Apocalypse" with Skeezy as his campaign manager. Doc and Addy follow them to Wall Drug, South Dakota and witness the somehow lucrative, always entertaining train wreck that is Sketchy and Skeezy.

episodes.name: Heart of Darkness
episodes.summary: Warren and the others inspect Murphytown and realize they are going to need a bigger army to extract Murphy.

episodes.name: They Grow Up So Quickly
episodes.summary: Doc and Addy try to convince Lucy's family to follow them; Murphy tests 10K's allegiance.

episodes.name: Doc's Angels
episodes.summary: Doc tries to find a way to communicate with Warren, but instead encounters something much more menacing.

episodes.name: The Siege of Murphytown
episodes.summary: Warren leads an attack on Murphytown and finally faces off with Murphy.

episodes.name: Duel
episodes.summary: Enders, Zombies, and Wild Beasts, oh my! The Man can dishes out more twisted horrors, but none of it stops Addy in her pursuit of Lucy. Meanwhile, Lucy makes The Man's life a living hell, summoning all manners of Zombie obstacles.

episodes.name: Everybody Dies in the End
episodes.summary: Addy and Doc have no idea where Lucy is when they're approached by a very unusual Zombie! They catch up with Warren and the others but the reunion is short-lived. The Man has Lucy captive at the highest point for miles, and while the Heroes must battle Zona Blends, Enders, Zombies, the fate of humanity hangs in the balance in this season finale literal cliffhanger.

episodes.name: Warren's Dream
episodes.summary: Warren's Apocalyptic Dream of a Black Rainbow sends our heroes on a mysterious new mission to save the Apocalypse from something even worse. Warren awakens from a coma to find herself in ZONA two years later, with Murphy seemingly cured, and the rest of our heroes either dead or fighting for their lives against unkillable "MAD-Z's" caused by an evolving Zombie Virus.

episodes.name: Escape from Zona
episodes.summary: Driven by her dream of a Black Rainbow and flesh eating rain, Warren and Murphy escape Zona; Doc, 10K and Sarge are pinned down by snipers.

episodes.name: The Vanishing
episodes.summary: By the time Warren and the others make it to the refugee camp, Red and Sun Mei have mysteriously vanished along with everyone else. After convincing 10K to give up the search for Red, Murphy and the others decide to head to Numerica with Sarge -- but Warren has her own plan. Driven by her dream, Warren is compelled to head east instead of north.

episodes.name: A New Mission: Keep Moving
episodes.summary: Following Warren's dream, the team doesn't stop while crossing The Great Pile, a seemingly endless landscape of rubble and destruction.

episodes.name: The Unknowns
episodes.summary: The team is captured by an Unseen Force and enslaved in an elaborate underground facility, forced by their mysterious captors to perform a series of bizarre, dangerous tasks.

episodes.name: Back from the Undead
episodes.summary: Lucy fights to save Murphy's life; Warren and the others battle a biologically modified Franken-Zombie guarding a clue to Warren's dream.

episodes.name: A Nice Day for Warren's Wedding
episodes.summary: Shaken by the death of one of the team, something snaps in Murphy, and Warren is unable to stop him and the others from committing an atrocity as misplaced revenge.

episodes.name: Crisis of Faith
episodes.summary: Warren and the others encounter a mysterious stranger who they think is a grave robber, but they're something much more.

episodes.name: We Interrupt This Program
episodes.summary: The group explores an abandoned TV news station and encounters news crew zombies triggering haunting flashbacks from day one.

episodes.name: Frenemies
episodes.summary: Doc and Our Heroes are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working Barber Shop full of mysterious, and murderous, characters.

episodes.name: Return to Mercy Labs
episodes.summary: Warren's dream leads the group back to Mercy Labs where she must perform a dangerous task without knowing why.

episodes.name: Mt. Weather
episodes.summary: Warren and the group must stop Zona from launching operation Black Rainbow to cleanse the landscape of zombies- and humans.

episodes.name: The Black Rainbow
episodes.summary: The secret of Warren's Black Rainbow dream is unlocked when they reach their final destination.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Newpocalypse
episodes.summary: Warren recovers from the drone crash with handsome, mysterious Cooper; Doc and the others finally arrive in Newmerica, where they meet George, who is helping form the new country.

episodes.name: A New Life
episodes.summary: Warren must leave her new life behind and find her way to Newmerica, reuniting with Murphy and the other heroes, while discovering George is an old friend.

episodes.name: Escape from Altura
episodes.summary: 10K nearly loses everything as panic and anti-Talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote.

episodes.name: Pacifica
episodes.summary: Warren and George search for Lt. Dante, who may be part of an underground network helping Talkers flee human vigilantes.

episodes.name: Killing All the Books
episodes.summary: Pacifica is bombed and the heroes decide to follow the Talker Underground to stop whoever is behind the attacks.

episodes.name: Limbo
episodes.summary: Warren and the others are reunited with Addy in "Limbo", an underground casino run by Murphy and his Blends, that shelters Talkers on the run from Altura Militia.

episodes.name: Doc's Stoned History
episodes.summary: As Doc explains his version of American History to George, Sketchy and Skeezy re-enact Doc's stories about the Founding Fathers, while Warren and the others go the bakery that invented biZkits in search of the secret ingredient.

episodes.name: Heartland
episodes.summary: Our heroes arrive in the farming outpost that produces flour for bizkits and find it overrun by zombies.

episodes.name: Water Keepers
episodes.summary: Doc must spirit walk again to help save the Chief of the Water Keepers and get the water flowing to Newmerica.

episodes.name: State of Mine
episodes.summary: Altura militiamen force Talkers to mine a hazardous waste landfill for the secret ingredient to bizkits.

episodes.name: Hackerville
episodes.summary: With some help from an outpost of renegade hackers, Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.

episodes.name: At All Cost
episodes.summary: Warren and the others must free the Talkers being held in Quarantine and prepare to attack Altura.

episodes.name: The End of Everything
episodes.summary: The heroes break into Altura in an attempt to bring Pandora and Estes to justice; Cooper reappears, shocking Warren; there's something he has to tell her.

shows.title: Resurrection
shows.summary: The people of Arcadia, Missouri are forever changed when their deceased loved ones suddenly start to reappear. An 8-year-old American boy wakes up alone in a rice paddy in a rural Chinese province with no idea how he got there. Details start to emerge when the boy, who calls himself Jacob, recalls that his hometown is Arcadia, and an Immigration agent, J. Martin Bellamy, takes him there. The home he claims as his own is occupied by a 60-year-old couple, Henry and Lucille Langston, who lost their son, Jacob, more than 30 years ago. While they look different, young Jacob recognizes them as his parents. Lucille is overjoyed at the seeming miracle of her son's reappearance. Henry is reluctant to accept that Jacob is back. Those closest to the family want answers, including Sheriff Fred Langston, whose wife Barbara drowned 30 years ago while trying to save Jacob, and Fred's daughter, Maggie, a local doctor. Pastor Tom Hale seeks a spiritual reason for what's happening in his community. When things take an even more shocking turn, Maggie's life-long friend, Elaine Richards, finds herself drawn into Arcadia's growing mystery. Bellamy, an outsider in the town, joins forces with Maggie to figure out why the unexplainable is happening in Arcadia. As their investigation plays out, Maggie learns some unsettling truths about her own past. Will they be able to solve the mystery of Arcadia before the rest of the world catches on to events there? And will they be able to protect Jacob from forces beyond their control?

episodes.name: The Returned
episodes.summary: The people of Arcadia, Missouri are forever changed when their deceased loved ones suddenly start to reappear.

episodes.name: Unearth
episodes.summary: The Langstons, especially Sheriff Fred, are forced to confront secrets from their past they'd rather leave buried when Bellamy pushes to have Jacob's tomb exhumed. Maggie agrees to help Bellamy in his investigation, and Pastor Tom reaches out to Jacob, his childhood friend. The Richards family adjusts to Caleb's return, the second for Arcadia. But unlike Jacob, Caleb claims he has no memory of his death.

episodes.name: Two Rivers
episodes.summary: Exhuming Jacob's grave only deepens the mystery of his return. Henry struggles to accept that Jacob is really the son he lost 30 years ago. Bellamy and Maggie search for a connection between Jacob and Caleb's deaths and wonder if the local river may hold a clue. Their digging also unearths Caleb's criminal past - he robbed the bank his daughter Elaine works at just days before his death. Pastor Tom's life is changed forever by a shocking turn of events.

episodes.name: Us Against the World
episodes.summary: Bellamy and Sheriff Fred form an uneasy partnership to find Caleb, who has gone on the run after Dale's murder. After Jacob suffers a seizure, Maggie gives him a checkup at the clinic and is shocked by what she finds. Pastor Tom adjusts to the unexpected presence of his old love Rachael in Arcadia.

episodes.name: Insomnia
episodes.summary: Bellamy struggles to keep Jacob safe from outside forces. But a tragic incident from his past as a cop continues to haunt him. Elaine is pressured to find out where dad Caleb hid the stolen bank money before the FBI comes to town and learns the truth about Arcadia. Maggie delivers shocking news to Rachael, and Caleb gives Bellamy a chilling warning.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.summary: Maggie turns to a man from her past, Dr. Eric Ward, now working for the NIH, for answers to Arcadia's mystery. She insists Ward is there as a friend, but Bellamy is suspicious of any outsiders. Rachael's secret falls into the wrong hands. In the wake of recent events, Pastor Tom and Bellamy try to reassure Arcadians they have nothing to fear from the returned, but some residents have other ideas.

episodes.name: Schemes of the Devil
